Added: October 14, 2026

Tracklist

All the way from Moldova, modern day Mozart, Andrei Rata, born on July 21st , 1992 has been making his own marks, and own unique style in the trance scene. Andrei Rata known as Andrew Rayel started at a young age developing the passion that he has towards his musical skills. Studying Orchestral music and producing only at the age 13 , Andrew Rayel is a name known for his piano keys, harmony, euphoric, and and mesmerizing sounds.

item.title: Ferry Corsten – Resonation Radio 307
item.description:
Artist: Ferry Corsten Show: Ferry Corsten – Resonation Radio 307 Serie: Resonation Radio Added: October 14, 2026 Genre: Trance

Show: Ferry Corsten – Resonation Radio 307

Serie: Resonation Radio

Added: October 14, 2026

Genre: Trance

Tracklist

Resonation Radio #307 brings another exciting selection of fresh electronic music, featuring tracks from Orjan Nilsen, Markus Schulz, Joris Voorn, Rank 1, Armin van Buuren and more!

Ferry kicks off the show with his latest collaboration with Eddo Brandwijk, Oh, How I Miss You, out now on Flashover Recordings, alongside a special blend of Attraction with Marsh ahead of their B2B performance in Liverpool.

With Amsterdam Dance Event just around the corner, Ferry shares details about his upcoming Ferry Corsten & Friends show at Free Your Mind Club and a special Club Train experience.

To close the episode, Ferry finally reveals the highly anticipated mystery ID, Persiste, coming October 30 on Flashover Recordings. Pre-save it here! https://ferrycorsten.lnk.to/Persiste

Ferry Corsten & Eddo Brandwijk – Oh, How I Miss You [Flashover]

item.title: Josey Rebelle – Bassiani Podcast 332
item.description:
Artist: Josey Rebelle Show: Josey Rebelle – Bassiani Podcast 332 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: October 13, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Josey Rebelle – Bassiani Podcast 332

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: October 13, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

A native Brit with Caribbean roots, Josey Rebelle’s been a London torch-bearer for many years, pulling from influences like hardcore, jungle, house and Detroit techno and building a reputation as canny DJ in the process. Learning to mix her older brother’s collection of records, she eventually ended up playing nights at some of the city’s most established venues, holding a residency at now-shuttered Plastic People, and crucially, a decade-long stint at Rinse FM. No PR, no social media, no management, stripped of all the marketing is a profound authenticity to her work and sets that speak for themselves, bringing the music she loves to club floors and festivals across the map (the likes of Open Ground, FOLD, RSO, Tresor, Terraforma, Dimensions and Aurora Halal’s Sustain-Release). And through it all is a formidable self-awareness, joy and knack for choosing the right tune at the right time: these fleeting beats are cathartic, physical and heavily addictive. For Bassiani Podcast 332, Josey unleashes an hour of high-grade dance fare punctuated by a slowed down, introspective and dubby coda; a chugging, wobbling, sample-heavy studio mix from a tried and true selector.

Bassiani Podcast

item.description:
Artist: Glaskin Show: Glaskin – HATE Podcast 508 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: October 11, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Glaskin – HATE Podcast 508

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: October 11, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Glaskin are the 508th guests of our original HATE Podcast series.

Sound, Rhythm & Movement. This mix represents the music we’ve been deeply immersed in lately, featuring some of our favorite producers when it comes to driving, hypnotic grooves and peak-time intensity. Blended with plenty of our own unreleased and upcoming material, it captures the essence of our sound as it stands today.

GLASKIN is the Munich based duo of brothers Jonathan and Ferdinand, known for their exceptional and one-of-a-kind techno as well as their residency at Blitz Club.

The duo has consistently pushed boundaries with releases such as the Valve EP on their own imprint, Inertia of Motion EP on Mutual Rytm, Blue Light EP on CROWD, which earned a spot among GROOVE’s top EPs of 2025, or their standout remix of Len Faki’s Gamma on Figure.

With their live performances becoming an increasingly defining part of their artistic identity and another significant chapter of their musical journey set to unfold before the end of 2026, Glaskin show no signs of slowing down, continuing to carve out their own path in contemporary techno.

HATE Podcast

item.description:
Artist: Aphøtic Show: Terminal V Podcast 130 – Aphøtic Serie: terminal-v Added: October 9, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Terminal V Podcast 130 – Aphøtic

Serie: terminal-v

Added: October 9, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Dutch producer and DJ APHØTIC has moved fast since his first rave in 2019. He bought a mixer soon after, production followed closely behind and now he has an audience that’s streamed his music millions of times worldwide. The name comes from the aphotic zone, the stretch of ocean sunlight never reaches, and it fits the music: aggressive, dark and relentlessly quick.

In our interview, he talks about going all-in on schranz, why he’s always four tracks ahead in the booth, and the year-long project he’s finally ready to unveil spanning schranz, hard techno and hardcore. The mix is hard and fast throughout, recorded across four decks and is stacked with unreleased material of his own alongside gems from VLTN, RiVid, Lorenz B and many more. Rather than stacking banger on banger, he builds it as a story with long breaks, continuous beats and undiscovered cuts woven between the heavy hitters.

As Markus Schulz turns the page from the trance-focused summer into his darker techno season, this week’s Global DJ Broadcast arrives alongside the release of In Search of Sunrise 22: Nocturnal Voyage. With the next open to close experience at Stereo in Montreal waiting this weekend, Markus showcases his latest single Second Tomorrow and the Dakota original Exit 302, along with Coldharbour features from KhoMha, Milkwish & van Dope and Mike EFEX. Fresh from his Nocturnal Voyage exclusive entry in Abyss, Sander van Doorn provides a powerful guestmix, before the final 30 brings Stereo into focus.

Midnighters, this week I’m opening the hour with my own track.

Golden goes first. You heard it in last week’s episode before most people did, and since then, it has kept climbing in the promo lists. Now it has a release date: 15 October on IAMT.

A track only travels when people pass it on, and the same goes for this show. If Golden has stuck with you since last week, send this episode to one friend who should hear it. Then tell me in the comments where you were when it hit you, and tag it #TheMidnightProject so I can find you.

On the island it’s closing season, but the show keeps going. A new hour every Wednesday, through the winter, wherever you are.

See you at midnight,

Sebastiaan

item.description:
Artist: Anthony Linell Show: Anthony Linell – Bassiani Podcast 331 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: October 6, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Anthony Linell – Bassiani Podcast 331

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: October 6, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Anthony Linell is no stranger to the Caucasian capital. With a frequent presence at Bassiani since the very beginning of the club, undoubtedly becoming a big influence on the emergence of Tbilisi club culture, he’s remained a recurring figure in the city’s musical life ever since. Known for his work around Northern Electronics and his more austere, hypnotic strains of techno, Bassiani Podcast 331 holds something different. Recorded on a beautiful morning in the late summer of 2026, it showcase another part of Linell’s musical vocabulary. The set draws from the fringes of his record collection, marking groove-driven psychadelic house and progressive-oriented numbers. A lesser known side of Linell’s club repertoire, captured in the intimate setting of the Horoom.”

Bassiani Podcast

item.title: Mees Salomé – Distant 111
item.description:
Artist: Mees Salomé Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 111 Serie: Distant Added: October 2, 2026 Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 111

Serie: Distant

Added: October 2, 2026

Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Tracklist

Life can be a lot sometimes. There are moments when everything seems to fall into place, when you’re at the top, enjoying life and feeling like you can take on anything. And then, sometimes, you find yourself at the bottom again, looking up at a mountain you have to climb.

For me, that’s how life works. Like a wave, up and down, constantly moving. We can’t really change that. What we can change is how we look at those moments.

When you’re at the bottom, it can be hard to imagine being back on top. But you will. Maybe not tomorrow, maybe not the day after that, and maybe the climb will take much longer than you hoped. But you will get there. Sometimes you just need to be brave enough to tell yourself: I will get there. No matter how long it takes.

And maybe that’s what this month’s episode is about. A little reminder that wherever you are in the wave right now, it won’t stay there forever.

Hope you enjoy <3

Distant

item.title: Balance Selections 386 – Fernando Olaya
item.description:
Artist: Fernando Olaya Show: Balance Selections 386 – Fernando Olaya Serie: Balance Selections Added: October 2, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 386 – Fernando Olaya

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: October 2, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Fernando Olaya is no stranger to Balance audiences. At the start of 2026, he made his debut with the label through the four-track ‘We Were Never Lost’ EP, a collaborative release that connected him with several fellow Colombian producers.

That release sits within a steadily growing catalogue that has seen his music appear across some of progressive house’s most established platforms. Alongside Kamilo Sanclemente, Olaya has become one of Colombia’s most active producers, building a reputation around a consistent run of detailed, club-focused releases.

On this Balance Selections, the producer highlights why he is becoming so undeniable. Featuring tracks and remixes from Greg Ochman, Gorkiz, Julian Millan and more, this is 90 minutes of proper progressive filled with many surprises.

Balance Selections

As the sun sets on another unforgettable Ibiza season, the island recently celebrated its now-traditional trance week. While Markus Schulz’s Eden residency took place on Thursdays, it moved to Friday September 25 for the closing party, as the transition from the trance sounds of The Nirvana to the darker techno influence of The Nocturnal Voyage was in earnest.

The finale of In Search of Sunrise 22’s trilogy, the Nocturnal Voyage, will be available to stream from Wednesday October 7; with the limited edition triple CD and vinyl editions available to pre-order now at the Magik Muzik shop.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 226
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 226 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: September 30, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 226

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: September 30, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters, a new hour is here.

I often wonder where you are when you press play. Some of you have told me you listen on the early commute, some at the gym, some in the kitchen, some late at night in the studio when everything else is quiet. From Amsterdam to Buenos Aires to right here on Ibiza, we’re all in different places at different times, but we’re listening to the same hour. That’s what makes this a community and not just a show.

So this week I want to hear from you. Where are you listening right now, and when? Drop it in the comments. Send a photo of your listening spot if you like, and tag it #TheMidnightProject. I’d love to see where these hours end up around the world.

And if there’s someone in your life who belongs in this community, a gym buddy or a friend who always asks what you’re listening to, send them this episode. That’s how Midnighters find each other.

For once, you can listen in the same place at the same time as me.

See you next Wednesday, Midnighters.

The Midnight Project

Dannic showcases two of his own productions — “Round & Round” and “Dopamine” — alongside his remix of Sir Ivan’s “Love Is The Piece,” while creative mashups and standout edits from SUBURBIA, WILL K, and Amir Reza keep the energy unpredictable and fresh. item.title: Ndrx b2b Sophie Phare – Bassiani Podcast 330
item.description:
Artist: NDRX , Sophie Phare Show: Ndrx b2b Sophie Phare – Bassiani Podcast 330 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: September 29, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Ndrx b2b Sophie Phare – Bassiani Podcast 330

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: September 29, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Stare at DJ founder and Tbilisi music mainstay NDRX teams up with native Sophie Phare for this next one. Clocking up over two decades of combined experience, their savvy selections are the living and breathing pulse of the local scene, a place where both have contributed not just to the clubfloor, but through a number of community-building projects that have stoked the fire of homegrown talent and fixed Georgia on the map as a nexus for electronic music culture. As longtime selectors, the duo bring a shared history as key figures in their respective music landscapes as well as complementary energies for their first back-to-back performance, a high-voltage deck-side trip through groove-heavy sounds. These tunes run hot, a perfect combination of spiraling melodies and glancing drum patterns, bouncy house for the early hours. Pairing activist tunes and a keen feel for rhythm, these two cook up a three-hour mish-mash of chugging vibrations for Bassiani Podcast 330, a live-recorded set from the Horoom floor back at the end of June.

Bassiani Podcast

Tracklist

Live from Ibiza’s Trance Week, Markus Schulz previews the finale of his Eden open to close Eden residency with the latest Global DJ Broadcast. The show is highlighted by a preview of his upcoming single Second Tomorrow, taken from In Search of Sunrise 22, alongside offerings from Dutch Force, Tao Andra & Sarah de Warren, Eli Brown, Laura van Dam and more. KhoMha returns to the broadcast to provide the guestmix, highlighting his upcoming Coldharbour single Ananke. Markus also pays tribute to the recently deceased Duncan Sheik, with his song On a High having been a pillar of the broadcast’s early years.

Hello my fellow trance classics lovers! Welcome to episode ninety-eight of Noisetalgia.

Today we celebrate the incredible legacy of Finnish producer and mastermind Jaakko Salovaara, aka JS16. item.title: Balance Selections 384 – David Mayer
item.description:
Artist: David Mayer Show: Balance Selections 384 – David Mayer Serie: Balance Selections Added: September 18, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 384 – David Mayer

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: September 18, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

David Mayer’s sound reflects a life spent moving between cultures. Raised across Germany, Spain and Norway before settling in Berlin in 2004, he developed an approach to dance music that has never sat comfortably inside a single genre. House and techno form the foundation, but the real through-line is rhythm- funked-up low end, muscular four-on-the-floor grooves and a sense of swing that keeps even his deeper productions firmly connected to the dancefloor.

As both a DJ and producer, Mayer favours music with weight and immediacy, balancing hypnotic detail with an instinct for hooks and forward motion. It’s a combination that has carried his work well beyond Berlin, while preserving the restless, open-ended character at the centre of his sound.

On this Balance Selections, the German producer stays true to form with a deep house-rooted 60-minute mix. Featuring tracks from Dino Lenny, The Deepshakerz, the late Nico Stojan and more, it’s an easy soundtrack for a day spent on an open-air dancefloor.

Balance Selections

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 224
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 224 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: September 16, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 224

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: September 16, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

Sixty thousand of you hear this hour on DI.FM every week, and that is before the podcast feeds, Spotify, SoundCloud, YouTube and every replay in between. The real number is bigger than I can count, and it grows in one way only. Someone sends the link to a friend on a night shift, someone drops the show in a group chat after a set, someone plays it in the car with the windows down. That has been the whole engine from the start. If the show gave you something this week, pass it to one person.

The hour opens on Drumcode with Taste of the Night, the first collaboration between A.D.H.S. and Kos:mo, out on DC4 Vol. 6 last Friday. Sam WOLFE and PETER PAHN came from that same EP last week, so the release is now three records deep in two shows. Victor Ruiz and Modeā follow with Bloom, again on Drumcode, then Zafer Atabey on EXTIMA, the Istanbul label he co-founded. Victor Ruiz returns with Moreira on Arcane Music, and Atlante takes us to twenty minutes, the title track of the Redraft Memories EP on Second State Audio. Gitecdj and Unika DJ land next on BLACKRIFT.

The middle is SS Ventura and Mankraft with Ravalon on Shodan Records, a label I know from the inside, then Marco Faraone with Killa on Artcore, Davestorm with the second EXTIMA record of the hour, and Tech Us Out on Orange Recordings. We close with Simina Grigoriu, Layers of Reality on DCLTD, the Heizek remix of Mind from Caméléonx on Dark Fiend Records, and Connect (BR) with Calum Kieran on Sound Dissonance.

Every one of those artists is someone in this community can discover for the first time this week. Follow them, buy the records, tell your people where you heard it. Small labels grow on exactly that, and so does this show.

So tell me which track hit hardest, I read everything.

See you at midnight, Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Woody92 – Bassiani Podcast 328
item.description:
Artist: Woody92 Show: Woody92 – Bassiani Podcast 328 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: September 15, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Woody92 – Bassiani Podcast 328

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: September 15, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Dutch selector and label boss Woody92 is an artist operating under a distinct brand of psychoactive electronic music, radiant techno and hypnotic fare that lives and breathes the spirit of immersive and narrative-driven experience. From his native Delft, The Hague, an unexpected electronic heavyweight, was only a stones throw away, and the young Dutch talent felt the pull. Since the mid 2010s he’s been active as DJ, holding a residency at now closed Amsterdam techno mecca De School and going on to found multidisciplinary platform Omen Wapta in 2021. The imprint is known for its abstract, rapid techno, with a tightly curated graphic output and dabbles in fashion and multimedia performances. It’s a shining example of what the very best labels can be when everything is taken into account, and for Woody, a “transitory playground for the imagination“. The mission is clear and underway, and Woody delivers his boundary-pushing energy in every set. For Bassiani Podcast 328 he brings rattling shamanic techno to the airwaves, a two hour flurry of cerebral rhythms criss-crossed with subversive magic and organic, ultra-layered sounds recorded in his studio. Stellar frequencies from a true visionary.

Bassiani Podcast

Tracklist

A dream destination of any summer, the Global DJ Broadcast World Tour arrives in the magical island of Ibiza, and captures the opening night of Markus Schulz’s five date open to close residency at Eden. A hot Thursday night into Friday morning formed the celebration of In Search of Sunrise 22’s second chapter, the Nirvana; alongside upfront originals and mashups. Markus’ Ibiza residency continues on Thursday September 17, before the season finale during Trance Week on the island on Friday September 25.

All the way from Moldova, modern day Mozart, Andrei Rata, born on July 21st , 1992 has been making his own marks, and own unique style in the trance scene. Andrei Rata known as Andrew Rayel started at a young age developing the passion that he has towards his musical skills. item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 223
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 223 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: September 9, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 223

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: September 9, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters, episode 223 is here.

Sam WOLFE opens the hour with Control Delete on Drumcode, and that label sets the tone for the whole show. Six Drumcode records in sixty minutes, more than I usually give one imprint, but Adam Beyer’s A&R has been on a run this year and the selection made the case for itself. After Sam WOLFE I go into Atmos, one of mine, then Gonzalo F with Disconnect, also Drumcode, and Mark Reeve with Everything Done on Monika Kruse’s Terminal M. Reeve has been a fixture on both of those labels for years, and it shows in how easily his record sits between them.

Les Boys follows, my second track this week, both of them tested on the island this summer. Then Redraft Memories and Spanto with Oculto on Second State Audio, the Pan-Pot label out of Berlin, which gets a long run in the mix because six minutes was what it needed.

The middle of the hour belongs to Kaufmann. Easy A and Nuff Said, back to back, both on Drumcode. I did not want to split them. PETER PAHN keeps the Drumcode thread going with NOCTURE before Sheik (AR) brings Needed You on Sound Dissonance Publishing.

From there the back half opens up. Jay Lumen with Dance4Life on Arcane Music, then Carlo Lio and M.I.T.A. together on Intec, Carl Cox’s label and one that has been part of this show since the earliest episodes. Rødhåd’s remix of Edge Runner by Ø [Phase] on Modwerks comes next, two Berlin names who have each shaped the harder end of techno for well over a decade and rarely appear on the same record. Slim Black closes with Acid Source on Hyggelit Records.

See you at midnight, Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Added: September 8, 2026

Tracklist

Hello my fellow trance classics lovers! Welcome to episode ninety-seven. Today we crank up the bass and bring the real oldschool as we celebrate the kings of progressive attack: the mighty Brooklyn Bounce.

Formed in Hamburg back in 1996 by Dennis Bohn and Matthias Menck, Brooklyn Bounce redefined the harder side of early club music. Expect 90 minutes of high-octane rave energy, iconic pumpin basslines, and massive anthems like ‘The Theme (Of Progressive Attack)’, ‘Club Bizarre’, ‘Get Ready to Bounce’, and ‘Loud & Proud’.

item.title: 3 Suli [live] – Bassiani Podcast 327
item.description:
Artist: 3 Suli Show: 3 Suli [live] – Bassiani Podcast 327 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: September 8, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: 3 Suli [live] – Bassiani Podcast 327

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: September 8, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Tbilisi trio 3Suli (three souls) is Kozmana, BMI and Third Soul, an experimental triple act and key force in Georgia’s underground. Together they rally up ritualistic symbolism and blistering beats, taking elements of house, techno, breakbeat and drum ’n’ bass as working material. They’re closely tied to Vodkast Records, the store so much a part of the Tbilisi scene, where their 2016 five-track Desna EP kicked off its eponymous label with a bang. As performers, the trio bring over a decade of know how to hardware driven sets, dispatching feverish beats to sweat covered ravers, strenuous rhythms for after-hours dancing, Tbilisi techno to the letter. For Bassiani Podcast 327, they bring that high-octane sound straight to the booth. Recorded live at Bassiani back in mid May, this is a one hour cut loaded with endurance drum patterns, snaking melodies and a whole lot of groove. Three souls working in perfect sync, and bringing the ethos of Georgian techno back to the fore. Steadily building, never tiring, a high-powered addition to the Bassiani Podcast roster.

Bassiani Podcast

Bidoben is the 503rd guest of our original HATE Podcast series.

Berlin-based DJ and producer Bidoben works in a hypnotic strain of techno: driving but physical, built on subtle shifts and evolving patterns that keep the energy moving without ever rushing it, with an elegant sense of restraint throughout.

This mix pulls in some unreleased and forthcoming music of his own, offering a focused glimpse into his sound: hypnotic, driving, and quietly intense.

item.description:
Artist: PoL Show: Selectro Podcast 465 – Pol (BO) Serie: Selectro Podcast Added: September 5, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Selectro Podcast 465 – Pol (BO)

Serie: Selectro Podcast

Added: September 5, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Pablo Mendizabal, aka Pol (BO), is a Bolivian DJ and producer from Santa Cruz who has been building his path in electronic music since 2019.

With a sound rooted in tech house, deep tech, deep house and minimal, Pol has become a familiar name across Bolivia’s club scene, performing at venues such as Panorama and Maroon in Santa Cruz, Lua in Cochabamba and RCA in La Paz.

His journey has also taken him to festivals and events including Beyond, Tarja Preta, Trébol Nights and Buriloop, where he has shared the stage with artists such as Inndrive, Rooftime, Emanuel Satie, Chino Negro, Morpei, Enzo Amoruccio, Rockstead, Slow Motion, Victor Lou and Charls.

Beyond the club, Pol has delivered podcasts and DJ sets for record labels and radio shows across Brazil, Argentina, Europe, Australia and the United States, steadily expanding his presence outside Bolivia.

Now focused on developing his own sound as a producer, Pol moves between tech house and minimal/deep influences. His music has been released on Upper Records, T-Tracks Music, Top of the Morning Records, Deep Tech Lab, Subliminal Senses, Vnyl Side, RIM, Go On, F*cking Sound Inside, Outsiders Recordings and more.

With new music on the way, Pol continues to develop a groove-driven sound built for the dancefloor while pushing his project into its next chapter.

item.title: Global DJ Broadcast – The Long Weekend Mix: Labor Day 2026 | Twilight of Summer
item.description:
Artist: Markus Schulz Show: Global DJ Broadcast – The Long Weekend Mix: Labor Day 2026 | Twilight of Summer Serie: Global DJ Broadcast Added: September 3, 2026 Genre: Trance

Show: Global DJ Broadcast – The Long Weekend Mix: Labor Day 2026 | Twilight of Summer

Serie: Global DJ Broadcast

Added: September 3, 2026

Genre: Trance

Tracklist

As the long days begin to fade, Markus Schulz shares his ode to Twilight of Summer with the Labor Day 2026 edition of The Long Weekend Mix series.

A two-hour journey through the final glow of the season, moving between new discoveries, current favorites and timeless memories. From warm evening atmosphere to deeper nocturnal moods, the journey reflects the places, people, nights and feelings that made the season ours.

The Long Weekend Mixes are created around key holiday weekends in the calendar, designed for immersive listening when you have a moment to step away. Music that takes its time, allowing you to get lost in the journey, and a story where meaning matters. You can find all nine Long Weekend Mixes to date in the podcast feed, with the next installment arriving in time for Thanksgiving.

Thank you for continuing to be part of the Global DJ Broadcast community week after week. We look forward to our autumn season, with the conclusion of In Search of Sunrise 22, Markus’ Eden Ibiza residency, a trip to Amsterdam Dance Event, and the weird and wonderful world of Afterdark all still to come.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 222
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 222 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: September 2, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 222

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: September 2, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters, thank you for another week of showing up. Here is where the hour goes.

It opens with something that is five days old. Zafer Atabey’s Keep It Going landed on TRAGEDIE on 28 August, built by the Turkish producer who co-runs EXTIMA, and it does exactly what the title promises. Rino Cerrone follows with Afterglow, Italian discipline, no wasted parts. Then Avision with How We Do It, a Suara cut from his Simple Things EP. Anthony Cardinale has been quietly carrying the New York techno flag for years and this one still hits like it was made last month.

The middle of the hour is where I had the most fun building. Cirez D’s On Off is the one throwback here, Eric Prydz in his techno skin on his own Mouseville imprint, and nothing has aged about it. Marco Bailey follows with Full Steam on COD3 QR, which is the label Laurent Garnier runs with Oliver Way. That makes two Garnier connections in twenty minutes, because Garnier is also the one who pulled the Avision track into his fabric presents compilation. Not planned, but I noticed it while I was mixing and left it in.

Then Mescaline. 1200 Micrograms wrote it as psytrance and Victor Ruiz and Alex Stein rebuilt it for VOLTA. It came out on 27 August and it is already sitting near the top of the Beatport peak time chart. Psytrance DNA, techno chassis, and it works on a rooftop at sunset better than it has any right to.

From there we stay heavy. Belocca’s Human Construct on Mainground Music brings the tension down and the weight up, Nikoretti’s Beyond the Edge keeps it moving, and Devid Dega’s Want You Back arrives on Second State, which is still one of the most consistent rooms in techno. Sisko Electrofanatik and Alex Micca close that stretch with Anairod on Off Recordings.

The last quarter is the payoff. Alan Fitzpatrick’s Zero Compliance mix of We Do What We Want on We Are The Brave is his own label and his own statement, and the title does not need my help. Franco Smith’s Anthem on Natura Viva is exactly what the name says. And we finish with Marie Vaunt and Space 92, Go Go Go on TAKEOFF, because sometimes the last three minutes just need to run.

The Midnight Project lands every week, same time, same place. No gaps, no reruns, 222 episodes and counting, and a community of Midnighters that keeps growing because you pass the show on to people who get it. Follow on your platform of choice and the new hour just shows up.

Tell me which track hit hardest. I read everything, and that is genuinely how I build these sets.

See you at midnight,

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.description:
Artist: Luke Hess Show: Luke Hess – Bassiani Podcast 326 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: September 1, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Luke Hess – Bassiani Podcast 326

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: September 1, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Born in 80s Detroit, Luke Hess grew up around the Motor City’s mythical warehouse parties, about as good a DJ origin story as you could hope for. His decade-spanning career has seen his purist production work find its voice on labels like Omar S’s FXHE and Carl Craig’s Planet E, and more recently a home on his self-run DeepLabs imprint, a channel for hope in a world that has it in short supply. His sets too are a demonstration of his tight mixing and faculty for layering rhythm, long-format stints that have graced the booth at clubs like Fabric (London), Unit (Tokyo), Bassment (Hong Kong) and Berghain. His continuing work as music producer and firebrand selector is focused on further sonic exploration, groove-centered and soulful techno true to his midwestern roots. Here for Bassiani Podcast 326, Hess shows his knack for beats once more: syncopated synths and driving basslines with his fingerprints all over them, a sharp selection of minimal rhythms flavoured by his many years in the field. Clocking in at an hour and a half, this latest installment is a testament to Hess’ keen instincts and skill on the decks, a deep exploration of techno in its more spiritual manifestations, boundary-pushing, mind-altering and body-moving percussions from a seasoned talent.

Bassiani Podcast

item.description:

Tracklist

# CASH ONLY steps up for the Data Transmission Podcast ahead of Love to be… Festival

CASH ONLY is heading to Harrogate this weekend, and before he lands at Love to be… Festival on Saturday 5th September, he takes control of the Data Transmission Podcast with a mix that moves freely through house, garage and everything sitting nicely between the two.

That freedom has always been a big part of his appeal. CASH ONLY came up through record shop culture in the late 90s, with jungle and UK garage pushing him towards his first set of decks. Since then, he has spent more than 25 years working across the industry as a DJ, promoter, producer, tour manager and label boss. His sets have developed the same breadth, mixing timeless records, unreleased weapons and his own edits without getting stuck in one lane.

This week’s podcast gets straight into it. Alaia & Gallo’s ‘Lipstick’ gets the Tony Romera treatment early doors before the mix runs through Solardo, Archie Hamilton, Route 94, Soulsearcher and Bushbaby & Danny P. There are plenty of exclusives in there too, including unreleased music from Jewel Kid & Wh0, Illyus Barrientos x Nesi and Capri x Denis Sulta.

CASH ONLY also brings a few of his own bits to the table. His G-Double-E edit of Fish Go Deep’s ‘The Cure and the Cause’ appears alongside a dubplate from Casnova and his forthcoming remix of Weiss’ ‘Feel My Needs’ with Ruejay.

That Weiss remix is a particularly big one for him. Arriving on Toolroom in September, it marks his first release for the label and sees him getting his hands on one of the catalogue’s best-known records. He also has a new release coming on Jewel Kid’s Alleanza, taking things into a bassier, garage-influenced house direction.

There is plenty happening away from the studio too. CASH ONLY’s recent run has taken in Glastonbury, Hï Ibiza, Studio 338, Ministry of Sound and Defected Festivals, and this weekend he joins the Love to be… Festival lineup at The Stray in Harrogate.

Love to be… returns with a 6,000-capacity crowd and three stages of house music, with Claptone, Paul Woolford, Sam Divine, David Penn, Mousse T, Todd Terry, Gok Wan and plenty more alongside CASH ONLY on the bill. As CASH ONLY puts it, the mix is “a journey across the spectrum of House and Garage”, and that pretty much nails it. Big records, quick turns, garage pressure, house grooves and enough unreleased material to keep the Shazams busy.

Turn it up, get stuck into the full mix below, and if you’re heading to Harrogate on Saturday, make sure you catch CASH ONLY at Love to be… Festival.

Data Transmission Podcast

Sanna Mun is a Berlin-based musician, DJ and live act, with releases on Clone’s Repetitive Rhythm Research, Modwerks, Token, K S R and her own label Katabasis. Spanning ambient and raw, hypnotic techno, her work explores repetition and resonance.

item.title: Dannic presents Fonk Monthly Mix 032
item.description:
Artist: Dannic Show: Dannic presents Fonk Monthly Mix 032 Serie: Dannic presents Fonk Monthly Mix Added: August 29, 2026 Genre: Electro , House

Show: Dannic presents Fonk Monthly Mix 032

Serie: Dannic presents Fonk Monthly Mix

Added: August 29, 2026

Genre: Electro , House

Tracklist

After his unmissable ‘Front of House’ radio show and podcast, Dannic takes his radio talents in a new, exciting direction with his fresh listening concept of Fonk Radio – continuing the groove with the funk-infused house music that Fonk Recordings is already admired for, as well as the hottest electronic hits in the scene today.

Episode 032 of the Fonk Monthly Mix delivers a relentless journey through big room and progressive house, anchored by Dannic originals, ID’s and collabs including “New Day,” “Round & Round,” “Gravity,” and the classic “Unstoppable” with Dyro. The mix is packed with standout moments like Hardwell’s 2026 bootleg of Prospa & Cloonee’s “Free Your Mind,” a massive Eric Prydz “Opus” bootleg, and a clever three-way mashup blending David Guetta, Axwell & Ingrosso, and BlackCode & Gaz Meeko. From melodic builds to dancefloor-destroying drops, this episode is pure Fonk energy from start to finish.

1. Swedish House Mafia & Lykke Li – Happiness Is So Sad (Extended Mix) 2. Kolter – Hey Everybody (Back In The Dance) (Extended Mix) 3. AVE – Meet Me In The Dark (Club Mix) 4. Oliver Heldens & Will Clarke – Lost In Music (Extended Mix) 5. Prospa & Cloonee – Free Your Mind (Hardwell 2026 Bootleg) 6. Gryffin, BUNT. & Inéz – World Away (Extended Mix) 7. Kryder – Oh My! (Extended Mix) 8. Lucas & Steve x Mike Bond – Be Like Bob (Extended Mix) 9. ID – New Day (Extended Mix) 10. Dannic – Round & Round (Extended Mix) 11. David Guetta & Third Party vs. Sophie Ellis-Baxtor – Hero vs. Murder On The Dancefloor (Fuerte & Josue Rodriguez Mashup) 12. BlackCode & Gaz Meeko vs. David Guetta vs. Axwell & Ingrosso – Take Me vs. I’m Good vs. More Than You Know (Dimitro Mashup) 13. Dannic – Gravity (Extended Mix) 14. Sir Ivan – Love Is The Piece (Dannic Extended Remix) 15. Eric Prydz – Opus (Trashock Bootleg) 16. Luvstruck x Leena Punks x Ethan – In My Heart (Extended Mix) 17. Dyro & Dannic – Unstoppable (Extended Mix)

Dannic presents Fonk Monthly Mix

item.title: Global DJ Broadcast – Markus Schulz and biskuwi
item.description:
Artist: biskuwi , Markus Schulz Show: Global DJ Broadcast – Markus Schulz and biskuwi Serie: Global DJ Broadcast Added: August 27, 2026 Genre: Trance

Show: Global DJ Broadcast – Markus Schulz and biskuwi

Serie: Global DJ Broadcast

Added: August 27, 2026

Genre: Trance

Tracklist

Direct from Ibiza as Markus Schulz commences his five-date open-to-close residency at Eden, Global DJ Broadcast presents a key preview of In Search of Sunrise 22: Nirvana, the second chapter of this year’s trilogy, arriving this Friday. Included is the premiere of Arctic Barbers’ New Dawn and a special Mike EFEX remix of First State’s eponymous anthem, alongside the Coldharbour debut of Nemke’s Final Flash. A key contributor to ISOS 22’s first Awakening presentation, Biskuwi joins the show for the guestmix. We hope you enjoy the Nirvana mix from Friday, and The Long Weekend Mix returns to GDJB next week for Labor Day.

The Essentials with Markus Schulz

01. Eco – Solo (Club Mix)

02. HERMEN – Subra

03. The Thrillseekers presents Hydra – Amber (Jerome Isma-Ae Remix)

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 221
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 221 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: August 26, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 221

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: August 26, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

The rooftop session at Tomorrowland was last night. Thank you to everyone who came up. That crowd made the last hour of the night feel like the room was playing itself, and a good part of what you hear this week is what worked up there while it was still warm.

We open on Drumcode. Volkoder and Korolova with “Waiting For You” sets the temperature straight away, no ceremony, just the pull. Tim Kollberg follows on Gain Records with “Pleasure State,” which is one of four Gain records in this episode. That was not a plan. It is just where the good stuff kept landing this month.

Then something a little sideways. Victor Ruiz took Liquid Soul and Captain Hook and pulled “Liquid Hook” out of psy territory and into something with real floor weight. It is the widest moment in the first half and it earns its place.

“Retriever” sits at fifteen minutes in. My own, named after the dog most of you have already met on Instagram. It has been in every set since I finished it and it keeps doing the same thing to a room, so it stays.

The middle of the show is where the groove takes over. Sisko Electrofanatik and Katerino go straight for the low end. Devid Dega on Second State brings the kind of old school devotion the title promises, and Jil Tanner keeps the pressure honest without ever raising her voice. Monika Kruse’s “Morgana” in Patrik Berg’s hands is the moment I would point a new listener to. It breathes.

From Norvis onward it climbs. Jay Lumen’s “Dance4Life” on Arcane is unapologetic peak time, digi.codes answers it with something colder and sharper, and Melvin Spix with TimeKube strip it back to exactly what is needed. That strip-back is the part I care most about. Give people less and they lean in.

Procombo’s “Unknown Force B” is the last hard turn before Franco Smith closes it out with “Anthem” on Natura Viva. Big title, and it holds up.

See you at midnight, Sebastiaan

item.description:
Artist: Jewel Kid Show: Data Transmission Podcast 967 – Jewel Kid Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: August 26, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 967 – Jewel Kid

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: August 26, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Jewel Kid lands on Data Transmission with a live mix recorded at Groove & Bass Festival in Quebec, Canada, arriving fresh from his ‘Explicit Behaviour’ EP on Radio Slave’s Rekids.

There’s something different about a mix caught in the middle of a festival rather than pieced together in the studio. This one comes straight from the floor, with Malta’s Jewel Kid taking control at Groove & Bass in Quebec and working through the kind of chunky house and tech house grooves that have kept him busy for more than two decades.

That experience runs deep. Jewel Kid has released across Toolroom, Alleanza, Glasgow Underground, Abode and Nervous, while his touring history includes Space Ibiza, Space Miami, Egg London, Cielo New York, Womb Tokyo and Sankeys Ibiza. He’s also a Carl Cox Worldwide Remix Competition winner, with multiple records landing inside Beatport’s Top 10.

The mix arrives just after his Rekids debut, ‘Explicit Behaviour’, released on 14th August. The three-track EP finds Jewel Kid leaning into big drums, analogue pressure and classic house touches, from the piano stabs and sirens of ‘Explicit Behaviour’ to the Chicago influence running through ‘In The Dance’ and the rolling tension of ‘The Tribute’.

Data Transmission Podcast

item.title: Nude Techno Podcast 220 – Jonas Xenon
item.description:
Artist: Jonas Xenon Show: Nude Techno Podcast 220 – Jonas Xenon Serie: Nude Techno Podcast Added: August 26, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Nude Techno Podcast 220 – Jonas Xenon

Serie: Nude Techno Podcast

Added: August 26, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Berlin’s Jonas Xenon takes control of the **NUDE Techno Podcast** today with 27 tracks of rolling, hypnotic techno built firmly for dark rooms and late hours-

Coming from a drum and bass background, Xenon’s music has always carried that sense of movement- The tempos may have changed, but the restless grooves, tight percussion and pressure are still there- Add his taste for old-school techno aesthetics and synth-led arrangements, and you get a sound that feels direct without being stuck in the past-

The special ingredient is the synth work- Rather than chasing big drops, Xenon keeps the tension moving through repeating lines, stripped drums and tracks that lock together properly- It is the sort of set that makes more sense the deeper you get into it-

His personal pick is **Machinegeist’s ‘Solid Shapes’**, forthcoming on Xenon’s own **Headlight Recordings**, while another Machinegeist cut, ‘Sensory Deprivation’, also makes an appearance-

The mix lands just after Xenon released his six-track **‘Shine Through Tinted Glass’ EP** on Headlight Recordings on 14th August- The record moves through dub-infused techno with a breakbeat detour and includes two collaborations with DAMIANO (DE)-

There is plenty more moving behind the scenes too- Xenon has two collaborative EPs with Michael Rosmann lined up for **Mouche Records** and **Headlight Recordings**, while work is underway on a first hybrid live set with Mython, due to premiere in Berlin this October- He has also just returned from New York, where he recorded his first hardware-only EP for **Blackcat Recordings**-

Nude Techno Podcast

item.description:
Artist: Bassiani , Danya Show: Danya – Bassiani Podcast 325 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: August 25, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Danya – Bassiani Podcast 325

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: August 25, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Patras native, Hamburg based DJ/producer Danya has been putting out sounds since 2017, bracing techno pushed to the limit. In her relatively short career she’s racked up residencies at Hamburg’s PAL and Bunker Club (Kiel) and toured extensively throughout Europe, sharing the decks with names like Rødhåd, Amotik, Setaoc Mass and Blanka. These days her time is split between a love of music and neuroscience research, a field in which her investigations into the auditory and perceptual have fueled her production work and further expanded the possibilities of her sound. Reaching towards new rhythmic formulations, the 6D. collective member brings a particular kind of feeling to her productions and sets, weaving futuristic frequencies together with a keen instinct for her crowd. In that vein, this next one stays true to the spirit of those peak-time adventures with a two-hour undertaking worthy of her output. A top-notch selection full to the hilt with percussive bangers and cunning beats that roll forward with sure and steady precision. Bassiani Podcast 325 is high-grade techno from a prolific and savvy innovator, plug in and let these rhythms do the rest.

Welcome to episode ninety-six of Noisetalgia! Today we pay tribute to one of the most influential record labels in UK dance history: Hooj Choons!

Established in 1990 by Red Jerry, Hooj Choons redefined progressive house and trance, releasing some of the most iconic club anthems of the 90s and early 2000s. This 90-minute retrospective features classics from Energy 52, Solarstone, Three Drives, Nalin & Kane, Lost Tribe, L.S.G., Lustral, and many more. Enjoy!

item.title: Balance Selections 380 – Diego Moreira
item.description:
Artist: Diego Moreira Show: Balance Selections 380 – Diego Moreira Serie: Balance Selections Added: August 23, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 380 – Diego Moreira

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: August 23, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Diego Moreira has spent more than a decade refining a strain of progressive house built on dark protocols. Since 2018, his releases have carried that approach well beyond his native Argentina, earning regular support across specialist radio, clubs and the wider progressive circuit.

Moreira’s music is defined less by obvious peaks than by the way it gets there- fluid, measured and always conscious of the journey.

On this Balance Selections, the Argentine delivers a set steeped in those same principles. Featuring music from Claudio Cornejo, Kyotto and Stas Drive, alongside a stack of unreleased material from Moreira himself, this is a proper journey into the more cerebral corners of progressive.

Balance Selections

Flug is the 501st guest of our original HATE Podcast series.

Flug has spent close to two decades in techno, with releases on CLR, Soma, MORD, Trip, Mutual Rytm and his own label Existentia.

For this episode he moves across the directions he’s playing and producing right now: dub techno, modern minimal, and classic techno. Recorded at his own studio, the mix maps the full range of the sound he’s built, and features a solid amount of his unreleased material.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 220
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 220 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: August 19, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 220

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: August 19, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

Episode 220 is here, and this one moves with purpose. We open deep and hypnotic, then build steadily into the kind of driving groove that defines the peak hours. Along the way there is a proper surprise: a remastered take on a nineties classic that some of you will recognise from the very first bars. Hearing it reworked with today’s production standards, sitting comfortably next to brand new records, reminds me why this music keeps pulling us back.

The second half leans harder. Rolling percussion, big rooms, open eyes. If you are listening on a Wednesday night drive or deep into a late session, this stretch is for you.

Thank you for being here every week. Two hundred and twenty episodes only happens because you keep showing up. See you on the dance floor.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Ben Klock is the 500th guest of our original HATE Podcast series.

To mark HATE’s 500th episode, Ben Klock steps in. A defining force in techno for over two decades, his work across Berghain, Klockworks, and PHOTON has consistently shaped the language of the genre, both in the booth and beyond it.

For this milestone edition, Ben shifts focus away from peak-time club tropes, pivoting from claps and functional dynamics toward a deeper, more fluid, and hypnotic narrative.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 219
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 219 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: August 12, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 219

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: August 12, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters, this hour is for you.

Last week you showed up in numbers that still make me smile, and the best way I know to say thank you is to raise the bar again. So this week we go deep into Drumcode territory. Pan-Pot’s Diamonds Head sets the pace on Mobilee, then Adam Beyer takes over the first quarter of the hour twice in a row. Alto with Layton Giordani is rave kissed and written in a major key, built from the same vocal source as The Orb’s Little Fluffy Clouds, and Let Loose with DJ Jock keeps that Drumcode drive rolling straight into Freak Your Mind on Truesoul.

Around the halfway point, I slipped in one of my own. Retriever is my new track, named after the four-legged member of this household, and it sits between the warm groove of Chemistry by Dhuna and Pablo Say and the low-end pressure of Feel My Bass. From there, Jay Lumen and DJ Jordan push the tempo before 6 SENSE tells you exactly what to do with Say It.

The final stretch goes big. Free My Soul, the brand new collaboration between Vini Vici, Space 92 and CERES on Armada, dropped only days ago and already feels like a festival closer. Psytrance energy, techno drums, one soaring vocal. I follow it with the Olly James rework of Cosmic Gate’s Exploration Of Space, a classic reborn, then land the hour with Disco Move and Strange Days.

The Midnight Project lands every week, same time, same place. No gaps, no reruns, over 200 episodes and counting, and a community of Midnighters that keeps growing because you share the show with people who get it. Follow on your favorite platform and the new hour just shows up.

If one track in this episode moves you, tell me which one. I read everything, and that is how I build these sets.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Welcome to episode ninety-five of Noisetalgia! Today we take a deep dive into the catalog of one of progressive music’s most influential duos: Way Out West (Nick Warren & Jody Wisternoff).

item.title: Terminal V Podcast 123 – GALLØ
item.description:
Artist: Gallo Show: Terminal V Podcast 123 – GALLØ Serie: terminal-v Added: August 7, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Terminal V Podcast 123 – GALLØ

Serie: terminal-v

Added: August 7, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Terminal V was the first festival that GALLØ ever went to, and was the first place he heard one of his own tracks being played. Back in April, he played for the first time and opened one of the main stages in a way that truly announced his arrival on the scene. Since then, he has played all across the UK and Europe and continues to be a favourite artist of EXHALE boss Amelie Lens, who released his first-ever tune.

The Scottish artist has a sound that sits at the intersection of hard techno, acid, bounce and trance, always with neon colours and future sound designs that take you into a parallel world. All of that is laid out on his punchy, vibrant mix for us this week, with plenty of unreleased material of his own sat next to the likes of Charlotte De Witte, MXGN and Alignment. Tune in while you get the lowdown on his journey so far.

item.title: Global DJ Broadcast – World Tour: Avalon, Los Angeles – Summer 2026
item.description:
Artist: Markus Schulz Show: Global DJ Broadcast – World Tour: Avalon, Los Angeles – Summer 2026 Serie: Global DJ Broadcast Added: August 6, 2026 Genre: Trance

Show: Global DJ Broadcast – World Tour: Avalon, Los Angeles – Summer 2026

Serie: Global DJ Broadcast

Added: August 6, 2026

Genre: Trance

Tracklist

Few venues have played a bigger role in Markus Schulz’s career than Avalon in Los Angeles, a place he has proudly called home for countless open to close journeys over the years. The latest Global DJ Broadcast World Tour relives highlights from his recent return, while also offering another glimpse into the musical world of the newly released In Search of Sunrise 22 Mix 1: The Awakening, with several selections from the compilation finding their place within the night’s journey. Blending exclusives, new favorites and timeless classics, it’s another memorable chapter from one of dance music’s most cherished club homes.

In Search of Sunrise 22 Mix 1: The Awakening is out now.

Tracklist

Dance TV is proud to present Dance TV DJ Mix #679 with the Ibiza/Düsseldorf-based music professional, DJ, producer and radio host Miss Luna. A longtime ambassador of Ibiza’s electronic music culture, she is the founder of Ibiza Live Radio and has spent more than two decades shaping the island’s sound through her work as a DJ, producer, composer, and curator. For this exclusive recording, Miss Luna delivers an elegant journey through deep tech, organic house and techno – warm, flowing and emotionally rich, with refined grooves and seamless transitions that invite you to settle in and enjoy the ride. Press play!

Miss Luna is a DJ, producer, composer, and creative visionary whose journey has been deeply intertwined with Ibiza’s electronic music culture for more than two decades. Originally trained in design, she found her true artistic language behind the decks, relocating to Ibiza in 2001 where she began developing the distinctive sound that has since become her signature.

Blending deep tech, organic house, and techno with elegance and emotion, Miss Luna has cultivated a style that is both refined and deeply immersive. As a producer, she collaborates with international artists and labels, while her work as a composer has expanded into film, including the original score for the ARTE documentary Mythos Ibiza.

In 2013, she founded Ibiza Live Radio, the island’s pioneering 24/7 electronic music station, helping establish it as one of Ibiza’s most influential platforms for underground electronic music. Over the following eight years, she shaped its musical direction, introducing listeners around the world to both established artists and emerging talent.

Beyond music, Miss Luna continues to explore the creative spirit of Ibiza through her acclaimed book Ibiza Heartbeat – 20 Years on the Island of Dreams, a personal reflection on life, art, and the enduring magic of the White Isle. Whether in the studio, behind the decks, or through her wider creative work, she remains dedicated to crafting experiences that are authentic, inspiring, and emotionally resonant.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 218
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 218 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: August 4, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 218

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: August 4, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters, last week I told you we are bringing the groove back to Ibiza. Then Friday happened. The rooftop filled up, the sun went down over Playa d’en Bossa, and a lot of you told me you came through the show. That is the whole point of this project, and episode 218 picks up exactly where that night left off.

We open with Per Hammar’s “Shuriken” on Natura Viva Black. Sharp, stripped, straight into the pocket. Yes, that label again. Three weeks running now they have earned a spot in the show, and this one shows why. Victor Ruiz and Kaufmann follow with “Don’t Mess With Us” on VOLTA, a collaboration that sounds exactly as confident as the title suggests.

The middle of the hour is where it gets physical. JLuna’s “Emergency SEQ,” Teenage Mutants’ “Conflicted Mind,” and A.D.H.S. back for the second week in a row, this time with “Eos” on DCLTD. Then Pan-Pot land “Futoreno” on Second State, and right after it comes my favorite moment of the episode: Mark Broom’s remix of “Tropical Melons” by 2000 And One on Rekids. A Dutch classic, rebuilt by one of the UK’s finest. I have loved this record since my Amsterdam years, and hearing it come back around like this made my week.

The back half runs from the YellowHeads’ peak mode “Reboot.exe” into Giorgia Angiuli’s “Light” on Terminal M, the melodic breath of the hour. Ilona Maras keeps it honest with “Don’t Pretend,” and JSPR closes on We Are The Brave with “Japan Air.”

And if you are on the island: I am back on the rooftop next Friday for Tomorrowland Rooftop Sessions Ibiza. Same foundation as this show. Groove first, sunset into darkness, no filler. Episode 218 is your warm-up.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Richard Akingbehin – Bassiani Podcast 322
item.description:
Artist: Richard Akingbehin Show: Richard Akingbehin – Bassiani Podcast 322 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: August 4, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Richard Akingbehin – Bassiani Podcast 322

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: August 4, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

British-Nigerian DJ and curator Richard Akingbehin is the co-founder of Berlin-based radio station Refuge Worldwide, and the founder of techno, dub and experimental label Kynant Records. His sets draw from the sonic innovations of Jamaican and UK sound system culture, using the heavy basslines and spatial effects of dub to guide his hallmark sound. Rolling atmospherics and pulsating rhythms are the order of the day, locked in tunes from the depths of the dancefloor. Appearances at Dekmantel, Draaimolen, Organik and Panorama Bar are standard issue for Akingbehin, but the weight of Refuge Worldwide is perhaps one of his most enduring contributions to the electronic music landscape. Broadcasting 24/7 from its Neukölln home, the community-focused radio station has brought together countless talents and worked in solidarity with refugee housing associations, marginalized groups and homelessness agencies, and left an indelible mark on the German capital. Behind the decks, all of his curatorial heft and cultural focus distils into something visceral, patient, purposeful and heavy where it counts. For Bassiani Podcast 323, the Berlin lynchpin delivers a racing three-hour dub ensemble recorded as part of the Eerste Communie night in early May, soft to the touch and quick on the pulse.

Bassiani Podcast

Expect emotional builds, hypnotic rhythms, and high-energy drops a musical trip where every track has a purpose, and every moment is designed to capture you.

Serie: terminal-v

Added: July 31, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Zurich-born, self-taught and self-made, Jasmin Fumagalli aka Jazzy, has never chased trends, and it shows. From underground raves to genre-fluid sets spanning hard techno, harderstyles and trap, her sound – and her striking stage presence – is built entirely on instinct rather than imitation. With releases coming via Zentryc Records and a relentless 2026 tour schedule taking in Tomorrowland, Creamfields and beyond, Jazzy’s star continues to rise.

item.title: Mees Salomé – Distant 109
item.description:
Artist: Mees Salomé Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 109 Serie: Distant Added: July 31, 2026 Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 109

Serie: Distant

Added: July 31, 2026

Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Tracklist

There are moments when I look around and see people from different countries, different cultures, different backgrounds, all dancing to the same melodies and sharing the same feeling. Music is such a strange and beautiful thing. It doesn’t really care where you’re from or what language you speak. Somehow it finds a way to connect us anyway. To create a space where, for a little while, complete strangers become part of the same story.

The fact that music allows me to experience this around the world, and with so many different people, is something I’ll never get my head around. No matter where I am, that sense of connection always feels the same. That’s what made me fall in love with music, and it still does.

Thank you for making this scene what it is. Thank you for welcoming me wherever I go, for listening, for dancing, and for sharing these moments with me. I feel unbelievably lucky to be a small part of it.

Here’s this month’s episode. Hope you enjoy ❤

Distant

item.title: Balance Selections 379 – Agustin Ficarra
item.description:
Artist: Unknown

Show: Balance Selections 379 – Agustin Ficarra Serie: Balance Selections Added: July 31, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: July 31, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Originally from Buenos Aires, Agustín Ficarra developed an early connection to music through Argentina’s diverse band culture. That background continues to shape a sound rooted in house and its various offshoots.

After establishing himself in the electronic music scene as a DJ, he began producing in 2020. His collaboration with Kabi resulted in the Let You Go EP on Balance Music, with its second track, ‘Keep You Close’ featured in this mix. It forms part of a growing discography that regularly receives support from leading figures across the scene.

On this Balance Selections, Ficarra delvers a 70 min plus mix filled with South American character. Featuring tracks from Polo, Scippo, Nacho Lopez and others, it offers an impressive showcase of both his curatorial instincts and Argentina’s wider influence on the electronic music scene.

Balance Selections

The show includes Coldharbour world premieres from ReDub and Tim Clark, alongside fresh offerings from Giuseppe Ottaviani & Billy Gillies, Sasha, Nicky Elisabeth, Estiva and Frankyeffe. item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 217
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 217 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: July 29, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 217

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: July 29, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters, this one is built on groove.

It is late July on the island. The nights barely cool down and everything I play out here lately has that rolling, physical quality. Episode 217 came together with that in mind.

We open with a KASIA double: “No Competition” with Equinøx on Arcane, then “The Realm,” her Drumcode collaboration with Layton Giordani. After that it breathes. Pablo Say’s “I’m a Dreamer” is the melodic moment of the hour. If you write in about one track this week, my money is on this one.

Then the groove takes over. A.D.H.S. on DCLTD, RHAPSODIE’s “Void,” and a middle stretch with four Natura Viva Black records, the second week running the label lands that many in the show. Pig&Dan’s “Aptitude” is my pick of the four. Play this section loud. Monika Kruse’s “Latex” on Terminal M anchors the back half, KENZ’s “Blade” brings the Drumcode peak, and JJ Mullor and Gombok Project close with “Grooveaholic.” Fitting title.

And if you are on the island this week: I am playing Friday at Tomorrowland Rooftop Sessions Ibiza. This is the music from the show, played live, open air, sunset into night. Come say hi.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Tracklist

Welcome to episode ninety-four. Today we pay tribute to one of the most influential record labels in electronic music history: Paul Oakenfold’s legendary Perfecto Records.

Founded in 1989, Perfecto transformed club culture and became the ultimate gold standard for progressive, trance, and goa sounds throughout the 90s and early 2000s. This episode is a 90-minute historical retrospective featuring 23 timeless classics and remixes from BT, Grace, Tilt, Timo Maas, Man With No Name, PPK, Transa, Scot Project, and many more.

item.description:
Artist: Paula Koski Show: Paula Koski – HATE Podcast 497 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: July 26, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Paula Koski – HATE Podcast 497

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: July 26, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Built around deep, powerful and mysterious atmospheres, this mix brings together music I’ve been enjoying playing at recent gigs. It moves through hypnotic textures, rolling energy and moments of intensity, with a few dubby moments along the way. The selection features tracks from my recent sets alongside upcoming and unreleased music from myself and some of my favourite producers.

Finnish-born, Berlin-based Paula Koski explores the space between hypnotic and driving techno, shaping her sets with a strong sense of tension, movement and flow.

Founder of the INTERLINK event series in Helsinki, she is known for her carefully crafted peak-time and closing sets. Her releases include Soma Records and a collaborative double EP with Justine Perry on Ostgut Ton.

HATE Podcast

item.description:
Artist: Chicane Show: Chicane – Sun:Sets 600 Serie: Sets Added: July 24, 2026 Genre: Downtempo , Organic House , Progressive House

Show: Chicane – Sun:Sets 600

Serie: Sets

Added: July 24, 2026

Genre: Downtempo , Organic House , Progressive House

Tracklist

This week’s 600th edition of Sun:Sets is an antidote to our fast moving world and attention economy, as we play some EPIC masterpieces and classic dance tracks in their entirety. It features only 7 tracks, but played from the first beat to the last, as the artist intended – showing that electronic music can be just as emotional, intelligent and technical as any piece of classical music if you give it the space to breathe..

1. Andrew Bayer – End Of All Things feat. Alison May 2. Stina Nordenstam – Little Star 3. Faithless – Salva Mea 4. Bassheads – Is There Anybody Out There 5. Sasha – Xpander (12” Remastered Version) 6. BT – Flaming June (BT and PvD Mix) 7. Underworld – Dark And Long (Dark Train Mix)

He showcases Dive on the show this week alongside offerings from Matt Fax, Das Pharaoh, Ciaran McAuley and ilan Bluestone. item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 216
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 216 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: July 22, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 216

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: July 22, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

Four Natura Viva Black records in one hour. That was not the plan when I started digging this week, but the label is on a run right now and it shows. Daniele Papini’s Hidden Source opens the show, AKKI and Kaspar hold the middle with Horizon, and DJ Dextro closes everything down with Unbalance. When one imprint bookends your whole set, you pay attention.

In between, Drumcode does what Drumcode does. Rafael Cerato and Charles D bring Right Now, a track I have been hearing everywhere this summer, and Mark Reeve drops a tool called Work that is exactly that: no frills, all function. Listen also for the two Arcane cuts back to back around the halfway mark. KASIA and Shalev called their track I Like It Raw, and after Linska and Duss set it up with Criminal, raw is precisely what you get.

The stretch from Sophie van Hayden’s The Void into Ignacio Arfeli and Tommahawk’s The Unknown is my favorite moment this week. Two titles about darkness and uncertainty, and somehow the most hypnotic ten minutes of the hour.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 215
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 215 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: July 15, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 215

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: July 15, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

We open with Achilles, fresh off the Panic release that Thomas Schumacher and A.D.H.S. dropped on Electric Ballroom last Friday. Four days old and already setting the tone for this hour: Berlin drive, no warm-up, straight in.

From there it keeps rolling. Anna Reusch on Tronic, Pan-Pot with Gray Cosmo on their own Second State, and a Peak Mode mix from YellowHeads that does exactly what the name promises. Listen for the vocal in Linska’s Four Four, rhys from the sticks gives the middle of this set an unexpected human moment before Norvis pulls everything back into the dark.

The last twenty minutes are pure engine room. Dok & Martin’s Generator on DCLTD, Rich Coote’s Thunderbird, and DJ Jordan closing with a track called Big Beautiful Bass. He is not lying.

The Midnight Project lands every week, same time, same place. No gaps, no reruns, over 200 episodes and counting. Follow the show on your favorite platform and you never have to think about it again, the new hour just shows up.

If one track in this episode moves you, tell me which one. That is how I build these sets.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 965 – Kyle Kinch
item.description:
Artist: Kyle Kinch Show: Data Transmission Podcast 965 – Kyle Kinch Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: July 14, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 965 – Kyle Kinch

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: July 14, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Kyle Kinch steps into the Data Transmission Podcast for the first time this week, bringing a mix packed with rolling house pressure, sharp club selections and a serious amount of unreleased music.

Kinch has spent years carving out a sound that sits somewhere between house, disco and techno, always tied together by groove. Jazz and disco remain at the root of what he does, but his records are built for proper rooms. That approach has taken him onto Gorgon City’s Realm Records, Sonny Fodera’s Solotoko, Nervous and EMI, with support from CamelPhat, FISHER and David Guetta along the way.

He was the first artist outside Gorgon City themselves to release on Realm, with his ‘Manchester’ EP helping establish the sound that has since carried him through Ultra Music Festival, Printworks, Brooklyn Mirage, Tobacco Dock and EDC. Add a Duke Dumont remix and sets alongside Claude VonStroke, Kaskade, Chris Lake and Gorgon City, and the picture is fairly clear. Kinch knows how to work a dancefloor.

The mix reflects that. Pietro Pellizzari opens proceedings before Kinch quickly starts dipping into his own vault. There are five solo Kyle Kinch IDs in here, alongside unreleased cuts from KC Gilmore and Drew Pree, My Friend, Alex Mills and more. Wh0, OFFAIAH, Ammo Avenue, Kepler, Boss Priester, Flashmob and Jack Marlow keep the energy moving between chunky house, swung drums and late-night low end.

There is also ‘Pressure’, Kinch’s collaboration with OFFAIAH, plus ‘TR8’ with KC Gilmore and Drew Pree. Released on Walker & Royce’s Rules Don’t Apply, ‘TR8’ is built around deep sub pressure, loose drums and the kind of swing that keeps a room moving without trying too hard. The three friends started the record while jamming on TR-8s, and that shared studio chemistry runs right through it.

Turn it up and get stuck in.

Data Transmission Podcast

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: July 10, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Based in Barcelona, Makebo crafts immersive journeys through organic and progressive house, balancing hypnotic grooves with rich atmospheres. Co-founder of the Rubicunda label alongside Amonita, he has brought his story-driven approach to dancefloors across Europe, the Americas and Ibiza, where his patient, groove-led sets have become a defining signature.

On this Balance Selections mix, the producer highlights his finely tuned ear, favouring cohesive track selection. Featuring music from Tim Green, Hernán Cattaneo & Khen, alongside a host of Makebo originals—including his forthcoming Balance Music release—the mix is an expertly crafted journey through organic and progressive house.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 214
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 214 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: July 8, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 214

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: July 8, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

Three days after the midyear special, we are back to regular programming. No looking back this time, just one hour on where techno is heading in the second half of 2026.

This episode opens on Truesoul and works its way through Terminal M, Drumcode Limited, and Arcane before landing somewhere darker. Listen for the acid line in Arielle Free’s Acid Love; it cuts through the middle of this mix like a knife. And Chris Avantgarde’s Jester might be the most cinematic six minutes I have played all year.

The closer is my own track Paws. Yes, it was in yesterday’s best-of, too. It is out now, and I stand behind it, so this week it gets the last word.

New episode every week. If one track in this hour moves you, tell me which one. That is how I build these sets.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Tracklist

Genghis Don is a Chicago-based DJ and electronic musician rooted in house, drum and bass, Detroit techno, and electro. A longtime vinyl collector, his sound is shaped by dark, machine-funk traditions of The Hague and Rotterdam labels such as Clone, Bunker, Viewlexx, and Creme Organization. In 2024, he released two EPs – Permutations and XY-FI – exploring a lo-fi, hardware-driven blend of electro, acid, and house. His mixes are bass-heavy, high-energy, and narrative in nature, unfolding as otherworldly sonic journeys where precision meets physicality and his human touch remains front and center.

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: July 6, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

With a DIY ethos front and center, Deano is a South African DJ, producer, and label owner whose sound is shaped by a thoroughly diverse musical background and early immersion in local nightlife culture. From house to techno and the interesting spaces in between, his sonic identity drifts seamlessly through high-velocity rhythms and deep, driving textures. His uncompromising energy has cemented his role as a staple of the South African underground, where he holds a long-standing residency at Cape Town’s Mødular Club and frequently commands the floor for Johannesburg’s legendary TOY TOY crew. Beyond DJing, his fully self-run label, Knowledge Imprint, has released music from emerging global talent since 2018 and is responsible for debuting many of these artists in his hometown (often in collaboration with VAULT—a Cape Town collective for whom he also holds a residency). He’s released a number of records via labels like Hayes, Hardgroove, Symbolism, and Sungate, with remixes in tow from the likes of Mark Broom, Luke Hess, Tripeo, Deniro, and more. His peak-hour sets are often anthemic, furiously poised, and sonically fluid, blurring the line between palpable spirit and mechanical force. For Bassiani Podcast 317, the South African stalwart brings his unremitting grooves to the airwaves, tuning into his trademark fusion of dark, alchemic beats with the precise focus of a seasoned techno talent.

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 964 – Illyus Barrientos
item.description:
Artist: Illyus & Barrientos Show: Data Transmission Podcast 964 – Illyus Barrientos Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: July 6, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 964 – Illyus Barrientos

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: July 6, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Illyus Barrientos is back on Toolroom with MALU for ‘Right Here’, and he joins us this week for the Data Transmission Podcast.

The new single lands with proper intent. Big drums, a heavy bassline and a vocal that knows exactly where it wants to be, right in the middle of the room. It follows Illyus’ recent run of club-ready cuts including ‘Never Let You Go’ with MK, ‘People’s PRTY’ and ‘Deep Down’, which dropped on Toolroom back in January.

MALU makes her Toolroom debut here too, arriving with serious heat from Brazil after appearances at Tomorrowland, Green Valley and more. Not a bad first stamp on the label, then.

Illyus has long been one of those names you trust when the record needs to work. Releases on Toolroom, Defected, Glasgow Underground, Love & Other and Nervous Records tell their own story, while support from Carl Cox, Chris Lake, Hot Since 82, FISHER, Sam Divine, Mark Knight and Armand Van Helden puts him in very good company.

He has also turned in official remixes for Armand Van Helden, Duke Dumont, Dom Dolla, Purple Disco Machine, Calvin Harris and Sonny Fodera, alongside sets at Fabric, The Warehouse Project, Printworks, Hï Ibiza, Ushuaïa, CRSSD and Splash House. Add in a BBC Radio 1 Essential Mix, Toolroom Radio hosting duties and his A&R role at Electronic Nature, and you’ve got someone who knows records from every angle.

For this week’s podcast, Illyus keeps it moving. His own cuts sit alongside DJ Romain, Danny Howard, Prunk, Airwolf Paradise, William Kiss and DJ Gant-Man, with plenty of bounce, swing and late-night pressure throughout. House music built for basements, festival tents and those sweaty rooms where the kick drum does most of the talking.

Lock in below and catch Illyus Barrientos and MALU’s ‘Right Here’ on Toolroom now.

Data Transmission Podcast

item.description:
