Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Dance TV is proud to present Dance TV DJ Mix #677 with Detroit’s own DJ, producer and label owner Mister Joshooa. A cornerstone of the city’s underground for more than two decades, he has helped shape Detroit’s electronic music landscape through his productions, acclaimed DJ sets, releases on labels such as Planet E, Life and Death and 20:20 Vision, and his longstanding role as Music Director of the legendary TV Lounge. For this exclusive vinyl only recording, Mister Joshooa delivers a deep, groove-driven journey through house and techno, blending timeless Detroit soul with impeccable selections and effortless mixing that remind us why the city’s sound continues to inspire dancefloors around the world.

@misterjoshooa Mister Joshooa is one of Detroit’s most respected underground DJs, producers, and tastemakers, with more than two decades dedicated to the city’s ever-evolving electronic music culture. From intimate warehouse parties to internationally renowned clubs and festivals, he has built a reputation for uncompromising selections, impeccable technique, and an unwavering commitment to the dancefloor.

As a producer, Mister Joshooa has released music on influential labels including Planet E, Life and Death, 20:20 Vision, Party Store Records, and Infolines, alongside a number of sought-after independent projects. His productions reflect the same depth, character, and musical curiosity that define his DJ sets.

A regular at Detroit’s legendary Movement Festival, Mister Joshooa has long been an integral part of the city’s musical identity. Beyond the booth, he served as General Manager and Music Director of TV Lounge from 2007 until 2023, helping establish the venue as one of Detroit’s most important homes for underground electronic music.

Whether performing, producing, or shaping the scene behind the scenes, Mister Joshooa represents the enduring spirit of Detroit: authentic, soulful, minimal, and deeply rooted in the culture. His passion for discovering, collecting, and sharing exceptional music continues to make him one of the city’s most trusted selectors.

Added: July 5, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Regis is the 494th guest of our original Hate Podcast series.

For our latest podcast episode, we are honored to host a true pioneer of underground electronic music: Regis. As the co-founder of the seminal Downwards Records and a key architect of the gritty “Birmingham sound,” Karl O’Connor has been a defining force in the industrial and drone-infused techno scene since the early 1990s. Known both for his fierce solo material and legendary projects like British Murder Boys and Sandwell District, he delivers a masterclass in raw sound pressure and uncompromising, loop-driven energy.

This episode features a relentless DJ set recorded with or without the kind permission of Regis, at Freedom Festival in Medellin, Colombia. Hit play for a masterclass in raw sound pressure and uncompromising, loop-driven energy.

HATE Podcast

item.title: Terminal V Podcast 120 – KLOUD
item.description:
Artist: Kloud Show: Terminal V Podcast 120 – KLOUD Serie: terminal-v Added: July 3, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Terminal V Podcast 120 – KLOUD

Serie: terminal-v

Added: July 3, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

KLOUD is a perfect alias for an artist whose take on hard techno has an ominous presence that looms larger over any dance floor he plays. The enigmatic American shares very little personal detail online, instead offering up only his cinematic blend of techno, electro and industrial-tinged house, all wrapped in the mystique of his masked persona.

This summer, he joins us at Terminal V Croatia, where he will again cast his spell, a taste of which you can get in this exclusive mix, which is packed full of fresh, hard-hitting and uncompromising sound that’s earned him a global following. We caught up with him to talk about the state of techno in the US versus Europe, why he only plays his own productions, the freedom his anonymous identity affords him, and how an ear injury has changed the way he performs.

terminal-v

Tracklist

Markus Schulz presents The Long Weekend Mix for Independence Day 2026 – a two-hour journey inspired by the universal themes of freedom, discovery, possibility and reflection. Built around the feeling of midsummer glow, this immersive DJ mix weaves together music from the present, the future, and a few unexpected places in between. Guided by the philosophy of where meaning matters, it unfolds through open horizons, golden hours and moments designed to stay with you long after the final track has played.

Dedicated to the people of Venezuela following the devastating earthquakes that impacted so many lives, this mix is a reminder of the power of music to bring us together, from New York to Los Angeles and wherever this music may find you around the world.

item.description:
Artist: Running Hot Show: Running Hot – Bassiani Podcast 316 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: June 30, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Running Hot – Bassiani Podcast 316

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: June 30, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Berlin based DJ/Producer Running Hot brings the spirit of summer to the Bassiani Podcast with a three hour, forty-five minute studio recording packed with breezy house. At a fresh 13 years old the native welshman’s intro to electronic music came in the form of rave tapes given to him by a school friend, and from there it was only up. A little older, he set up shop in London where he built a name for himself as versatile selector and resident at The Cause, before relocating to Germany where his talents have since found maximum latitude. His debut EP The Hardest Step Is Always First came out to critical acclaim in 2022, a stepping stone to further releases on labels like Certain Music, Permanent Vacation and Love on the Rocks. His upcoming release on self-titled imprint Running Hot Recordings It’s Best Not to Think About It (out June 12th), also promises to be a heavy-hitting drop run through with more of his infectious beats. Threaded into his sound are moments of 90s progressive house, Italo and sun-bleached disco that find their home as much at venues like Panorama Bar, Tresor and Fabric as on a golden hour rooftop steeped in love and good energy. For Bassiani Podcast 316, Running Hot brings the heat: house perfection, radiant grooves from a four-to-the-floor champion.

Bassiani Podcast

After his unmissable ‘Front of House’ radio show and podcast, Dannic takes his radio talents in a new, exciting direction with his fresh listening concept of Fonk Radio – continuing the groove with the funk-infused house music that Fonk Recordings is already admired for, as well as the hottest electronic hits in the scene today.

Episode 030 of Fonk Monthly Mix – June 2026

Episode 030 of Fonk Monthly Mix is a high-energy journey through big room and progressive house, packed with euphoric drops and dancefloor-ready anthems. Dannic showcases an impressive run of originals including “I’ll Be There For You,” “Gravity,” “Chasing Freedom,” and the emotional “Last Forever” with Blackcode & David Allen, alongside a slick mashup of “You’ve Got The Love vs. Reload.” Standout moments include MEDUZA’s “Don’t Wanna Go Home” in a private extended mix, Axwell’s “Whatever Turns You On,” and a hard-hitting closer with Afrojack’s “No Beef” in the &friends Remix.

June is here and Ibiza season is in full swing. The island’s legendary pre parties are back and things are heating up at Café Mambo.

Each night, the Sunset Strip comes alive with an incredible lineup of guest DJs, all bringing their own signature sound, while the residents keep the Balearic spirit flowing from sunset well into the night.

This month’s show features brand new music from Roog, Gonzhu, Earth n Days, and Café Mambo resident Dayl among others. Plus, this month’s guest mix comes courtesy of Dutch DJ and producer Easttown.

We are Café Mambo… We are Ibiza!

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 212
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 212 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: June 24, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 212

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: June 24, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

What a week. Friday on the Tomorrowland rooftop with Lilly Palmer was everything I hoped it would be. The terrace filled as the sun dropped, the energy built hour by hour, and handing the night over to Lilly was one of those moments that stays with you. Thank you to everyone who came through, said hi, and made it what it was. Nights like that are why I do this.

This week’s show carries some of that same weight. It opens with HI-LO and Saint Joshua before Oliver Huntemann brings Brutal on Senso Sounds. There’s Pan-Pot on Second State, Sam Paganini on his own JAM label, and Simina Grigoriu on Drumcode. I close the hour with Planetary Assault Systems in an Adam Beyer and Wehbba remix, a proper way to bring it home.

Which moment catches you? Drop the timestamp in the comments, I read every one. That back-and-forth, week after week, is what makes this more than a radio show. It is a room we keep building together.

Midnight never sleeps. See you next Wednesday.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 962 – Deltech
item.description:
Artist: Deltech Show: Data Transmission Podcast 962 – Deltech Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: June 23, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 962 – Deltech

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: June 23, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Deltech are back in the building.

The Midlands duo return to the Data Transmission Podcast this week with a mix built for proper dancefloor movement, landing just as they line up their third release on Jamie Jones’ Hot Creations.

Their new single ‘Voices’ drops on 10th July 2026, following previous label outings ‘I Don’t Need That’ and ‘Funkk’. It is another strong step from a pair who have been putting in serious work, with multiple Beatport #1s, over 10 million streams in the past year, and releases on Sola, Moxy Musik, Nervous Records, Repopulate Mars and plenty more.

Their sound has travelled well too. Deltech productions have found their way into sets at DC10, Ushuaia, Amnesia, Printworks, fabric, Creamfields, The Warehouse Project and Elrow, with support from Jamie Jones, John Summit, Marco Carola, Solardo, Richie Hawtin, Hannah Wants, Riva Star and Steve Lawler.

This week’s mix keeps things rolling, with ‘Voices’ sitting right in the thick of it alongside fresh cuts from Joey London Style, Proudly People, Gaza (UK), Riordan and a healthy dose of Deltech’s own club gear.

Low-end pressure, sharp grooves, peak-time bounce and enough swing to keep the room moving.

Get stuck into Deltech in the mix, and keep an ear out for ‘Voices’ landing on Hot Creations this July.

But before pressing play, I want to take a moment to say thank you. Thanks to all of you, ON AIR has now surpassed an incredible milestone: 107,000 downloads.

What started as a passion project has become a global community of music lovers, and none of this would be possible without your support, your listens, your messages, and your energy week after week.

For Edition 303, I’ve prepared another exclusive journey filled with the sounds that are inspiring me right now. Deep grooves, emotional moments and dancefloor energy from start to finish.

Thank you for being part of this adventure.

on-air-with-anna-tur

item.title: DJ TOOL – Bassiani Podcast 315
item.description:
Artist: Dj Tool Show: DJ TOOL – Bassiani Podcast 315 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: June 23, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: DJ TOOL – Bassiani Podcast 315

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: June 23, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Danish-born, Berlin-based DJ TOOL returns to Bassiani for another dose of frenzy. His trance-inflected selections are a defining feature of his evolving sonic palette: psychedelic, high-impact rhythms par for the course. Spanning earlier influences like punk, metal and noise, as well as newer inspirations from a more purist techno realm, his recall for sounds is unmatched, with years of digging, dancing and vinyl-focused practice forming a bold identity through his ongoing work. As an early affiliate of Copenhagen’s Fast Forward crew and co-founder of Berlin-based collective and event series Mala Junta, he’s played a pivotal role in recontextualizing trance and breakneck beats for a new generation, with queer perspectives and inclusivity at their core. His extended sets push persistently onward, stretching over many hours and balancing an equally driven fervour with steady pacing and flow. Serpentine rhythms that coil and morph through dense and layered structures, DJ TOOL channels meticulous technical accuracy and equally fine-tuned instincts via XL format compositions. For Bassiani Podcast 315, the Danish selector throws down yet another long-form exploration of his signature output. A hefty six-hour run through mutant grooves and unstoppable clubfloor momentum from a techno heavyweight recorded live at Bassiani.

Bassiani Podcast

item.title: Terminal V Podcast 118 – Dr. G
item.description:
Artist: Dr. G Show: Terminal V Podcast 118 – Dr. G Serie: terminal-v Added: June 19, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Terminal V Podcast 118 – Dr. G

Serie: terminal-v

Added: June 19, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Dr. G is on a roll. The Brussels-based artist has weaponised grooves not just to blow up dance floors, but as a way to stir up emotions. He plays hard and fast but always with meaning and a signature bass sound that unites everything he does. Though he wears his 90s and 00s influences on his sleeve, they get folded into contemporary sound designs that have taken him all across Europe and Australia.

He joins us in Croatia for Terminal V in mid-July and before that has served up a taste of what to expect: big and bouncy beats, turbocharged synths and sunny sounds to match the mood of warmer days. It’s a fast-paced trip through vibe-filled house and garage that will keep you going all year long, so stick it on and find out more about the man who is G by name, G by nature.

Franky Rizardo presents FLOW, a weekly radio show dedicated to bringing you the hottest records in house music. item.title: Terminal V Podcast 117 – Kara Okay
item.description:
Artist: Kara Okay Show: Terminal V Podcast 117 – Kara Okay Serie: terminal-v Added: June 12, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Terminal V Podcast 117 – Kara Okay

Serie: terminal-v

Added: June 12, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Kara Okay is all about serving up sonic treats that bring joy. Importantly, though, the Dutchman knows you can have too much of a good thing, so he has learned to balance the ups with the downs, the light with the dark. The self-confessed optimist pulls his pianos, vocals and rushes of euphoria from across a spectrum of house, trance and garage, often with hints of 90s nostalgia, and can count the likes of DJ Heartstring and Marlon Hofstad as fans.

His own productions are often the high points of his sets, and are something he really managed to focus on after a knee injury kept him at home more often than he’d have liked. Ahead of a busy summer of gigs across Europe and ahead of him joining us in Croatia in mid-July, he has served up set full of unreleased gems and also shared some of his feelings about studio gear, mixing techniques and how he packs his USBs.

terminal-v

Tracklist

Simon James and Adam Helal are the duo behind Rolasoul. Releasing music on labels including Plastic Fantastic and District, they write and produce from their studio at Tileyard in London.

Combining their individual influences and experience behind the decks, Rolasoul’s productions blend a classic groove with dynamic energy. Their partnership is built on a shared love of electronic music and a natural creative chemistry that has developed over years of working together.

Through an extensive touring history and a growing catalogue of releases, the Rolasoul sound has stayed focused on what matters most- making music they believe in.

On this Balance Selections mix, Rolasoul showcase exactly what that believe is- deep, dense progressive. Featuring tracks from Kasey Taylor & Stereo Underground, Fordal, Elliot Moriarty and more, this 90-minute journey is packed with energetic dance.

The annual Sunrise Set returns as one of the most cherished traditions in the Global DJ Broadcast calendar. Created as a celebration of music, memories, emotions and imagination, the 2026 edition invites you to step away from the noise of everyday life and immerse yourself in the theatre of the mind. Featuring beautiful melodies, evocative atmospheres and meaningful moments from across the trance, progressive and melodic spectrum, this special two-hour journey continues a tradition of storytelling through sound while offering a glimpse into the spirit of the forthcoming In Search of Sunrise 22. Wherever you may be listening in the world, thank you for sharing this experience and being part of the journey.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 210
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 210 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: June 10, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 210

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: June 10, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

Opening with my own Rain, extended version. Teenage Mutants and Tonino come in next with Oedipus Rex on Tragedie, then VNDX with Fabio Salvati on Furrier. Mattia Saviolo’s Mindframe and Simina Grigoriu’s Frame Control both land on Drumcode, holding the spine of the first half. Funk D’Void and Pig&Dan link up on Cocoon for Overdose, Alex Lentini & STOMP BOXX drop Kraken on 8693 DCLTD, and Dok & Martin go underground with Sound of the Underground. Romain Say and Nelayan bring Transmission on Memoro, Audio State’s Generator Room keeps it moving, and Simina Grigoriu returns with Coconut Milk on Drumcode. Closing with a Rhapsodie techno edit of Kelis’ Milkshake into DJ Jordan’s Melodic Punch.

Next Friday I’m on the Tomorrowland Store rooftop in Playa d’en Bossa with Lilly Palmer joining me. 19:00 to 23:00. If you’re on the island, come through.

Midnight never sleeps. See you next Wednesday.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Boyá – Bassiani Podcast 313
item.description:
Artist: Boyá Show: Boyá – Bassiani Podcast 313 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: June 9, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Boyá – Bassiani Podcast 313

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: June 9, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Local artist Boya (Solomon Gagua) has been active as part of the Tbilisi scene for the past ten years, part of a new generation of DJs shaping the music scene in the Georgian capital. In 2016 he formed Digital Groove Affair together with Giorgi Kakoishvili, a Chicago house, garage, and 80s disco-inspired collaboration project that quickly set up shop in the city, and became known for its wobbling tempos and limitless grooves, both through their mixes and published work. His career as a solo artist has put him behind decks at venues like Bassiani, TES, Reflector and local vinyl haunt Morevi Records, and places farther afield like Tallinn, Berlin and Oslo. His music continues to pull at the genres that have so deeply informed his work, and picks up those threads to make an altogether new assembly of styles that’s undeniably his. Full to the brim with skipping beats and airy textures, Boya’s mixing charts a course through old-school references and present-day tracks to deliver his tailored musical style. For Bassiani Podcast 313, he offers a smooth-running two-hour riff on his usual grooves; one of Tbilisi’s finest at the top of his game.

Bassiani Podcast

item.title: Mathys Lenne – HATE Podcast 490
item.description:
Artist: Unknown

Show: Mathys Lenne – HATE Podcast 490 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: June 7, 2026 Genre: Techno

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: June 7, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Mathys Lenne is the 490th guest of our original HATE Podcast series.

For this podcast, I wanted to focus on a passage through tension, hypnotic movement, and atmosphere. A selection of tracks shaping my current state of mind and the direction my sound has been evolving toward over the past months. Some of the tracks woven into this journey remain unreleased, quietly connected to a project taking shape behind the scenes and meant to unfold in its own time.

Mathys Lenne crafts techno as a form of tension architecture. Raw, hypnotic and emotionally charged. Through releases on MORD, HAYES or Mutual Rytm, he has developed a singular language where mental intensity meets physical impact. His productions move between hypnotic repetition, cinematic atmospheres and fierce rhythmic pressure, always driven by a strong sense of storytelling. With his last album “The Poet And The Muse” on MORD, Mathys expands that vision even further. Melancholic textures, suspended spaces and visceral grooves coexist in a body of work that feels both intimate and uncompromising, revealing a deeper and more reflective side of his sound. Whether in the studio or behind the decks, Mathys approaches techno as a constantly evolving space: immersive, emotional and built to transport. His sets unfold like narrative journeys, balancing tension and release while pushing rhythm to its rawest and most hypnotic form.

HATE Podcast

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: June 7, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Qrion has carved out a distinctive sound that blends soft, exploratory textures with soulful house rhythms.

That delicate balance has earned her global recognition, with releases across some of electronic music’s most respected labels, from Anjunadeep to Last Night On Earth.

Her 2021 debut album I Hope It Lasts Forever was widely praised as one of the year’s standout dance records and established her as one of the most exciting electronic artists to emerge in recent years.

Recognized internationally for her unique approach behind both the decks and in the studio, Qrion continues to push boundaries while staying deeply connected to the emotional core of dance music.

On this Balance Selections mix, the Austin-based artist delivers fully on that promise.

Featuring tracks from Jamie Stevens, Seth Troxler, and Floating Points, this is a tightly woven hour of lush deep house filled with warmth, groove, and melodic pleasure.

🖖 This week’s guest is an exclusive from Marc Spieler 👨‍🚀🌕

Marc Spieler is a DJ and producer who doesn’t just play music for the crowd, he fully lives every moment of it. Whether behind the decks or performing through his live sax project MSP, Marc brings a natural energy that instantly connects with people on the dancefloor.

As the founder of Lust&Laune and Electro Swing Paradise, he has built his own unique musical universe, blending groove, emotion and rhythm into sets that feel both powerful and personal. His open-minded approach to music allows him to move smoothly between different styles and influences, creating an atmosphere that pulls people in from the very first track.

With warm melodies, uplifting vibes and a strong feeling for the crowd, Marc Spieler delivers musical journeys that stay with you long after the night is over.

This week, Marc Spieler joins Selectro with an exclusive guest mix on Dance FM.

We’ve been following Sonophone closely for years because his early productions had that rare elegance and refined touch that instantly stood out. Known for his impeccable sound design and deep musical vision, Darius has built a unique universe around his music.

Over the last years he spent most of his time in the studio experimenting, searching and refining his sound even further. There are also a few exciting surprises coming soon, but until then, those who truly appreciate his music can explore his productions and remixes on his Bandcamp page.

A true old school underground spirit, Sonophone has been appreciated for years by respected labels thanks to his distinctive style and authentic approach. From eclectic DJ sets moving naturally through disco, electronic, dub and house, to memorable live performances with a full band behind him, his musical journey has always been about emotion, groove and detail.

This week we are very happy to welcome Darius, better known as Sonophone, to Selectro.

Baron Von Trax is part of the Australian new wave, but what makes him unique is the joy and emotion he brings to harder dance sounds. His tracks are always luminous and uplifting, rich in melody and packed with inescapable emotion that swells the heart while his drums get the pulse rising.

In this interview, the Melbourne man admits he wants his music to be accessible and credits his classical piano background as one of the key tools in his production arsenal. He also speaks on what first turned him onto eurodance and where his sound is going next while serving up a gloriously bright, sunny mix that transitions smoothly through every facet of his sound.

item.title: Mees Salomé – Distant 107
item.description:
Artist: Mees Salomé Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 107 Serie: Distant Added: June 5, 2026 Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 107

Serie: Distant

Added: June 5, 2026

Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Tracklist

The last few weeks have been a bit of a blur. A lot of shows, new music being released, upcoming releases to prepare for, and a handful of new projects that I’m really excited about. It’s the kind of period you’ve been looking forward to for a long time. Getting to share music, visit new places, and see this little world we’ve built continue to grow. In many ways, it’s exactly what I hoped it would be.

At the same time, I’ve noticed something else. The more things there are to do, the easier it becomes to move straight from one thing to the next without really taking any of it in. One show ends and you’re already preparing for the next. A release comes out and your mind is already focused on the one after that. Somewhere along the way, it becomes surprisingly difficult to simply enjoy the things you’ve been working so hard for.

I’m not very good at saying no to opportunities. Partly because I’m genuinely excited about all of it, but also because I always want to do my best for everyone involved. Whether that’s the people I work with, the events inviting me to play, or all of you listening and supporting this journey. I’m getting better at juggling all those different things, but I’m also learning that being present for them is just as important as making them happen in the first place. Otherwise, everything starts to feel like a checklist instead of the adventure it was meant to be.

There’s a lot to look forward to this month. A new collaboration at the end of June, which I’ve included in this episode, Distant Moments this weekend, and of course festival season ramping up all around us. For now though, maybe this hour can be a small excuse to slow things down for a moment and simply enjoy where you are.

Hope you enjoy ❤️

Distant

Broadcasting from Ibiza, Markus Schulz returns with the latest studio edition of Global DJ Broadcast. The show is highlighted by the world premiere of Not Over Yet, his new collaboration with Paul Oakenfold and Grace; paying tribute to a song that has left a lasting mark on generations of dance music fans. Alongside the premiere, Markus shines a spotlight on Above & Beyond’s Anjunabeats Volume 17 and Armin van Buuren’s A State of Trance 2026 mix compilations. item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 209
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 209 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: June 3, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 209

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: June 3, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

Charles D opens with One Time For Your Mind on Truesoul, and Daxson comes in right behind with Beija on Arcane. Veerus and Mattia Saviolo bring Move Your Body on Drumcode, then YellowHeads team up with Pablo Say on I’ll Never Leave You Alone.

Pan-Pot’s Portals on Second State sits in the middle and shifts the room. Alex Lentini and STOMP BOXX take two slots on DCLTD, Can’t Follow Me and Orbital Adventure, with Anna Sonic’s Strobe between them. That pairing was deliberate, their sound has been on heavy rotation in the studio this month.

Slim Black returns with Mosher on Human, RHAPSODIE drops NO MORE DISGUISES, HIFEX lands on Sound Dissonance with The Room Is Dead. Then a Thomas Schumacher edit of Franco Smith’s Stimulation on Electric Ballroom, Slam’s Kuture Version on Soma, and Rob Robsen closes on DigDis with Turn My Body.

Drop the timestamp of the moment that catches you in the comments. I read every one. One more thing for the Ibiza Midnighters: Lilly Palmer is joining me at the Tomorrowland Store Ibiza Rooftop Sessions on June 19. Come up if you’re on the island.

Same pulse, different cities. See you next Wednesday.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Ina Kacz – Bassiani Podcast 312
item.description:
Artist: Bassiani , Ina Kacz Show: Ina Kacz – Bassiani Podcast 312 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: June 2, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Ina Kacz – Bassiani Podcast 312

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: June 2, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Ina Kacz is a French-Polish DJ and producer based in Tbilisi, Georgia, known for crafting deeply immersive and rhythmically charged journeys through techno and hypnotic club fare. Mixing together percussive layers and driving low-end pressure with a polished sense for progression and darting beats, her dynamic approach has made her a regular presence in some of Europe’s most acclaimed venues, including clubs such as Berghain, Tresor, Ohm, and RSO. Her productions too are the stuff legendary nights are made of, her 2024 Endless EP released on self-run imprint Aneelhi Rec, a riveting portrayal of her fast-burning techno running at fever pitch. Merciless, pounding basslines form the backbone of her sound, driving tightly coiled sets and productions aimed squarely at the dancefloor she calls home. Bridging gritty textures and high-impact tempos, Kacz delivers propulsive narratives through marathon sets, intensely primal energies she’s become fluent in drawing out. For this latest number, Kacz unleashes a flurry of techno cuts shaped by her acutely tuned feeling for tension and release. Bassiani Podcast 312 is a trip through her hammering take on the genre, a defiant two-hour edition from a burgeoning creative force.

Bassiani Podcast

item.description:
Artist: Franco Rossi Show: MindTrip Podcast 116 – Franco Rossi Serie: MindTrip Podcast Added: June 1, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: MindTrip Podcast 116 – Franco Rossi

Serie: MindTrip Podcast

Added: June 1, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

For MindTrip Podcast 116, label head Pfirter introduces Franco Rossi, an Argentine producer originally from Córdoba and currently based in Barcelona, Spain. Rossi’s signature sound sits at the exact intersection of deep, hypnotic techno and careful sound design, a style shaped over years of hard work across the South American and European underground circuits. Following the success of his debut Cenit EP on MindTrip last year, he returns to the imprint this summer for his second release. This exclusive podcast mix highlights that signature progression, bookended by his own unreleased cuts while seamlessly weaving in heavy-hitting tracks from cutting-edge labels like Semantica, Mord, Nachtstrom Schallplatten, and MindTrip itself.

This is MindTrip!

01.Franco Rossi – intro id 02.Andre Luki – Flying Simulator [ANTISTAGE Records] 03.BRALLE – slings & arrows [Adversarial Machines] 04.Bernardo hangar – Munin [Analog Solutions] 05.DSNGDMANN – simple shape (Mist gasp remix) [Airsound Records] 06.Dave wincent – obsess [Nachtstrom Schallplatten] 07.Drop-E – Remanent Magnetism [Semantica] 08.Franco Rossi – Keiko [MindTrip] 09.Franco Rossi – Varuna [MindTrip] 10.Arjun Vagale & Oxygeno – Zero Gravity [Semantica] 11.KOLPOS – Bipolar / mindtrip 12.Marc Faenger – Circuit [Nachtstrom Schallplatten] 13.Marc Faenger – Corridor [Incense] 14.Nemesis – self reproach [MindTrip] 15.Obscur & Variable – with in context [Sigma5] 16.olmo – famine (stndrd remix) [Ucker records] 17.Operator (uk) – running from the man [Mord] 18.Franco Rossi – ID outro

item.title: Balance Selections 372 – Raw Main
item.description:
Artist: Raw Main Show: Balance Selections 372 – Raw Main Serie: Balance Selections Added: May 29, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 372 – Raw Main

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: May 29, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Part of a rising generation pushing melodic and organic house into new territory, a Raw Main production is identifiable through hypnotic percussion, detailed sound design and an instinct for atmosphere that feels equally suited to headphones and dancefloors alike. In recent years, he’s built an impressive catalogue with releases landing on Lost Miracle and All Day I Dream, home to his most recent release.

With continued support from respected selectors including Sébastien Léger, Bedouin, Lee Burridge and Roy Rosenfeld, Raw Main has quietly established himself as one of the more intriguing names emerging from the melodic underground today.

On this Balance Selections mix, the French artist threads together organic textures, hypnotic grooves and luminous melodic fragments into a fluid journey through the deeper end of melodic house. Featuring music from Lost Desert, Kebin van Reeken and Jonas Rathsman, it’s an energetic hour of energetic melodic house.

Balance Selections

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 208
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 208 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: May 27, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 208

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: May 27, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

This one is for the gym at 6AM, the highway at midnight, the dancefloor at 3.

Slim Black and Mosher tear it open with Take Me Away. Walks in, owns the room. Sheik from Argentina hits back with Adrenaline, then Audio State out of Romania locks it down on Natura Viva Black.

YellowHeads bring fire in the Peak Mode extended mix on HILOMATIK. Sisko Electrofanatik turns Baby Doc’s Twisted Silky into a weapon on Variety. Teenage Mutants land on TRAGEDIE, PAGODA with Ian Thaüer build the pressure, Mario Ochoa pushes through on Terminal M, Alex Lentini with STOMP BOXX go heavy on DCLTD.

Then Anna Reusch takes the room twice. Heartbeat on Electric Ballroom, The Pill on Voltaire Music. When something hits like this, you give it the floor.

System 97 closes the energy stretch with Breathe With Me. Daxson takes us out with Laser Beam on Arcane.

Drop the timestamp of the moment that catches you in the comments. I read every one.

Same pulse, different cities. See you next Wednesday.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Pierce – HATE Podcast 468
item.description:
Artist: Pierce Show: Pierce – HATE Podcast 468 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: May 24, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Pierce – HATE Podcast 468

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: May 24, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Pierce is the 488th guest of our original HATE Podcast series.

For this one-hour podcast recording, Pierce focuses on tension, dialogue, and release, carefully layering hypnotic grooves, evolving textures, and driving rhythms into a fluid, forward-moving journey. Built with precision and restraint, the mix balances pressure and space, gradually unfolding into moments of cathartic energy while maintaining a consistent sense of motion throughout.

Tbilisi-based DJ/producer Pierce is known for his instinctive ability to build energetic, driving atmospheres, both in the studio and behind the decks. Shaped by one of Europe’s most visceral underground scenes, his approach to music is deeply rooted in momentum: the kind that steadily pulls a room forward and refuses to let go.

With releases on labels such as Token, WSNWG, and Sublunar, his productions are rhythmically precise, texturally rich, and driven by a relentless sense of purpose. As a DJ, Pierce has brought that same intensity to some of the world’s most respected dance floors, including Tresor, K41, Horoom, and Tillatec.

item.title: Balance Selections 371 – Mariano Montori
item.description:
Artist: Mariano Montori Show: Balance Selections 371 – Mariano Montori Serie: Balance Selections Added: May 22, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 371 – Mariano Montori

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: May 22, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Now based in Barcelona after emerging from Argentina’s progressive underground, Mariano Montori crafts music with patience and control, favouring subtle melodic interplay and slow-burning tension over obvious peaks.

Across releases for labels including The Soundgarden and Univack, he builds tracks that move with precision, balancing atmosphere with a strong sense of dancefloor momentum.

From clubs and festivals across Europe and Latin America to appearances in Mexico, Peru, Colombia and Pakistan, Montori continues to refine a sound grounded in emotional storytelling and deep, transportive energy, both in the studio and behind the decks.

On this Balance Selections mix, he delivers a two-hour set that simmers with controlled tension. Featuring music from Kamilo Sanclemente, Nicolas Viana, Fernando Olaya and more, this is well-crafted excursion into mature dance music.

Balance Selections

This Memorial Day edition of The Long Weekend Mix on Global DJ Broadcast marks the threshold of summer – a moment that brings a shift in pace in North America, and an open invitation for listeners around the world to step into the feeling of longer days, warmer nights and renewed energy ahead.

Where meaning matters.

Built around deep flow and emotional progression, this two-hour set moves through atmosphere, energy, and release; designed for uninterrupted listening from start to finish. As always, the focus is on continuity and storytelling through music.

Whether you’re marking the holiday weekend or simply taking time for yourself wherever you are, this mix is an invitation to slow down, disconnect, and step into the season ahead through sound.

Episode eighty-nine is a journey into the heart of the UK trance underground: the iconic Platipus Records.

Established in 1993, Platipus became world-renowned for its unique raw blend of acid lines and melodic elements. From early trance anthem to genre-defining bombs, this 90-minute mix pays tribute to one of the most influential labels in electronic music history.

item.title: Terminal V Podcast 115 – MXGN
item.description:
Artist: MXGN Show: Terminal V Podcast 115 – MXGN Serie: terminal-v Added: May 15, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Terminal V Podcast 115 – MXGN

Serie: terminal-v

Added: May 15, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Liverpool’s MXGN belongs to a new generation who have come up through the internet age but don’t live online. Instead, he’s been locked in the studio since his mid-teens and refining a sound that hits with brutal peak-time force but still carries musicality beneath the beats. Raised on Tomorrowland videos before buying his first decks aged nine, he has now racked up millions of streams, released on labels like Teletech, Filth On Acid and NineTimesNine and is one of the UK’s fastest-rising hard techno stars.

Increasingly drawn toward live performance and hands-on hardware experimentation, MXGN has been rebuilding his music in real time using Roland drum machines, synthesisers and Ableton-based live setups. We speak to him about all that, his route into the scene, and find out about the exclusive mix he has served up for us. It was recorded fully live on hardware and is an assault on all the senses.

terminal-v

item.title: Balance Selections 370 – Aaron Suiss
item.description:
Artist: Aaron Suiss Show: Balance Selections 370 – Aaron Suiss Serie: Balance Selections Added: May 15, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 370 – Aaron Suiss

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: May 15, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Emerging from Washington D.C. before relocating to the island energy of Koh Phangan, Aaron Suiss has built a career defined as much by emotional connection as dancefloor momentum. Now based in Thailand, the DJ, producer and label figure channels a melodic progressive sound rooted in feeling rather than functionality. That philosophy extends beyond the studio.

Whether overseeing A&R duties for Outta Limits Recordings, championing new talent, or crafting productions that continue to climb the Beatport charts, Suiss approaches music as an act of energy exchange rather than pure entertainment. It’s a mindset that has helped shape his rise while keeping his perspective grounded.

On this Balance Selections, the artist showcase a crips sound that feels seamless. Featuring tracks from Dowden, Stereo Underground, Patrice Bäumel and more, this is a dynamic journey though progressive textures.

Balance Selections

DIZZY is a Bucharest-based DJ and producer crafting a distinct sonic identity rooted in the underground.

Serie: Tracklistings Mixtape

Added: May 13, 2026

Genre: Electro , House

Tracklist

SGT is a Berlin-based electro producer and DJ. Built from years as a selector and electronic music collector, his sound hits with the raw energy of punk and the machine-driven pulse of early Detroit electronic pioneers. No gloss, just stripped-down, functional tracks made for dark rooms and serious systems.

Drawing influences that range from rap to punk rock, SGT channels the energy of artists who thrived on the edge- those who blurred boundaries with punk attitude and sonic innovation, like Drexciya and Cybotron. This intersection defines his own style- militant electro layered with analog textures, tight loops, and acid-laced sequences, often straight 808 and 303 sounds, twisted into modern, dance floor focused pieces of music.

These days, SGT is locked into production. Transforming years of DJing into tracks made to move bodies and rattle sound systems, his music carries the imprint of punk; tight, looping structures and a raw approach to rhythm, wired together in his own brand of stripped-back, hard-hitting electro.

item.title: DJ Sense – Bassiani Podcast 309
item.description:
Artist: DJ Sense Show: DJ Sense – Bassiani Podcast 309 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: May 12, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: DJ Sense – Bassiani Podcast 309

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: May 12, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Emerging from Tbilisi’s restless underground, DJ Sense (Otiko Gakharia) is a 90s-born selector both shaped by and shaping the techno landscape in Georgia. Over the span of his relatively short career, he’s built a reputation for hypnotic sounds that unfold slowly and follow their calculated trajectory into the early hours. A resident at TES Club (one of Tbilisi’s foremost spaces for electronic fare), Sense has come into focus as a master of shifting energies and precision loops. He’s also known as curator and party organizer, having launched his infamous event series U.F.O. (Unit for Observation) as platform for the exploration of techno’s outer fringes.

As host of radio show Tears in Club he pushes the limits of standard dancefloor acoustics into the realm of pure listening, exemplifying an approach to sound that’s not just expertly cut, but heavily researched. While maintaining close links to the city that made him, he now brings that sound to the world with performances at venues like Den Anden Side (DK), Hayfilm Cluster (AM), ://about blank (DE) and The White Hotel (UK). Pushing the letter ever forward, Sense brings his recondite beats to the Podcast, an 82-minute build that balances force and restraint, techno that hightails through murky waters, DJ Sense’s unbending vision for techno brought to a narrative point in constant flux.

Bassiani Podcast

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 956 – Mauro Venti
item.description:
Artist: Mauro Venti Show: Data Transmission Podcast 956 – Mauro Venti Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: May 11, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 956 – Mauro Venti

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: May 11, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Mauro Venti steps into the Data Transmission Podcast. Verona’s Mauro Venti joins us this week with 60 minutes of rolling tech-house pressure.

Over the last decade, Mauro has built a serious catalogue across labels including Spinnin’ Deep, STMPD RCRDS, Hot Creations, Repopulate Mars, Toolroom, Relief, Glasgow Underground, Dirtybird, Sola, Techne, Desert Hearts, Circus Recordings, Snatch! Records, Kaluki and Nervous. Not a bad little run.

His sound sits right in that sweet spot between club-ready groove and underground bite. Tough drums, sharp basslines, and enough bounce to keep things moving from warm-up rooms to late-night basements.

The mix follows that same thread, moving through cuts from Malikk, SAGO, TWENTYSIX and Amal Nemer, Jude & Frank, ESSED, Cyava and Davide T, Marco Lys, Thomas Newson and David LeSal, Nausica, TCTS, DONT BLINK and more.

There’s also a big one from Mauro himself, as he features his forthcoming single ‘You Move Me’ alongside Dantiez, The Saunderson Brothers and JKLN. With Kevin Saunderson’s family name involved, you know there’s a bit of history in the room.

Mauro calls the mix a “progressive musical journey” powered by passion and selection. Fair enough. That’s exactly what a good guest mix should be.

Lock in for the next hour and get into Mauro Venti’s Data Transmission Podcast mix.

Data Transmission Podcast

Marcal is the 486th guest of our original HATE Podcast series.

Marcal is a Brazilian artist whose forward-thinking approach to techno continues to reshape the contemporary landscape through hypnotic storytelling, intricate sound design, and powerful rhythmic precision.

Rooted in the contrasts of Brazil’s cerrado landscapes and the mechanical textures that surrounded him growing up, Marcal has developed a sonic identity where organic energy meets futuristic architecture. His productions are driven by captivating groove structures, tribal undercurrents, and immersive atmospheres, balancing raw instinct with meticulous detail.

Known for crafting deeply narrative DJ sets, Marcal moves seamlessly between psychedelic tension, driving hypnotism, and sci-fi-inspired intensity, maintaining a fluid sense of progression that keeps listeners fully locked into the journey.

item.title: Terminal V Podcast 114 – Vivace
item.description:
Artist: Vivace Show: Terminal V Podcast 114 – Vivace Serie: terminal-v Added: May 8, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Terminal V Podcast 114 – Vivace

Serie: terminal-v

Added: May 8, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Aberdeen’s Vivace are forging a sound that is unbound by rules, history or pretence. They have an eclectic range of tastes and influences and pull from all of it when cooking up heat in both the booth and the studio. Trance euphoria, speed garage bump and the hardness of techno all collide with hints of musical nostalgia that bring the fun.

The pair only started working together in early 2024 and have since worked without limits. They now have an unspoken chemistry in the booth and a vast vault of unreleased tunes that you will hear soon. In the meantime, read about how they work, where they find inspiration and how they put together their mix, which is a twisted hard techno workout of slamming drums, dark textures and fresh fusions that hit different.

item.description:

Serie: Monument Techno Podcast

Added: May 7, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Episode 518 welcomes Marius Bø, co-founder of Oslo’s Ute collective — the label and event series born from deep-forest gatherings in Norway. Blending ambient, IDM, trance and techno with psychedelic finesse, his sets move between hypnotic tension and euphoric release, connecting old-school gems with futuristic soundscapes.

A regular at venues like Bassiani and FOLD, and festivals including Monument Festival and Organik Festival, he delivers a deeply immersive journey for the latest Monument Podcast.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 205
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 205 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: May 6, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 205

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: May 6, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters, this one moves with intent.

The set opens with Kasablanca and Township Rebellion’s It’s Chemical on MAHOOL, exactly the kind of statement we needed to start. Charlotte de Witte’s Amor with CERES on KNTXT follows, and Karla Blum’s The Only One on Arcane Music keeps the grip tight.

Through the middle: Adam Beyer with Mark Reeve on Drumcode, EDRDO’s Innocence Is a Myth, Diego Amaro, and Paul Tognelli’s Take Control on Mainground. Stephan Dodevsky’s rework of Jeff Mills’ The Bells lands at the halfway point, a classic for those of us who remember the original.

The closing stretch is where this one earns its place. Norvis and Anna May on Animarum, Demon Noise with Lautaro Ibañez, Amber Broos’s Chicks, Alex Farell with MXGN on HEKATE, and Giorgia Angiuli’s Sanamos Bailando. The set closes on Marie Vaunt and Deborah de Luca with Lalala, exactly the finish I wanted to share with you this week.

Two days from now, the first Rooftop Session begins at the Tomorrowland Store Ibiza. Friday May 8, on the rooftop of Ibiza Gallery in Playa d’en Bossa, the start of twelve bi-weekly Friday nights across the season. If you’re on the island, find me on the rooftop. If you’re somewhere else this Friday, this set is what we’ll be building toward.

There’s a moment around the middle of this mix, you’ll know which one. Drop the timestamp in the comments. I read every one.

Same pulse, different cities. See you next Wednesday.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Show: Yonti – Bassiani Podcast 308

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: May 5, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Based between Berlin and Lisbon, Yonti crafts a surging techno charged with rebel spirit. At a fresh 23 years old, he debuted at Berghain’s SNAX before becoming a regular there, and has gone on to play at some of the world’s most respected haunts including De School, Tresor, Basement, Pawnshop and no less than Glastonbury. His tension building sets are sinister and raw formulations that build layer upon layer towards their head-spinning climax. Blending surgical precision with instinctive feeling for sound he’s mastered the kind of peak-hour techno that leaves a mark, heaving basslines with no small measure of sharply defined detail thrown in. For Bassiani Podcast 308, Yonti channels that intensity into a mix that feels both relentless and deeply intentional, a punishing journey moored to the physicality of the dancefloor, a high speed collision of chaotic kicks and throbbing low-end locked in for after-hours ritual. A merciless 100 minute mix guaranteed to get you moving.

item.title: Dance TV DJ Mix 675 – Doc Martin (Oceanside, CA, U.S.A.)
item.description:
Artist: Doc Martin Show: Dance TV DJ Mix 675 – Doc Martin (Oceanside, CA, U.S.A.) Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix Added: May 4, 2026 Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Show: Dance TV DJ Mix 675 – Doc Martin (Oceanside, CA, U.S.A.)

Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix

Added: May 4, 2026

Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Dance TV is proud to present Dance TV DJ Mix #675 with the legendary Bay Area DJ, producer and Sublevel label head honcho – Doc Martin. Exclusively recorded for Dance TV, this mix is a masterclass in timeless house – groovy, funky and effortlessly refined. Packed with unreleased gems from top-tier producers across the globe, it captures Doc Martin’s unmistakable touch and deep-rooted connection to the dancefloor. An absolute must listen for any house music lover!

A product of the 80’s San Francisco dance music boom, Doc Martin has been creating innovative, high-energy electronic music for over three decades. Once a mainstay on the Pacific Northwest scene, he has gone on to perform everywhere from Ibiza to Tokyo, London and beyond, building an enduring and influential body of work in the process.

Doc Martin’s choice to pursue a career in music was an obvious one, given the musical family he grew up in. Most notably, his mother sang with Bay Area icons Jefferson Starship. Doc, however, was drawn to the emerging electronic subcultures taking shape across the country. Endless hours spent in San Francisco’s indie record stores armed him with a deep knowledge of everything from acid house to techno, shaping the genre-bending style that would come to define his career.

Within a few years of his first performances, Doc was selling out shows across his hometown and setting his sights on a global stage. In the early 90’s, he relocated to Los Angeles, quickly embedding himself in the city’s thriving rave scene. Not long after, his rising profile took him to Europe, where he became a regular at some of the continent’s most iconic clubs and parties, including Fabric (residency), Circoloco, Rex Club, Panorama Bar and Sunwaves. Over the years, he has become a favorite with audiences from New York to London, performing at institutions such as Output, Coachella, The Roxy, Twilo, Cityfox, Space, Desert Hearts, Movement and Lightning in a Bottle. Alongside his club career, he has DJ’ed for Grace Jones and James Brown, and served as tour DJ for Deee-Lite.

After decades of bringing people together through music, Doc Martin’s passion and drive remain as strong as ever. He continues to evolve, revealing new dimensions of his artistry while maintaining a global touring schedule and releasing some of the most compelling music of his career. A true elder statesman of electronic music, his legacy is firmly established – and still growing with every set he plays.

His journey has taken him from private events and club nights to major venues and festivals, including Electric Castle, Film în Sat, and Zi-le de Watra. He has performed at well-known spots such as Fratelli Iași, Madison Palas, La Corniche Palas, Ebony, Versus, and Story.

Tracklist

Funreal Future are the 485th guests of our original HATE Podcast series.

Formed by Repro and Adam Askov, Funeral Future stands among the key forces behind Copenhagen’s fast techno movement, a scene widely recognized for its intensity, emotional depth, and distinctive high-BPM sound.

As co-founders of the Euromantic label, they helped shape one of the most recognizable expressions of the Danish underground: fast, euphoric, melancholic, and deeply physical techno rooted in community, warehouse culture, and a strong DIY spirit.

Their sound moves between pounding rhythms, EBM-influenced pressure, trance-informed atmospheres, and emotionally charged melodic tension. Releases such as Hard Candy, Blue Euphoria, and The Bright Light Of Life remain defining examples of their unique approach; raw, functional, and deeply expressive at the same time.

HATE Podcast

Serie: terminal-v

Added: May 1, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Rising fast out of Sydney’s north-west, Efesian is armed with techno weaponry built from pummelling kicks, jungle-leaning percussion and flashes of ‘90s trance euphoria. He’s already had a Beatport #1 with ‘Can’t Be Stopped’, and been backed by heavyweights like Carl Cox, Klangkuenstler, FJAAK, Joris Voorn and HI-LO, so he is another one of Australia’s closely watched hard techno exports.

Now stepping up for Terminal V’s mix series with a turbocharged session built for maximum impact and stacked with his own productions, unreleased IDs and smartly chosen classics. It’s tightly wound with controlled peaks and troughs from start to finish and kicks off with a premiere of his brand new tune, ‘Good Time.’ Stick it on while you learn about his journey to this point, pressure in the studio and why he loves it hard.

item.description:

Serie: Distant

Added: May 1, 2026

Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Tracklist

The festival season is finally here, and I can feel that shift in energy again. Longer days, warmer weather, everything slowly coming back to life. It always brings a different kind of excitement with it.

These past months have been really special. Being able to release new music again means a lot to me, especially together with such incredible artists. There’s something about creating music together that keeps surprising me every time, you never really know where it will take you, but somehow it always ends up exactly where it needs to be.

Looking ahead, there are so many shows coming up that I’m genuinely excited for. Some new, some familiar, but all of them I can’t wait to experience with you. It feels good to step into this season with so much to look forward to.

Hope to see you out there somewhere. And until then, I hope you enjoy this month’s episode ❤

Distant

Whether on the move or immersed at home, the focus is on atmosphere, progression, and allowing the music to unfold naturally. In that space, this is where meaning matters.

item.title: Intercell.086 – X & Ivy
item.description:
Artist: X & Ivy Show: Intercell.086 – X & Ivy Serie: Intercell Added: April 24, 2026 Genre: Hard Techno , Techno

Show: Intercell.086 – X & Ivy

Serie: Intercell

Added: April 24, 2026

Genre: Hard Techno , Techno

Tracklist

An Australian meets a Californian at USC, bond over late-night sessions, and somehow end up making some of the most groove-locked club music around. That’s X & Ivy.

Their sound is a conversation between two very different record collections. Aussie pub rock and disco on one side, soul, hardcore, and house on the other, filtered through early Chicago house, Detroit techno, and the breakbeat-heavy, acid-tinged chaos of 90s UK raves. And somehow, it all fits perfectly.

Catch them on June 13 at Intercell x Interplanetary Criminal & Main Phase pres. ATW.

Intercell

item.title: Balance Selections 367 – Yonit
item.description:
Artist: Yonit Show: Balance Selections 367 – Yonit Serie: Balance Selections Added: April 24, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 367 – Yonit

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: April 24, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Shaped by the marathon dance floors of early-2000s New York, Yonit channels the spirit of the city’s club era.

Drawing from both nostalgic and contemporary sounds, she moves through groovy, melodic and rhythm-led territory, often landing somewhere between deep house, subtle tribal textures and emotional late-night moments.

With a selector’s mindset and an open-ear approach, Yonit digs across styles and eras to create journeys that feel fluid, playful and free of rules.

On this Balance Selections mix, the Brooklyn native showcases why she’s one to watch.

Featuring tracks from Danny Howells, Cinthie, Armen Miran and more, this is a tight, lush journey through contemporary deep house.

Balance Selections

Following a run of special editions, Markus Schulz resumes regular studio duties on Global DJ Broadcast this week. The show is highlighted by the world premiere of his new single Rave Generator, a driving techno piece set for release on Hilomatik on Friday May 1. Alongside the premiere, the show includes new Coldharbour Recordings material from Andy Woldman and Nemke; and a selection spanning progressive, trance and techno. item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 203
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 203 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: April 22, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 203

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: April 22, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

Episode 203 is locked and loaded, and this one hits with a raw, driving energy from start to finish. I’ve been diving deep lately, and you can feel that in this selection. It’s all about momentum, tension, and those moments where the groove just takes over completely. No distractions, just pure connection through sound.

We kick things off with Jody 6 setting the tone on Ride This Groove, and from there it’s a steady climb. Karla Blum and Kaeno bring that hypnotic flow, while Arielle adds a sharp edge with Attention. Seboro flips the vibe into something more playful with Party At My House before Jay Lumen and Devid Dega push things into full force territory.

In the second half, Drunken Kong and Belocca keep the pressure high, leading into TOYZZ with a massive Earthquake moment. Then Pablo Say, David LeSal, and Viv Castle bring a groove-heavy shift before we dive into something truly special, Chris Liebing and Charlotte de Witte with Symphonie des Seins. That one speaks for itself.

Closing out with DJ Panda’s Enter Reality, we land, but not softly.

Thanks for being part of this journey. Every week, you bring the energy right back to me.

See you in the next one.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Added: April 21, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Angioma and BLANKA are a French/Spanish duo based in Berlin whose uncompromising sound takes over the airwaves for Bassiani Podcast 306. Their ongoing partnership brings together two highly disparate voices that keenly thumb through their extensive techno catalogue in the service of an unfettered and contemporary sound. Together, the duo started Room Trax, a label and event series that brings Barcelona and Berlin a little closer together with its community focused music explorations, an underground gathering that showcases both established and upcoming names. Their studio recordings have been released on Amotik’s AMTK+, Soma, Mutual Rytm and Setaoc Mass’ SK_Eleven, and appearances at Berghain, FVTVR, FOLD, Basement and WOMB have put them to the test with flying colours. It’s techno with a solid emphasis on groove and steady rhythm, synthetic formulations that exponentially build toward a point of release. Their gravity defying basslines continue to define their corner of the techno landscape, proving their mettle as innovative producers and world-class performers. This latest number brings the pair together for a two hour journey into their world: a raw and minimal bout of blazing beats and technical precision, red hot tunes from a visionary duo.

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 954 – GUDFELLA
item.description:
Artist: Gudfella Show: Data Transmission Podcast 954 – GUDFELLA Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: April 20, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 954 – GUDFELLA

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: April 20, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

GUDFELLA steps up for the Data Transmission podcast with a mix that mirrors where his sound is at right now, sharp, groove-led and built for big rooms without losing that late-night edge. With “Morning Coffee” opening things up, he wastes no time setting the tone. It’s the track that’s been doing serious damage across sets worldwide, and it still hits.

From there, it moves fast. His edit of “Shut Up” and that flip of “Buttons” show the playful side, while cuts like Chris Lorenzo’s “In This Bih” and Ship Wrek’s “My Body” keep the pressure on. There’s a nice balance here, known weapons, left turns, and a stack of IDs that hint at what’s coming next from his camp.

Tracks like Marco Strous’ “Yello Kitty” and the Beltran remix bring that rolling, low-end groove, while deeper moments like Parcels’ “Overnight” give the mix some space before it builds again. And those GUDFELLA IDs are doing exactly what they should, locking you in without giving too much away.

This one feels like a proper snapshot. Big records, tight transitions, and just enough unreleased heat to keep you guessing.

Lock in and run it loud.

Data Transmission Podcast

item.title: Dance TV DJ Mix 674 – Ora The Molecule (Oslo, Norway)
item.description:
Artist: Ora The Molecule Show: Dance TV DJ Mix 674 – Ora The Molecule (Oslo, Norway) Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix Added: April 20, 2026 Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Show: Dance TV DJ Mix 674 – Ora The Molecule (Oslo, Norway)

Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix

Added: April 20, 2026

Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Dance TV is proud to present Dance TV DJ Mix #674 with the Norwegian DJ, producer, vocalist and live act Ora The Molecule. Based in Oslo, she has been making serious waves on both sides of the Atlantic with her distinctive blend of Italo disco, cosmic electronics and timeless club sensibility – a sound that has earned her a Spellemannsprisen (Norwegian Grammy) for her self-produced album Dance Therapy. Ora the Molecule represents a fresh wave of electronic artists redefining disco for a modern audience. Dive into this exclusive and truly special recording with a few of Ora’s original tracks! Dope!

A true multi-instrumentalist and visionary artist, Ora The Molecule operates in her own universe — writing, producing and performing music that draws from the golden era of disco while pushing it into a futuristic, genre-blurring space. Often described as Norway’s disco queen, her work channels the spirit of pioneers like Giorgio Moroder and Cerrone, yet remains unmistakably her own: playful, sophisticated, and deeply immersive.

From crafting records in a forest cabin in Norway to performing at iconic platforms like Beats In Space in New York, she has built a global presence through her unique artistic voice. Her live shows are a world of their own — a striking fusion of performance, character, and club energy — blurring the line between concert, DJ set, and art installation.

With releases on Mute Records — home to legends such as Depeche Mode, New Order, and Kraftwerk — Ora The Molecule stands at the forefront of a new wave of electronic artists redefining disco for a modern audience. Bold, imaginative, and unmistakably original, she continues to carve out a space that is entirely hers.

Capture Radio is the weekly soundtrack to your journey through sound, curated and hosted by Laura van Dam.

Every episode blends the worlds of trance, techno, and progressive house, with a signature touch: Laura’s own productions and personal selections that tell a story beyond the dancefloor.

Expect emotional builds, hypnotic rhythms, and high-energy drops a musical trip where every track has a purpose, and every moment is designed to capture you.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 202
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 202 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: April 15, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 202

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: April 15, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

Episode #202 is here, and this one dives straight into a deep, driving journey that kept me locked in from the very first second. There is a raw, hypnotic flow running through the entire set, one of those episodes where every track pulls you further into the night without letting go.

We open strong with Jody 6 – You Got Me, setting the tone before Emmanuel Miro’s Monochrome takes things into a more atmospheric space. From there, it is all about momentum. Sian and Sam WOLFE bring that edgy energy with Another Pill, and Sergio Marini’s Freaking adds a sharp twist that hits just right.

I have packed this episode with powerful selections. Westerby’s Human Expression and AIO and HNGT’s No Compromise really push that hypnotic groove forward, while Boy In Nature’s Cellular adds a deeper layer to the journey. Dj Perroz keeps things rolling with K.B.A., and Hybrasil alongside HYBRD deliver a standout moment with Way Back.

Thomas Schumacher and A.D.H.S. raise the intensity with Prometheus, and then you will recognize a reworked classic vibe as Green Velvet and Harvard Bass drop Lazer Beams in that Slim Black Festival Edit, always a weapon on the floor.

Closing the episode, Karla Blum’s Ahogar brings a darker edge before Krzysiek Teper’s Disco Volante wraps things up with pure driving energy.

This is one of those episodes you will want to replay, trust me.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your energy keeps The Midnight Project alive every single week.

Much love, Sebastiaan

Serie: JOOF Radio

Added: April 14, 2026

Tracklist

I’m breaking my own rules on the radio show this month.

As you know, I’ve never been a DJ who uses this platform to heavily promote my own music or label. This show has always been about sharing the incredible sounds I discover each month, wherever that journey takes us. But this month is different.

After six long years in the making, and what must be the longest album tease in history, The Lost Tribe is finally here. The reaction over the past few days has been overwhelming, and I want to sincerely thank you for the support, the messages, and for taking it straight to number one across the charts within a day.

The album was written as a complete journey. Eighteen full-length tracks, designed to be experienced from beginning to end. But one thing was missing… a mixed version. So I’ve fixed that.

As a one-off for this month, I’ve created an exclusive continuous mix of the entire album, keeping the story intact as it was intended. A deep, uninterrupted journey, stretching well beyond two hours.

I hope you enjoy this version as much as I enjoyed putting it together for you.

item.description:
Artist: Draxx Show: Data Transmission Podcast 953 – Draxx (ITA) Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: April 14, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 953 – Draxx (ITA)

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: April 14, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Draxx (ITA) steps up for DT Radio with a rolling, percussive workout

Fresh off his link-up with Nick Francis on Sound D’Elite, Draxx (ITA) lands on Data Transmission with a tight, club-focused mix that does exactly what you want it to. No filler, just movement.

The Italian has been building this lane for a while now. Releases on Desolat, Nervous and Trick, plus that ‘Future of Dance’ nod, have put him in the right circles. The ‘I Needa’ EP shows where he’s at right now, groove-led, rhythmic and built for busy floors

This mix leans straight into that energy. Latin pressure from Evelio Escobar’s ‘Mi Tierra’, rolling cuts like Twolate’s ‘Afrolatino’, and that low-slung swing on Lotten and Delatorre’s ‘Gata Celosa’. His own ‘Pa Miami’ with Cvmpanile slots in clean, while ‘Believe’ with Nick Francis keeps things driving late on.

It’s heads down, hips moving stuff. The kind that works in basements and doesn’t let up.

Lock in and run it back.

Data Transmission Podcast

item.title: Marie Montexier – Bassiani Podcast 305
item.description:
Artist: Marie Montexier Show: Marie Montexier – Bassiani Podcast 305 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: April 14, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Marie Montexier – Bassiani Podcast 305

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: April 14, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

With half-French/half-German roots, Berlin-based DJ Marie Montexier is a proponent of fast-paced rhythms with a heavy rave bent. From a youth spent at parties and early experiments at illegal gatherings back in Cologne comes a voice that’s charged with turn of the millennium energy, a narrative structure that both resonates with her own coming of age and brings its newer interpretation: breakbeat and bass-focused rhythms pulled from her many vinyl digs and internet deep dives. Hitting the ground running in 2019, she founded Paryìa two years later, a community-led imprint that platforms upcoming talents whose work dovetails with her own bold and club-laced vision. From being a regular at Berghain and Blitz, Fabric to DGTL, Butik Festival and Nation of Gondwana, she’s forging a name for herself as an innovative selector with an expert read of a floor and the skill required to keep it moving. Early morning set? Build tension. Later in the day? Bring out the bangers. Trippy techno, UK breaks, tribal beats and acid cuts primed for club, Montexier weaves it all together with the precision and passion of a tested talent. Bassiani Podcast305 is a two-hour studio mix: low end rhythms from the abyss, layers of rumbling techno for the peak hours.

Bassiani Podcast

Artist: Nicolas Ruiz Show: Balance Selections 365 – Nicolas Ruiz Serie: Balance Selections Added: April 10, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 365 – Nicolas Ruiz

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: April 10, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Nicolás Ruiz emerged from Argentina’s Misiones province with a sound shaped as much by local grounding as global ambition. Releases on Renaissance, Hope Recordings and Plattenbank have placed him firmly within the progressive continuum, with support from figures like Hernán Cattaneo and Nick Warren reinforcing his steady ascent.

Having shared booths with names from John Digweed to Guy J, and appearances spanning from Zurich’s Street Parade to key European showcases, Ruiz continues to refine a craft that sits comfortably between dancefloor functionality and melodic depth.

On this Balance Selections mix he continues that fine form. Featuring tracks from Kasper Koman, Maze28, Juan Deminicis and more, this is two hours of well-crafted dance music.

Balance Selections

item.title: Global DJ Broadcast – In Bloom 2026
item.description:
Artist: Markus Schulz Show: Global DJ Broadcast – In Bloom 2026 Serie: Global DJ Broadcast Added: April 9, 2026 Genre: Progressive Trance , Trance

Show: Global DJ Broadcast – In Bloom 2026

Serie: Global DJ Broadcast

Added: April 9, 2026

Genre: Progressive Trance , Trance

Tracklist

For the arrival of spring, Global DJ Broadcast turns its focus to the emotional connection between music and voice; where melodies are given life through lyrics, and every song tells a story. Titled In Bloom, this annual tradition reflects the sense of renewal and color that comes with the season; a journey shaped by feeling, memory and the moments that stay with us long after the music fades.

The 2026 edition marks a special milestone; the 10th chapter of In Bloom. Over the years, it has grown into one of the most cherished concepts within Global DJ Broadcast, eagerly anticipated by listeners across the world. Each edition captures a snapshot in time, and together, they form a lasting emotional archive of vocal dance music.

This year’s journey has been carefully constructed to flow as a single, immersive experience – where every transition matters, and every song plays its part in a larger story. Featuring a blend of standout favorites from the past 12 months alongside forward-looking selections, In Bloom 2026 showcases the voices and producers who continue to shape the sound of trance, progressive and melodic dance music.

From intimate moments to expansive, euphoric peaks, this is a mix designed to be felt from beginning to end. An uninterrupted journey through connection, reflection and release.

In Bloom 2026 is dedicated to the global dance music community, and to everyone who returns to these moments year after year.

Tracklist

Bryan Gee returns with the April edition of the V Podcast, delivering another upfront selection of drum and bass pressure from across the spectrum.

This month features fresh heat from Shy FX, L-Side, Makoto, Riya, Crystal Clear, Zero T and Business As Usual, alongside vocal cuts from DRS, Rider Shafique, Vanessa Freeman, MC Fats and more.

On guest mix duties this month is Sweetpea. With releases across multiple labels, a stint hosting the BBC Radio 1 Drum & Bass Show, and as part of EQ50, she’s been putting in serious work across the scene, alongside regular shows on Kool FM.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 201
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 201 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: April 8, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 201

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: April 8, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

Episode 201 is here, and this one hits with pure momentum from the very first beat. I went deep into driving rhythms and hypnotic layers this week, one of those journeys that keeps pulling you forward, track after track. No compromises, just raw energy designed for those late-night hours where everything locks in.

We kick things off with a powerful opener from Rein (NL), setting the tone instantly, and from there it’s a relentless ride. You’ll hear massive cuts from Anna Reusch, Viviana Casanova, and a heavy collaboration between Pan-Pot and Eli Brown that really pushes the intensity. Sisko Electrofanatik and Roberto Pagliaccia bring that groove, while Bouras keeps things tight and driving.

Mid-set, Monika Kruse gets a fresh twist with a Mark Reeve remix, and then a truly iconic moment: Jeff Mills’ The Bells reimagined for now. That transition hits different. From there, it’s all fire, Green Velvet and Harvard Bass remixed by Adam Beyer and Massano, plus Victor Ruiz and Alex Stein delivering pure power.

In the final stretch, Kaufmann (DE), Leblanc, and Chloe Martinez close the episode with attitude and edge, no slowing down, just forward motion all the way to the last second.

This episode is packed with standout tracks and serious heat throughout.

Thank you for being part of this journey, Midnighters. Your energy fuels everything I do.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project
