item.title: Natascha Kann – Bassiani Podcast 304
item.description:
Artist: Natascha Kann Show: Natascha Kann – Bassiani Podcast 304 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: April 7, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Natascha Kann – Bassiani Podcast 304

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: April 7, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Native to Germany’s Ruhr region and based in Berlin for 15 years, Natascha Kann has been DJing for over a decade. She spent six years as a resident at ://about blank, where she started to built her skills and learned what it takes to move a crowd. Her sets flow across genres from ’90s house and Detroit to tech house, minimal, and acid. Always guided by a strong sense of intuition and connection. You can tell she’s spent countless hours on the dancefloor herself. Every track is carefully chosen with a clear sense of timing, energy, and what works in the room in that moment. Kann regularly plays at Berlin’s standout spots like Heideglühen, Panorama Bar, and Sisyphos, bringing her mix of warmth, groove, and drive to each set. Whether spinning vinyls or files on a USB stick, her mixes rally together history, community and great energy for unforgettable nights: a blend of rich, analogue textures and dynamic mixing that demonstrate a keen feel for her craft as DJ and offer a glimpse of her city’s singular magic. For Bassiani Podcast 304, Kann delivers a 90-minute mix of peak-time floor-fillers, a dose of soaring, grassroots house from the Morevi showcase at Horoom last September.

Bassiani Podcast

item.title: MindTrip Podcast 114 – MASCHA
item.description:
Artist: MASCHA , Pfirter Show: MindTrip Podcast 114 – MASCHA Serie: MindTrip Podcast Added: April 6, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: MindTrip Podcast 114 – MASCHA

Serie: MindTrip Podcast

Added: April 6, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

This week, Pfirter welcomes East-Berlin native MASCHA to the airwaves. With over a decade of immersion in the underground circuits of both Berlin and Mexico City, MASCHA has cultivated a sound defined by surgical precision and hypnotic intensity.

Her style bridges the raw, industrial grit of her hometown with the soulful, driving lineage of 90s Detroit techno. Recently, she made waves by expanding the genre’s boundaries through a live collaboration with the National Orchestra of Guatemala, proving her ability to command both the sweat-soaked dancefloor and the grand concert hall.

For this 70-minute journey, MASCHA delivers a masterclass in tension and release. Featuring heavyweights like Oscar Mulero, Planetary Assault Systems, and Rødhåd, the mix is a tightly structured descent into the deep, rhythmic techno that defines the MindTrip aesthetic.

MindTrip Podcast

item.description:
Artist: dc11 Show: dc11 – HATE Podcast 482 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: April 5, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: dc11 – HATE Podcast 482

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: April 5, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

dc11 is the 482nd guest of our original Hate Podcast series.

‘This podcast is a live one take in the studio, using the same tools I use live in a club, Octatrack, 909, a small modular. A collection of sounds I’ve been toying with recently, quite synth forward and driving; I love synths and love even more putting them forward in the mix. An hour of peak time, straightforward techno.’

The Rennes-based artist dc11 got into making music via modular synthesizers and to this day they are his tool of choice in the studio as well as in clubs. Gravitating towards the loopy side of techno, his live sets always leave a big part to improvisation. Finding ways to slightly shift loops hasn’t lost its appeal yet.

HATE Podcast

item.title: Mees Salomé – Distant 105
item.description:
Artist: Mees Salomé Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 105 Serie: Distant Added: April 3, 2026 Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 105

Serie: Distant

Added: April 3, 2026

Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Tracklist

After a little break between shows, it always feels a bit unfamiliar to step behind the decks again. Not because it’s been that long, but because playing your music in front of people is such a super special feeling. Something day to day life, and the time in between, doesn’t really compare to. It reminds me of coming back from a holiday, sitting down at your desk, staring at your screen and thinking, “ok… so how do I do this again?”

Nothing has really changed. It’s not something you unlearn in a few days. You just need a moment to find your rhythm again, to reconnect with it. But that small gap, between not quite knowing what you’re doing and everything clicking back into place, that’s the part that makes me a little nervous every time. At the same time, I know that once I’m up there, surrounded by all of you, it will feel exactly how it’s supposed to. Like it always does. And honestly, that’s the part I’m looking forward to the most.

But until that moment is here, I hope you enjoy this month’s episode ❤

Distant

item.title: Balance Selections 364 – Paul James Nolan
item.description:
Artist: Paul James Nolan Show: Balance Selections 364 – Paul James Nolan Serie: Balance Selections Added: April 3, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 364 – Paul James Nolan

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: April 3, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Paul James Nolan approaches electronic music as a tool for transformation, using the booth not just to perform, but to hold space and guide a shared, immersive experience.

With a background in high-end audio engineering alongside artists like Sasha and Junkie XL, his technical precision underpins a sound that feels both tactile and emotionally charged.

With releases spanning Bedrock Records to When We Dip, his work is supported by artists including Hernan Cattaneo, John Digweed, Patrice Bäumel and Tim Green.

With a heavily anticipated official remix of Diabla by Funk D’Void slated for release on one of the world’s most influential electronic labels later this year, Paul continues to build momentum as a vital voice in the scene.

On this Balance Selections, he showcases that approach across a two-hour mix. Featuring tracks from Trentemøller, Four Candles, Redspace and more, it unfolds patiently before building toward an energetic finale.

Balance Selections

The Long Weekend Mix returns for a special Easter edition on the Global DJ Broadcast, curated and mixed by Markus Schulz. Designed for moments of reflection, travel and disconnection from the everyday, this two-hour journey unfolds with patience and precision – blending deep, atmospheric progressive sounds with evolving melodic energy.

Built as part of a series of six Long Weekend Mixes across 2026, this edition captures the spirit of the Easter period: renewal, introspection and emotional connection. From immersive early textures through to a powerful and resonant closing stretch, every transition is crafted to create a seamless, story-driven experience.

Whether you’re on the move, unwinding, or simply taking time out, this is a mix designed to stay with you long after the final track fades.

From chilled vibes to uplifting energy, this mix takes you on a journey through emotional soundscapes and powerful club tracks.

Highlights include Ferry’s own productions, collaborations like “Attraction” with Marsh, and a strong closing track from B Jones.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 200
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 200 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: April 1, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 200

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: April 1, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

Episode 200… wow. What a milestone. This week’s Midnight Project is all about that raw, driving energy that’s been fueling dancefloors for years, but with a forward push into what’s next. I wanted this one to feel like a journey, starting deep, building tension, and then unleashing pure intensity as we celebrate this special moment together.

I’ve packed this episode with absolute power. From the timeless energy of Monika Kruse’s Latex to the hypnotic pull of Nicole Moudaber’s Black Silk, and the relentless drive of Space 92’s Dimension, this is one of those sets that just doesn’t let go. You’ll also hear massive collaborations like Chris Liebing and Charlotte de Witte with Symphonie des Seins, plus that explosive closing with Lilly Palmer and Space 92 on Vicious Chords.

There are so many standout moments in here, including that Radio Slave remix of Ralph Falcon’s Break You and the dark groove of Victor Ruiz’s Scorpio (HNGT Remix). This is exactly what The Midnight Project stands for: timeless sounds, forward-thinking energy, and tracks that hit you right in the chest.

Thank you for being part of this journey and for riding with me all the way to episode 200. This is just the beginning of the next chapter.

Much love, Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Tygre is a San Francisco-based DJ whose sound is rooted in the marrow of bass music. His instincts were forged in the drum and bass underground of Philadelphia’s rave scene in the 90s. Weight, tension, and sub-bass are ingrained like a predator’s spirit. Today he moves between electro and dubstep, two genres bound by the same brooding intensity and low-end devotion. Resident DJ at Addicted 2 Bass (@addicted2bass-official), with appearances across the international mix circuit. His mixes are dark, atmospheric, and obsessively precise. item.title: Chontane – Bassiani Podcast 303
item.description:
Artist: Chontane Show: Chontane – Bassiani Podcast 303 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: March 31, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Chontane – Bassiani Podcast 303

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: March 31, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Meet Chontane, a Berlin-based producer and DJ with Ukrainian roots blending sharp-witted sound design and genre-fluid tunes for the capital and beyond. He cut his teeth at Krach in Berlin’s leafy Humboldthain before delving into venues like Tresor and K41 (Kyiv), as well as RSO, Berghain, Blitz, Basement NYC, Fuse (Brussels), and of course, Bassiani. Techno, breaks and electro, permeated with tribal rhythms and 90s kick, a modus operandi that sets him apart as Berlin favourite and clubfloor champion. Since 2018, his studio releases have appeared on labels like Monnom Black, Mutual Rytm and Emerald, and a further push to innovate has brought his self-run imprint TANE into the light where his powerful yet contained sound flourishes. Last year’s Set a Dot ([TANE003]) received particular attention for its rhythmic dexterity and relentless drive, with standout tracks Magallanes and Cycle Break quickly becoming crowd favourites. His sound is dense, layered, astute in its selection and unsparing in its demands, body-focused music from the future that invokes the spirit of the early 2000s and all its techno splendour. With a discography that spans over 90 tracks, he continues to evolve, blending UK-style rhythms with hypnotic loops as well as other influences. Bassiani Podcast 303 is a take no prisoners, 105-minute mix that covers all his usual bases and more: mile a minute beats that climb towards their heady peak. As he gears up for more releases and global gigs in 2026, Chontane remains a vital voice in modern electronic music, always ready to surprise and move the dancefloor.

Bassiani Podcast

Les Castizos are a duo of Spanish DJs and producers with a career of more than 13 years in the booths of the best clubs and festivals around the world, with outstanding performances at Privilege and Amnesia in Ibiza, Pacha Barcelona, Marina Beach Club Valencia, Dreambeach, A Summer Story, Arenal Sound and FIB among many others. They have travelled with their music to places like Miami, Amsterdam, Paris, London and different parts of the world such as Colombia, Mexico, Guatemala, Russia and Asia.

Their music is a reflection of their roots and the lifestyle of their sunny hometown Malaga, combined with their attitude in the booth and their refined and avant-garde taste for Latin Tech House sounds, make their DJ Set one of the most demanded shows on the Spanish and international scene. Their tracks has been released on world-renowned labels such as Spinnin’ Records, Subliminal, Nervous Records, Hurry Up Slowly…

item.description:
Artist: Juan Pablo Torrez , Kostya Outta Show: Juan Pablo Torrez – Clubsonica Radio 070 (Kostya Outta Guestmix) Serie: Clubsonica Radio Added: March 26, 2026 Genre: Progressive House

Show: Juan Pablo Torrez – Clubsonica Radio 070 (Kostya Outta Guestmix)

Serie: Clubsonica Radio

Added: March 26, 2026

Genre: Progressive House

Tracklist

Hello everyone, and welcome to a brand new episode of Clubsonica Radio with your host and the DJ for the first hour of the show, Juan Pablo Torrez.

This episode delivers a deep and melodic progressive journey, blending atmospheric textures with driving grooves. The first hour features music from Elliot Moriarty, Ritchie Haydn, Franco Camiolo, Nicolas Viana, Ignacio Hernández, Pablo Arbelaez, Mauro Aguirre & Jossem, and more, alongside a standout remix by Matthew Sona and a special rework by Juan Ibanez on ELECGROUND’s “Quasar”.

In the second hour, we welcome Polish artist Kostya Outta for a special guest mix.

Known for his releases on leading underground labels such as Mango Alley, Balkan Connection, UV, and Replug, Kostya has established himself as a key figure in the progressive house scene, with support from artists like Nick Warren, Eelke Kleijn, and Henry Saiz. Returning to Clubsonica, he delivers a powerful new remix of “Ad Astra” by ELECGROUND, bringing his signature high-energy approach with driving grooves, intricate percussion, and evolving melodic elements.

The result is a dynamic and refined interpretation that perfectly reflects his distinctive sound and production style.

Now he takes over the second hour with an exclusive mix for Clubsonica Radio, showcasing a deep and energetic journey through his current sound.

Let the music set your vibes, and let me know what you think about the show. Leave a comment, like, and repost. This is a great way to support your artists.

Remember that music is life, enjoy.

Sunny & Clay are two passionate DJs from Bucharest, Romania, brought together by their love for electronic music.

Their sets blend techno, deep tech minimal, tech house and house, with touches of tribal and classic influences. Each set feels like a journey, moving from driving energy to warm, soulful grooves.

Beyond DJing, they are also stepping into production. They are currently working on two original tracks that reflect their style and will be released soon.

With real passion and a strong focus on their craft, Sunny & Clay bring a fresh sound to the dancefloor. 🔥

As March fades away, excitement for the 2026 Summer Season is reaching a fever pitch, hinting at nights on the Sunset Strip that will be impossible to forget. With every sunrise, the island’s pulse grows stronger, Ibiza is gearing up to ignite once more, ready to embrace sun-chasers and party lovers from every corner of the globe.

Resident DJ Ryan McDermott is back, getting you ready for another summer on the White Isle with a jam-packed show of the tunes you’ll be sipping along to with your Strawberry Daiquiri on the Café Mambo Terrace. This month’s lineup features a special guest mix from legendary house DJ Seb Fontaine, alongside new tracks from Dayl, Marco Lys, Rue Jay, Ben Santiago & Lovely Laura, plus many more.

So kick back, turn it up, and start dreaming of summer 2026!

We are Café Mambo… We are Ibiza!

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 199
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 199 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: March 25, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 199

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: March 25, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

Episode 199 is here, and this one hits with pure late-night intensity from the very first kick. I built this set to keep you locked in that hypnotic zone, driving, emotional, and raw in all the right moments. It’s one of those journeys where time disappears and the groove takes over completely.

We open strong with OZBEK and Zafer Atabey’s “Shake Off,” setting the tone before rolling into the deep, powerful energy of Belocca and Sisko Electrofanatik’s remix of “Ametista.” The momentum keeps building with serious heat from Eli Brown and Pan-Pot on “Coming In Heavy,” a track that absolutely slams on big systems.

There’s also a beautiful balance in this episode. Tracks like Sam WOLFE’s “My Instinct” and KASIA’s “Simulate” bring that hypnotic tension, while Jay Crusoe and KAŸ Wagner add groove and emotion to the mix. And then we close with something truly special, Push’s “Universal Nation” (BLR Remix). A legendary moment, reimagined for now.

As always, I’ve packed this episode with music I love, including some real standouts and must-play tracks that are lighting up dancefloors right now.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Your energy keeps this project alive.

See you next week.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Globally supported LA based open format electronic DJ & producer/mixing & mastering engineer since 2002. Ex host & curator of Elektronik Tranzmissionz Podcast.

6047 (GOAT) is a Los Angeles based open format electronic DJ & producer whose musical diversity is reflected in his mixes & productions. Influenced by the electronic music styles of house, techno, synth-pop, italo disco, freestyle, & electro. Attention to detail is what is always present in his work. He is a specialist in programming concept & deconstructed mixes of which are a result of 20 years of experience & progression. A specialist in creating locked grooves & progressive mixes that range from noise to jungle. Rather than boring people with long-winded bios written in 3rd person about his musical accomplishments he prefers to let the music do all the talking. His mixes have been aired on the best podcasts & radio stations worldwide which have been featured throughout 15 countries, 40 podcasts, & 210 shows. He is the ex host & curator of Elektronik Tranzmissionz Podcast.

6047 – The numerical stylizing for the word goat which is the zodiac symbol of the astrological sign Capricorn.

Vito Fattore is an Italian DJ and producer and the founder of BlackBox Records. Over the years, he has built his place in the electronic music scene through passion, consistency, and strong collaborations.

He has worked and shared projects with respected international artists such as Thomas Schumacher, Pirupa, Leon, Ralf, Nice7, Sergio Fernandez, Karotte, Giorgia Angiuli, Sasha Carassi, Nathan Barato, Uner, Flashmob, Livio & Roby, and many others.

Active mainly between Italy, Germany, and the UK, Vito Fattore was also the first Italian artist to perform at Waha Festival in 2016 and 2017. He has also appeared at events in London with Deep Square Records and Point, as well as in clubs like Crack Bellmer, Farbfernseher, [ipsə], and Circolo Bartali.

Artist: Ulf Eriksson Show: Ulf Eriksson – Bassiani Podcast 302 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: March 24, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Ulf Eriksson – Bassiani Podcast 302

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: March 24, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

For about two decades, Ulf Eriksson has put blood, sweat and tears into the Malmö scene, and weathered the challenges that come with such a fast changing landscape. As DJ, head of the legendary Kontra-Musik label, AD at Inkonst and chief curator of electronic and experimental music fest Intonal, he’s a name whose fate is intimately tied to his local scene, having helped build the city’s cultural heft from the ground up. Kontra-Musik started in 2002, a club night at first then imprint with a radically open aesthetic that covers techno, house and ambient from a mix of underground local talents. His ongoing partnership with Sebastian Mullaert has seen the duo tour with Mullaert on live duties and Eriksson on decks, a pairing that furnished 2016’s The Dance, a nine-track kicker designed for three dimensional listening that pulled in some of their close collaborators for a masterful exploration in sound. His studio work with Andreas Tilliander (TM404) will also release a collaborative EP this May. Eriksson’s own musical approach is a textural deep-dive into the world of wax, as a mainly vinyl DJ he creates slow-build structures that reward patience with fine analog detail and emotional complexity. For Bassiani Podcast 302, the Swedish pioneer keeps things light without losing any of his broader palette: this is an 85-minute studio mix with spring set in its sights, a fresh and synth-heavy number from a Malmö legend.

Bassiani Podcast

item.description:
Artist: Unknown

Show: Deetron – HATE Podcast 481 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: March 22, 2026 Genre: Techno

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: March 22, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Deetronis is the 481st guest of our original HATE Podcast series.

For over three decades, Sam Geiser has shaped the landscape of House and Techno in ways that are impossible to overstate. With a catalog spanning timeless classics and influential releases, he has firmly established him as one of the most musically sophisticated producers in the game. Recently, Sam has also reignited his Techno persona SOULMATE, delivering a string of irresistibly body-moving releases on the iconic Ilian Tape.

There are artists who are extraordinary in the studio, and others who redefine what it means to be a DJ — but it is a rare sight when both qualities reside in one person. Deetron is one of those rare cases. Watching him mix reveals not only the heights of technical mastery, but how deeply technique can enhance the emotional and physical power of a DJ set.

HATE Podcast

item.title: Terminal V Podcast 111 – ROW1
item.description:
Artist: ROW1 Show: Terminal V Podcast 111 – ROW1 Serie: terminal-v Added: March 20, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Terminal V Podcast 111 – ROW1

Serie: terminal-v

Added: March 20, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Belgian DJ ROW1 is riding the crest of a new wave of hard dance talent that is emerging from Europe’s underground. Still early in his journey but already shaping things with a distinct identity, his approach leans into intensity, emotion and instinct, but always with unstoppable momentum. This year, he has continued to play live and serve up his own tunes: they’re bold and bouncy and, he says in this interview, often inspired by interactions with dancers in the club.

He also expands on what he has already learnt in the DJ booth, how he approaches his sets and the role the gear plays in how he plays. Read on and tune into the accompanying mix, which is a blend of hard dance and trance inspirations.

item.title: Dance TV DJ Mix 672 – ADMN (Detroit, U.S.A.)
item.description:
Artist: ADMN Show: Dance TV DJ Mix 672 – ADMN (Detroit, U.S.A.) Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix Added: March 20, 2026 Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Show: Dance TV DJ Mix 672 – ADMN (Detroit, U.S.A.)

Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix

Added: March 20, 2026

Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Dance TV is proud to present Dance TV DJ Mix #672 with Detroit’s DJ, producer and Infolines imprint head honcho — ADMN. Rooted in the city’s rich musical legacy, ADMN delivers a seamless journey moving from house through minimal into techno, all infused with that unmistakable Detroit soul. Blending his own productions with cuts from some of the city’s finest and beyond, this is a dope, carefully crafted selection with a uniquely smooth and captivating flow. Enjoy!

Behind a Clark Kent–like exterior—glasses, calm demeanor, and a knowing smile—Alexander Drazin, aka ADMN, operates as one of Detroit’s more elusive sonic architects. With a natural affinity for both music and technology, his journey began early and has evolved into a relentless pursuit of sound, shaped by the grit and depth of Detroit’s underground.

ADMN’s style resists easy categorization. Rooted in an almost entirely original output, his sets and productions blend raw textures, minimal structures, and heavy low-end into a signature sound often described as minimal ghetto sludge—a hypnotic, driving fusion that feels both industrial and deeply soulful.

His technical foundation was sharpened at Allure Sound Studios, where he worked as an audio engineer on multiple records, including Recovery by Eminem. This studio experience continues to inform his precise, detail-driven approach in both production and performance.

Balancing life as a network engineer, producer, DJ, and label head of Infolines, ADMN remains deeply embedded in Detroit’s scene, holding a residency at TV Lounge and performing across the U.S. He has appeared multiple times at Movement Electronic Music Festival, including the main stage in 2022, as well as virtual editions like Movement At Home and Paxahau’s Micro Movement.

His discography reflects strong ties to Detroit’s legacy and global underground, with releases and remixes for labels such as Planet E (including remixing Carl Craig’s seminal ‘Psyche – From Beyond’ along side Seth Troxler and Ataxia), and collaborations with Oliver Dollar on Rekids, Refuge AUS, and his own Infolines imprint.

Consistently evolving yet unmistakably rooted, ADMN continues to push a sound that is as functional as it is forward-thinking—built for dark rooms, deep systems, and those who know.

item.title: Balance Selections 362 – Leah Marie
item.description:
Artist: LEAH MARIE Show: Balance Selections 362 – Leah Marie Serie: Balance Selections Added: March 20, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 362 – Leah Marie

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: March 20, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Hailing from Australia and now based in Berlin, Leah Marie is part of a new wave of artists shaping the deeper end of the electronic spectrum. Her sound moves between deep, progressive and melodic house, with a touch of cerebral techno; built on groove, restraint and a strong sense of space. In the booth, she favours flow over flash, guiding sets with careful pacing and an instinct for atmosphere.

Her productions and remixes have found a home on labels include Mango Alley to Musique de Lune Noir, with further releases on the horizon. Along the way, she’s taken that sound beyond Berlin, playing across Germany, Portugal, the Netherlands and the UK.

In 2025, she co-founded Kontrast. with Dilby and Dowden- a Berlin-based event centred on the deeper, groove-led corners of house music. The next edition lands at Hotel Amano East Rooftop on Saturday 11th April (more info here).

On this Balance Selections mix, the rising producer displays a taste for a wide-ranging sound. Featuring tracks from Timo Maas, Patrice Baumel, Chus & Ceballos and more, this is a two-hour mix that evolves with patience and intent.

Balance Selections

item.title: Monument Techno Podcast 511 – AHIL
item.description:
Artist: AHIL Show: Monument Techno Podcast 511 – AHIL Serie: Monument Techno Podcast Added: March 19, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Monument Techno Podcast 511 – AHIL

Serie: Monument Techno Podcast

Added: March 19, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

AHIL joins the Monument Podcast from Rotterdam with a rich and immersive addition to the series. Episode 511 unfolds as an ever-evolving journey, blending depth, energy, and seamless progression throughout.

“Having the opportunity to create a mix for Monument, a platform and festival that has shaped my sound over the past six years, feels truly special. I approached this mix the same way I would approach a festival set, I want this to feel as a journey shared between artist and dancer. It begins with space to arrive, to settle into the moment, and to prepare for the adventure ahead. Slowly, percussive and deep hypnotic elements emerge, inviting the body to move almost unconsciously. As the story unfolds, rhythms intensify and tension gradually builds, guiding the listener deeper into the experience. What starts as a subtle pulse evolves into a more intense flow of energy, leading towards a final moment of release”

Monument Techno Podcast

Added: March 18, 2026

Genre: Trance

Tracklist

In episode 277 of Resonation Radio, Ferry Corsten brings you an hour packed with melodic trance and progressive sounds. This week’s show features brand new music from top artists across the scene, including exciting collaborations and fresh releases you don’t want to miss.

Expect tracks from Agents of Time & Miss Monique, ARTBAT with Giuseppe Ottaviani, and a special collaboration between Marsh & Ferry himself.

The episode kicks off with “Resurrection” by Sound Quelle & Jantine and takes you on a journey through uplifting melodies, deep grooves, and powerful closing energy.

Ferry also shares his upcoming tour stops, heading to São Paulo, Miami, and Medellín. Sit back, relax and enjoy the next hour of Resonation Radio!

item.title: Pōnky – HATE Podcast 480
item.description:
Artist: Pōnky Show: Pōnky – HATE Podcast 480 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: March 15, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Pōnky – HATE Podcast 480

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: March 15, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Pōnky is the 480th guest of our original HATE Podcast series.

In this set, Ponky explores the hypnotic side of techno: driving energy, fluid percussion, and immersive loops that pull the listener into a continuous state of movement. The groove is constant, but never static — small details appear and disappear, synths swirl through space, and the rhythm unfolds like a living organism. As the set evolves, the intensity rises through thicker arrangements and more complex rhythmic structures.

The hypnotic groove remains the guiding force, but the sonic palette expands gradually, revealing new textures and emotional depth.Toward the final part of the set, the energy begins to transform. The dense rhythmic layers slowly open up, making space for more melodic elements to emerge.

Available to listen to via our SoundCloud from Sunday (15th of March, 2026)

Follow #Pōnky here: https://soundcloud.com/romain-arabian https://www.instagram.com/ponky.mp3

item.title: Terminal V Podcast 110 – Arman John
item.description:
Artist: Arman John Show: Terminal V Podcast 110 – Arman John Serie: terminal-v Added: March 13, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Terminal V Podcast 110 – Arman John

Serie: terminal-v

Added: March 13, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

Hanover’s Arman John is at the sharp end of the hard techno scene as both a DJ and producer. He heads up Phased Records but also releases on labels like Obscuur and Ismus, often with elements of Euro dance and trance sitting next to his love of acid, bouncy beats and alluring vocal hooks that keep his tracks emotionally as well as physically charged up.

Fresh off finishing a Master’s degree in Science, Arman has put together a mix that invites you into where he is at right now. It’s “good vibes only” from him ahead of a busy run of shows around Europe and then his appearance at Terminal V Croatia in August. Read on to get a perspective on how he approaches production, balancing fun and functionality, and plenty more.

terminal-v

Randoree is a fast-rising DJ and producer known for his signature blend of House, Afro, and Tribal rhythms crafted for the dance floor. With over a decade of global experience, 2025 marks a breakthrough year for Randoree, performing across the world in destinations like Ibiza, Mykonos, Switzerland, Thailand, Tel Aviv, India, Dubai, Baku, and more. This year alone, he delivered unforgettable shows at Hï Ibiza (Main Room with Hugel), Cova Santa for The Sumerians, Cavo Paradiso in Mykonos, and Lucerne ive Festival in Switzerland, each set showcasing his hypnotic tribal groove and magnetic stage energy. Following his worldwide success with Majnuna (with Hugel & Grossomodo), which hit #1 on Beatport, Randoree released his second collaboration with Hugel, Work That Body. His music has earned the support of industry heavyweights such as Solomun, Dixon, Black Coffee, Tiesto, Adam Port, Blond:ish, Vintage Culture, and many more.

Check his upcoming release LE LO LE along SAHAR SAX on Redolent!

Rromarin is an Australian vocalist, producer, songwriter and DJ carving out a distinctive lane in electronic music with her immersive, emotive sound.

Blending melodic and organic house with a voice that drifts effortlessly between the intimate and the cinematic, she’s collaborated with artists including Golden Features, Solomun, Dusky, Colyn and Braxton, amassing over 40 million streams along the way.

With releases across labels like Ninja Tune, Anjunadeep and Foreign Family Collective, and support from triple j and BBC Radio 1, Rromarin continues to shape a sound that feels equally at home on headphones and on the dancefloor.

On this Balance Selections mix, the songstress showcases that her programming skills are just as finely tuned as her vocal range. Featuring tracks from Dosem, Cid Inc., Martin Fredes and more, this 90 minutes of engaging progressive hits all the right notes.

Tracklist

With a career spanning back to the vibrant 1980s, he has been a DJ and producer deeply immersed in the world of club and dance music, captivating audiences in major nightclubs. A lifelong lover of electronic music, his passion began with his very first vinyl record in the 70s, “Die Menschmaschine,” by Kraftwerk which he had to buy with his father because he was too young to purchase it himself. Based in Germany, he embarks on a new journey with his project, focusing exclusively on the electrifying realm of electronic sounds.

Introducing “Elektronensturm”, a fresh mix series designed to showcase the finest electronic productions. Rubber emphasizes contemporary tracks while occasionally revisiting timeless classics, ensuring a dynamic listening experience. He is dedicated to supporting emerging artists and labels looking to elevate their tracks in the scene.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 197
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 197 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: March 11, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 197

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: March 11, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

Episode 197 of The Midnight Project is here, and this one hits straight from the first second. I’m opening the show with my brand new track Atmos, and to celebrate the release, I’ve made it available as a free download for a few days on my SoundCloud. If you want to grab it, head over to https://soundcloud.com/sebastiaan-hooft while it’s still up.

From there, we dive deep into a powerful journey packed with driving energy and hypnotic grooves. Mario Ochoa brings serious tension with Forsaken, Pan-Pot delivers their unmistakable signature with Altered State, and METODI drops the wild Prince Igor On Steroids. Victoria Engel keeps the momentum flowing before the massive collaboration between Chris Liebing and Charlotte de Witte, Symphonie des Seins, takes things to another level.

You’ll also hear Amelie Lens with Falling Into Acid Dreams, a fierce moment from Paula van Klar with Calentura, and Tom Wax bringing pure rave spirit with The Rave Machine. Spartaque, Danny Aion, and Pablo Say keep the pressure building before we close strong with Bart Skils & Weska on Drumcode and George Z calling everyone back to the dancefloor.

As always, this episode is packed with incredible artists pushing the sound forward, and I’m grateful to share these tracks with you every week.

Thank you for being part of this journey and for keeping the energy alive every week. I see you, Midnighters.

Sebastiaan Hooft

The Midnight Project

item.title: Function – Bassiani Podcast 300
item.description:
Artist: Function Show: Function – Bassiani Podcast 300 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: March 10, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Function – Bassiani Podcast 300

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: March 10, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Function returns for a new podcast and a new year. The techno veteran and native New Yorker emerged out of the Big Apple in the heady days of the early 90s, think Jeff Mills and Limelight, before recordings on Synewave, Downwards and his own label Infrastructure started to surface. He went on to co-found the groundbreaking Sandwell District collective and eventually landed in Berlin, becoming a Berghain resident and part of the Ostgut roster within due course. The decades since have seen him cement his position as a forerunner of the techno genre, with releases such as his career defining Incubation and more recent Green EP (2023) timed as the relaunch of his infamous label. He continues to shape the landscape of electronic music with a stylistic approach that threads together gritty beats and delay heavy atmospheres, articulating a sound that’s emotional and merciless all at once. Bassiani Podcast 300 comes from his closing set at the club’s season opening night back in September, and it’s got enough momentum and ideas to keep even the hungriest raver satisfied. Clocking in at just over seven hours, this one’s a true testament to Function’s skill and experience, channeling his three decades of musical exploration into a poker hot endurance set that moves from his classic tone to sweeter-toothed euphoria. It’s a colossal mix with industrial throughline, proof of Function’s staying power as one of techno’s greats.

Bassiani Podcast

item.title: Sol Ortega – HATE Podcast 479
item.description:
Artist: Sol Ortega Show: Sol Ortega – HATE Podcast 479 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: March 8, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Sol Ortega – HATE Podcast 479

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: March 8, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Sol Ortega is the 479th guest of our original HATE Podcast series.

A versatile ride through deep and dub textures, flowing into proper techno, with stops along the way in house, Detroit techno and hardgroove territory. There’s a clear thread running through the whole mix: steady groove, jacking hi-hats, and chords that lock in the identity from start to finish.

Born and raised in Buenos Aires, Sol has become one of the few Latin American artists to carve out a strong presence on the global electronic music scene. Her unique sets — skillfully moving along the border between House and Techno — quickly gained traction in Argentina.

Sol has performed at some of the world’s most respected clubs and festivals, including Berghain, Concrete, Fusion Festival, Creamfields, EDC, Stone Techno Festival, Toffler, Boiler Room, Dekmantel, Fabric London, Fabrik, Lollapalooza, among many others.

Her studio work mirrors her approach as a DJ: one step at a time, with unwavering consistency. Early releases on Rhythm Nation and Unitas Multiplex laid the groundwork, while 2023 marked a milestone with her standout release on CROWD, followed by contributions to the Hardproof series on IMF, SEVEN, RAW. Her latest EP ’Auguria’ (2026), was released on Mitsubasa. Whether played by a House or a Techno DJ, Sol’s productions thrive in any context — balancing complexity and simplicity with a rare and distinctive touch.

HATE Podcast

item.title: Terminal V Podcast 109 – TJADE
item.description:
Artist: Tjade Show: Terminal V Podcast 109 – TJADE Serie: terminal-v Added: March 6, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House

Show: Terminal V Podcast 109 – TJADE

Serie: terminal-v

Added: March 6, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House

Tracklist

If you’ve spent any time in Europe’s underground dance circuit over the past decade, you’ll have surely heard of Tjade. Amsterdam-born and floor-focused, he’s always defining his own brand of high-energy dancefloor music and blurring the lines between uplifting prog house and early trance. His tracks have blown up on cult labels like Bordello a Parigi, DGTL and Correspondant, and he also heads up Agrio Tracks, a place where emerging talents feel at home.

We caught up with him to talk about the highs and lows of hitting the road, running a label in 2026, crafting nuanced sets that still hit hard, and his vision for a year of more sun-soaked grooves, musicality, and straight-up joy on the dancefloor. Dig in while giving yourself over to his sleek, bouncy and emotionally charged mix, which features cuts from the likes of In2pol & Entasia, Palmiz & Flor Coto and even one of his own.

item.title: Mees Salomé – Distant 104
item.description:
Artist: Mees Salomé Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 104 Serie: Distant Added: March 6, 2026 Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 104

Serie: Distant

Added: March 6, 2026

Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Tracklist

I’ve been working on a lot of exciting things lately. The kind of projects that make you want to rush through and skip to the good part. Working through all those different projects and tasks, I notice like I’m running on autopilot. I seem focused, like getting loads more done in less time, but honestly, I’m just way more impatient than usual. My attention span has shrunk and it feels almost impossible to really sit down with something. Whether that’s work, or me trying not to work.

I can see where all of this is heading, and it looks incredible. I just want it to be here already. The process feels like it’s in the way. Which it isn’t, of course. If I want to do this right, and I really do, then rushing through it would just mean arriving somewhere I’m not fully proud of. It’s more important to do it right than to do it quickly. I have to keep reminding myself of that, and try to slow down enough to actually be present for it.

So maybe we start here. Try to listen through this month’s episode as a whole. No skipping, no shuffling. Just sit down with it, let it play, and see where it takes you. Hope you enjoy ❤️

ps. one of these tracks will be released in 3 weeks.

Distant

Tracklist

Stereo Productions Podcast welcomes KPD for a powerful house session packed with groove and attitude. The mix features a strong selection of his own productions alongside standout cuts shaping today’s dancefloors. Highlights include his recent collaboration with DGRACE, “We Need Luv” on Stereo Productions, plus the label’s latest energy with DJ Chus – “That Feeling (Crusy & Alex Now Remix)”. Expect driving rhythms, classic house influences and pure club heat throughout this special guest mix.

Markus’ connection with Stereo Montreal has long been one of the most special relationships in his touring career, and this World Tour edition of the Global DJ Broadcast captures highlights from a marathon 12-hour open-to-close journey inside the legendary club. Recorded during an unforgettable night on February 21, the set showcases the darker, driving side of Markus’ sound as the floor moved through waves of techno, melodic tension and peak-time energy deep into the morning. Among the moments featured is his new single Somebody’s Watching Me, a track that proved to be a powerful weapon on the dancefloor during the night. Experience the atmosphere, intensity and storytelling of one of Markus’ most cherished stages as the World Tour stops in Montreal.

item.description:
Artist: Kali G Show: Dance TV DJ Mix 671 – Kali G (Casablanca, Morocco) Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix Added: March 5, 2026 Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Show: Dance TV DJ Mix 671 – Kali G (Casablanca, Morocco)

Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix

Added: March 5, 2026

Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Dance TV is proud to present Dance TV DJ Mix #671 with the Casablanca based DJ, producer and AVGD Records label owner – Kali G. A true architect of the Moroccan underground, he brings over two decades of experience shaped across global dancefloors, with releases on respected international labels and a vision rooted in deep, forward-thinking sounds. As the force behind Avangardis and his newly launched AVGD Records, Kali G continues to build platforms that support and evolve the culture from within.

For this mix, he delivers a fluid, tripped-out and forward-driving journey — guided by subtle energy, intricate melodies, and a hypnotic flow that draws you deeper with every transition. Enjoy!

Kali G (Khalil Belamallem) is a Moroccan DJ, producer, and entrepreneur with more than 25 years deep in the electronic music scene. Widely regarded as one of the key figures behind Morocco’s underground movement, he has played an essential role in shaping and elevating the culture both locally and on an international level.

His journey began in Spain, where he honed his sound and developed a distinct musical identity before taking it worldwide. From Ibiza to Germany, Switzerland, India, Colombia, and Brazil, Kali G has consistently delivered his signature blend of deep, driving grooves to dancefloors across the globe.

On the production front, his work has landed on respected labels such as Windhorse Records, Celo Records, Akbal Music, Achat Records, and Rewire Muzik, further solidifying his presence within the global circuit.

Beyond the booth, he is the founder of Avangardis — a platform focused on artist booking and event production — reflecting his long-term vision of nurturing and expanding electronic and live music culture. Now stepping into a new phase, he launches AVGD Records, an independent label dedicated to forward-thinking sounds, raw underground energy, and authentic artistic expression.

With decades of experience, global reach, and a clear artistic direction, Kali G continues to evolve — pushing boundaries as a DJ, producer, and curator committed to the deeper side of the culture.

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 948 – Très Mortimer
item.description:
Artist: Très Mortimer Show: Data Transmission Podcast 948 – Très Mortimer Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: March 4, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 948 – Très Mortimer

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: March 4, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Chicago’s Très Mortimer lands on the Data Transmission podcast this week, fresh from dropping his ‘PRADA’ release on his own Optics Records and bringing a mix packed with unreleased fire.

The Optics boss has been carving out his own lane in recent years, pushing groove-led house rooted in Chicago tradition but built for modern floors. With releases across labels like Ministry of Sound, Mad Decent and Three Six Zero, plus support from the likes of Seth Troxler, BLOND:ISH and Diplo, Mortimer’s records have been doing damage from rooftops to sweaty basements.

His mix for DT gives a proper snapshot of where his head’s at right now. The opener sets the tone straight away with his unreleased collaboration with Geo Smith, ‘Bass Controller’, a track he recently tested in New York and describes as “dancefloor certified.” It’s a chunky, groove-heavy start that rolls straight into cuts from Life on Planets and Jansons, DMX Krew, CASSIMM and Kolter.

There are a couple more unreleased moments in there too, including JAKKOB’s ‘DO YOU UNDERSTAND ME?’, while the middle section lifts off with a mash-up of Maori and OMRI’s ‘Levitate’ layered with Future, Metro Boomin, Playboi Carti and Travis Scott’s ‘Type Shit’.

Naturally, Très Mortimer’s own ‘PRADA (Hans Extended Mix)’ makes an appearance. It’s his favourite moment in the mix and a darker flip of the record, driven by heavy basslines and late-night pressure. That bassline approach is a big part of his style too, he prefers grooves that skip the first beat, leaving space for the drums to punch through and keep the floor moving.

The mix wraps with club-ready cuts from Gabss, Méssous and Kolter, keeping the groove locked all the way through.

Next up, Mortimer is gearing up for a big hometown moment with ARC Festival in Chicago, with the announcement landing soon.

Data Transmission Podcast

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 196
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 196 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: March 4, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 196

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: March 4, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters,

It’s Wednesday, 6 AM, and episode 196 of The Midnight Project is live. This week is about momentum, unity, and that shared pulse that connects us wherever you’re tuning in from. When you press play, you are stepping into a global circle of dedicated Midnighters who live and breathe this sound together.

We open strong with Pablo Say’s VIP on Truesoul, setting a deep and driving tone right from the first kick. Bart Skils and Weska lift the intensity with For The Music on Drumcode, a title that says everything about why we gather here every week.

Very early in the episode, you’ll hear something personal. Pablo Say and Anna Tur – My Life in my Private Edit. I reshaped this one especially for you. It is emotional, hypnotic, and built to pull us deeper into the journey as one.

Victor Ruiz and Moreira bring the heat with FREAK OUT on Arcane, while UMEK delivers pure energy with The World of Rave. There is a beautiful tension in Detune Prayer by IN-sane and a cosmic drive in Andromeda by Andres Koller and Lautaro Gabioud.

This week’s Classic of the Week is Twin Freaks by The Gateway Experience. This track has that timeless edge. It still feels dangerous, still feels fresh, and it reminds us where this underground spirit comes from. When it drops, you can feel the roots of the culture that shaped us.

In the final stretch, Aundreja’s Adrenaline pushes the pace higher, GP4S hits hard with The World Has Died, and Marie Vaunt closes the episode with a powerful triple on Arcane: Like a Fool, My Prada, and Never Gonna Stop. That closing sequence is relentless and unapologetic.

The Midnight Project airs every Wednesday at 6 AM and later connects with 60,000 listeners on DI.FM. And don’t forget, Saturday at 6 AM, the exclusive guest mix goes live on my channels. We keep building all week long.

Midnighters, this is more than a radio show. It is a growing global family. Share the episode with a friend who needs this energy. Message me your favorite moment. Let’s expand this movement and keep supporting the artists who shape our sound.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Bryan Gee digs deep into the foundations for this month’s V Podcast, pulling out a heavyweight selection of classic Bristol drum and bass ahead of the V Classics show in Shoreditch this March.

Long before playlists and algorithms, these were the records that shaped the sound. Raw breakbeats, heavyweight basslines and unmistakable Bristol attitude from the likes of Roni Size, DJ Die, Krust and Dillinja, alongside underground pressure from Kamanchi, Mask and Gang Related, Suburban Knights and Scorpio.

This episode rewinds to the era of Full Cycle, Dope Dragon and early V Recordings, when dubplates ruled the dance and the Bristol crew were rewriting the blueprint for jungle and drum and bass.

item.description:
Artist: GNMR , Zurkin Show: Zurkin b2b GNMR – Bassiani Podcast 299 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: March 4, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Zurkin b2b GNMR – Bassiani Podcast 299

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: March 4, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Up next comes a three-hour bout of hammering beats courtesy of Georgian DJ Zurkin and Italian DJ/Producer GNMR. The Vodkast record founder brings his narrative-driven approach and mastetful mixing style once more, merging leftfield house music with minimal trance and under the radar techno in a seamless exploration of rare record finds and freshly cut dubplates, setting him apart as a versatile and astute DJ. Gianmaria Coccoluto steps up to the task too with his own track selection, one that offers a brand of bubbling rhythms that owes a heavy debt to his DJ father, who set him on an early path as DJ at a mere 14 years old. Worthy of note is his parallel path as recording artist and founder of no less than three music labels: starting with The Dub Rec alongside his father, he later launched his own imprints, Tête Records first and Dubblack.ltd in 2022. This highly charged set weaves together two visions for the club floor, saturated and forward-pitched rhythms that bring something fresh to the table. It’s a pairing that makes a lot of sense, one that generates a mix of primetime cuts that resonates long past night’s end. Bassiani Podcast 299 is a b2b outing from the Horoom floor recorded live on NYE 2026.

item.title: Balance Selections 359 – Lucas Zarate
item.description:
Artist: Lucas Zárate Show: Balance Selections 359 – Lucas Zarate Serie: Balance Selections Added: March 4, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 359 – Lucas Zarate

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: March 4, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Born in 2001, the Argentinean-born Lucas Zárate belongs to a new generation of producers. Since taking up the craft in 2021, he has refined an organic sound filled with sculpted melodic arcs, imprinted on labels such as Zenebona, Clubsonica and Plaisirs Sonores Records.

Now a regular at infamous Miami club Do Not Sit On The Furniture, Zárate continues to deepen his connection with his local scene. He will also appear on the lineup for our official Road to Balance Croatia showcase during Miami Music Week, where he will join Guy J, Guy Mantzur, Ezequiel Arias and Niki Sadeki for Balance Miami, our first show in the city this decade.

On this Balance Selections mix, the young producer demonstrates why he is one to watch. Featuring tracks from Kebin van Reeken, Kabi & Tomás Pablo, Fernando Olaya and more, it unfolds across two dense, immersive hours of progressive built for patient floors and open skies alike.

Balance Selections

item.title: Art Alfie – Bassiani Podcast 298
item.description:
Artist: Art Alfie Show: Art Alfie – Bassiani Podcast 298 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: February 27, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Art Alfie – Bassiani Podcast 298

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: February 27, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

With cheeky beats and firm roots in the dance floor, Oscar Wedren, AKA Art Alfie is a Stockholm talent steeped in his local scene and ready to take on the world. It was in hardcore and psychedelic bands that Wedren kicked off his career, a move from which has deeply influenced his approach to music today. He’s head of Velvet Pony, a self-run imprint with productions that bring a left-field edge to your typical house; worthy of note too, is his long standing collaboration with Mr.Tophat, and the numerous releases on their shared Karlovak imprint. As for his own work, as well as his sets, the name of the game is warm, rolling and melodic sounds that meander light-heartedly along and mix in playful samples with a dose of expertly programmed percussions. 2017 saw his album Reveries Of on Axel Boman, Petter Nordqvist and Kornél Kovács’ Studio Barnhus too, a conduit for catchy, rolling rhythms straight out of downtown Stockholm. With his house-focussed workouts, Wedren brings a chipper flavour to the club and studio that calls forth the energy of Sweden’s off-the-beaten-path approach to parties. Here for Bassiani Podcast 298, comes an hour-long dose of Alfie’s jolly rhythms, breezy sounds for long-awaited sunny days.

Bassiani Podcast

item.title: Dance TV DJ Mix 670 – Nikk. (Lille, France) / Live at Maloot
item.description:
Artist: Nikk Show: Dance TV DJ Mix 670 – Nikk. (Lille, France) / Live at Maloot Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix Added: February 27, 2026 Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Show: Dance TV DJ Mix 670 – Nikk. (Lille, France) / Live at Maloot

Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix

Added: February 27, 2026

Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Dance TV is proud to present a special Dance TV DJ Mix #670 with Bulgarian underground mainstay Nikk., now based in Lille, France 🇫🇷 — a master of refined selection and seamless long-form storytelling, known for his precise mixing technique and deeply curated sound.

Recorded live at Maloot in Lille, this extended 4.5-hour journey dives deep into rolling minimal, stripped-back grooves and immersive deep house textures — a hypnotic ride built on subtle transitions and atmospheric flow. Lock in and let this one unfold!

A cornerstone of the Bulgarian scene for nearly two decades, Nikk. has been shaping dancefloors since 2005 with a sound rooted in minimal, dub house, and organic rhythms. From iconic venues across Sofia to international appearances, his sets are known for their depth, patience, and finely tuned energy. Beyond the booth, he’s released on labels such as Thanq, Baile Musik, Raw Roots, and PL7, while also playing alongside respected names across the global underground circuit such as Fabio Florido, Jun Akimoto, Reelow, Dean Barred, Yvo Zanev, Proudly People, tINI, Matt Sassari, Spartaque, Skober, Nakadia, Hollen, Franz Costa, D-Formation or Paco Maroto. Last but not least being a professional at all he touches, Nikk. is also an integral member of the Dance TV team, guarding the quality of audio and video as our irreplaceable Content Manager.

Now entering a new chapter from Lille, Nikk. continues to evolve his sound — and this recording captures exactly that.

Dance TV DJ Mix

Enjoy this week’s episode with LA SANTA, head honcho of Redolent Music, along with CHUS, DJ & producer influenced by Classical Music, Jazz, Bossa Nova, Soul, and World Music. This amalgamation of cultures allowed her to blend them into a unique scent. She creates a unique and extraordinary sense of belonging, enhanced through an inner journey. Her DJ sets are filled with sensitivity, harmony, high doses of groove, drums & ethnic roots. She has shared the DJ booth with the best international Electronic djs at the moment such as The Martinez Brothers, Seth Troxler, Blond:ish, CHUS, Dennis Ferrer, Deborah De Luca, Oscar L, Audio Fly or Birds Of Mind to name a few. La Santa expands her energy & grooves all over the world with her continuous plays at Ibiza, Tulum, El Cairo, Guatemala, Panama, Bali, India, Morocco… Her style, influenced by the English, Dutch & American underground sounds, definitely converged into house music inspired by Soul, Tribal, Latin, and World Music.

item.title: Balance Selections 358 – Christian Smith
item.description:
Artist: Christian Smith Show: Balance Selections 358 – Christian Smith Serie: Balance Selections Added: February 27, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 358 – Christian Smith

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: February 27, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Christian Smith has long operated at the intersection of progressive and techno. As both DJ, producer and label boss of Tronic, his work is defined by precision, propulsion and an instinct for evolution that has kept him at the top of his game for more than two decades.

A constant presence in global clubs and festivals, Smith’s output remains relentless. His productions draws on a deep understanding of dancefloor psychology shaped over years behind the decks. The recent Follow Me EP with us underscores that position. Rooted in groove yet engineered for peak-time moments, it reflects an artist who has refined the art of impact.

On this Balance Selections mix, the pioneer delivers on those years of refinement. Featuring tracks from Gai Barone, Jamie Stevens and Mariano Mellino, this is a muscular mix that knows when to pull on emotional levers.

Balance Selections

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 195
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 195 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: February 25, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 195

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: February 25, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

Episode 195 is here, and this one hits with pure drive from the very first kick. I built this week’s journey around control, tension, and release, that feeling when the groove locks in and you forget everything else around you. Whether you tuned in on Wednesday at 6 AM CET or caught it later on DI.FM with 60,000 global listeners, you know this one was made to move.

We open strong with Serioes, Legendaer, and Little Duracell’s Take Control (Return Fall Extended Remix), setting the tone with a deep but commanding pulse. Patrick Scuro, The Post Brothers, and The Enveloper keep the pressure high with Oldschool, while Zafer Atabey’s Unrest on EXTIMA brings that hypnotic tension I love to play with early in the set.

Crossbow and GIULIA (IT) take us inward with Someone in the Mirror before YellowHeads unleash Monochrome Dreams in Peak Mode, a serious moment on the dancefloor. Then UMEK drops Kappa One… and you already know that means business.

Mid-set, Salkantay’s Cross The Line and Nicolas Hoop with BCT’s Mental Focus push the groove into overdrive. Victor Ruiz and HNGT’s A New Day on 1001 Recordings lifts the energy beautifully, and Layton Giordani with Camden Cox on Destiny adds that emotional edge that keeps things human inside the machine.

The final stretch is where it gets special. Victor Ruiz and Moreira’s Every Day Arcane flows into Liberthorn’s Digital Dissociative, and then we flip it. L.A. Style’s James Brown is Dead in UMEK’s bootleg form is a nod to the roots, reimagined for now. Annie Hill closes Episode 195 with Legacy, and that title says it all.

This show is about pushing forward while respecting where we came from. New names, established legends, exclusive heat, all in one uninterrupted ride.

Thank you for being part of this movement every single week. Your energy fuels The Midnight Project, and I feel it wherever I play.

See you next Wednesday at 6 AM.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Added: February 25, 2026

Genre: Electro , House

Tracklist

Devil Rays is a Vinyl DJ from Buenos Aires, Argentina. Creator of La Nave, the first and only bilingual electronic music show (broadcasted for 10 years) and co-founder of the label UFOS MUSIC, together with musician and producer Spacetime Distortion.

Her unmistakable style, sensitivity and connection with the dancefloor have made her cross paths with some of the most influential names in electronic music including Helena Hauff, Ellen Allien, Perc, Underground Resistance and Kenny Larkin.

Her sets are built around Techno’s powerful energy, bridging eras and styles while merging vinyl’s analog warmth with her futuristic vision.

From Electro to Trance, Industrial to EBM, Chicago to Detroit, she pushes boundaries while staying true to the genre’s core.

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 947 – Joey London Style
item.description:
Artist: Joey London Style Show: Data Transmission Podcast 947 – Joey London Style Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: February 23, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 947 – Joey London Style

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: February 23, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Joey London Style steps up for Data Transmission as his ‘Clurb’ EP lands on Hottrax this January.

Fresh from his latest outing on Jamie Jones’ label, the London-raised, Manchester-based selector delivers a mix stacked with groove and intent. ‘Clurb’ and ‘Little Bitter’ both feature, with the latter his personal pick, and you can hear why. Tough drums. Weighty low-end. Built for busy rooms.

There’s plenty of Joey London Style dubs in here too. ‘Copy Kats’, ‘HOT GIRL CRAZY’, ‘The Speed Train’ and ‘Grip Tight’ all get a run out, sitting alongside cuts from Joe Thomas, Ruggier and Baylee Brown. It moves fast. It keeps its punch. No filler.

If you’ve been following his rise through Hottrax, Cuttin’ Headz and Metamorfosi, this feels like another clear step forward. Focused, confident and very much aimed at peak-time.

Stream the full Joey London Style mix now on Data Transmission and grab ‘Clurb’ via Hottrax on 23rd January.

Data Transmission Podcast

Added: February 23, 2026

Tracklist

Welcome to episode eighty-three. Today, we’re leaving the lush melodies behind and diving into the raw, mechanical, and high-energy side of classic trance.

To be honest, this is my favorite style. It’s the sound that truly defines my passion for the genre – focused on relentless drive, industrial textures, and pure power. I’ll admit, I recorded this episode more for myself than for anyone else, but I have a feeling you’re going to appreciate this workout just as much as I do.

Expect 90 minutes of banging energy that doesn’t hold back.

Toolroom Radio is now live! Illyus Barrientos is back with brand new beats from ESSEL, Lewis John, Siege, Camila Jun and a hot collaboration between Armand Van Helden, Mark Knight and D.Ramirez. M-22 stops by for Club Toolroom and of course we drop this week’s hottest record in the world right now with the Killer Cut!

Capture Radio is the weekly soundtrack to your journey through sound, curated and hosted by Laura van Dam.

Every episode blends the worlds of trance, techno, and progressive house, with a signature touch: Laura’s own productions and personal selections that tell a story beyond the dancefloor.

Expect emotional builds, hypnotic rhythms, and high-energy drops a musical trip where every track has a purpose, and every moment is designed to capture you.

Dutch DJs Lucas and Steve joined forces in 2010 and quickly started to impress the scene with their productions. With music getting released on various labels (including Spinnin’ Records and Armada Music), and recently being listed by Beatport in their Top 3 House Producers, their triumphal march through nowadays house music is getting more impressive by the day.

Serie: Dance TV DJ Mix

Added: February 20, 2026

Genre: Deep House , House , Minimal , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Dance TV is proud to present Dance TV DJ Mix #669 with Mexico City–born, Puebla-based DJ and producer ViiV — a rising force within Mexico’s underground whose refined taste and vinyl-driven sets have quietly earned her a respected place behind the decks. Viiv reinforces a reputation built not on excess, but on patience, musicality, and an instinctive understanding of atmosphere — qualities that position her among the new generation carrying the underground forward. Check out her sublime, deep and eclectic vinyl only DJ mix for Dance TV! Enjoy!

Mexico City–born, Puebla-based DJ and producer Vivian Garciaferro aka ViiV is a rising force within Mexico’s underground electronic scene. Her refined taste and vinyl-driven sets have quietly earned her a respected place behind the decks. Active since the early 2010s, Viiv’s artistic path deepened during a formative period in Chicago, where full immersion in the city’s legendary house ecosystem helped shape her musical identity and led her to become part of the Naughty Bad Fun Collective, founded by Sassmouth.

A dedicated crate digger with a clear affinity for the tactile ritual of vinyl, ViiV is known for crafting elegant journeys through minimal house and techno — subtle, hypnotic, and rich in detail. Her commitment to the format translates into sets that feel intentional and deeply curated, balancing restraint with groove while allowing the music’s textures to breathe. This approach has brought her to some of the country’s most respected clubs and stages, including appearances at Boiler Room and Comunité Festival, where her understated confidence and selector’s mindset have resonated with discerning dancefloors.

Beyond the booth, ViiV continues to expand her footprint in the underground by spreading a distinct whim — capricho — energy through her projects and collaborations. She is not only a resident of Sonoro, but als of Space Container, a new party in CDMX focused on merging forward-thinking electronic music with high-quality visual experiences, creating immersive environments that go beyond the dancefloor. With original productions currently in the works and the forthcoming launch of her Unisono label, ViiV is stepping into a new chapter — one that blends sound, vision, and intention while staying rooted in the deeper shades of the underground.

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: February 20, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Behind the moniker N-TCHBL stands Marija Nikolić, an artist who returned to the DJ booth after a decade-long absence from the live circuit.

During that period, she launched her FRISKY Radio show Subliminal, which remains a consistent Top 10 program on the station and has made her one of its longest-standing residents.

In 2024, Marija stepped decisively into production, securing releases on labels including Univack and Contrast, with support from Hernán Cattáneo and her mentor Moshic.

On this Balance Selections mix, the N-TCHBL sound is in full bloom. Featuring music from Stereo Underground, HAFT, Rick Pier O’Neil and others, it’s a set rooted in the underground, where shadow and subtlety shape the narrative.

Balance Selections

Ahead of his highly anticipated open to close return to Stereo in Montreal this Saturday, Markus Schulz delivers the latest Global DJ Broadcast studio session. The episode is highlighted by the world premiere of his upcoming single Somebody’s Watching Me, channeling a darker mainstage space where tech house meets techno, and available from Friday February 27. The show also features selections from Kaufmann, Joris Voorn & Ferry Corsten, Argy, KASIA and Shadow Assembly among others. Frankyeffe steps in for the guestmix to showcase his driving Coldharbour single Liquid Clouds. From deep, emotive moments to dark, peak-time power, this is Global DJ Broadcast primed for the weekend.

Tracklist

All the way from Moldova, modern day Mozart, Andrei Rata, born on July 21st , 1992 has been making his own marks, and own unique style in the trance scene. Andrei Rata known as Andrew Rayel started at a young age developing the passion that he has towards his musical skills. Studying Orchestral music and producing only at the age 13 , Andrew Rayel is a name known for his piano keys, harmony, euphoric, and and mesmerizing sounds.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 194
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 194 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: February 18, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 194

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: February 18, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

Episode 194 is live, and this week is a true showcase of the artists driving the culture forward right now. Every Wednesday at 6 AM we connect across time zones, and I am proud of the names featured in this one.

We open with Adam Sellouk and Alex Kaspersky on Drumcode. Adam has been on a serious rise, appearing on major lineups worldwide and building a reputation that goes far beyond the studio. KASIA continues to establish herself as one of the strongest forces in the current wave of producers, and her collaboration with KAF3R reflects that growing international presence. Township Rebellion and Fab Massimo represent consistency at the highest level, with Township in particular remaining a staple across global festivals and clubs.

Zafer Atabey is another artist to watch closely. His work on EXTIMA shows how fast new names are stepping into the spotlight. And then there is UMEK. A true pillar of the scene. Decades deep and still leading from the front. His influence on generations of producers is undeniable.

Roddy Lima’s connection with Drumcode continues to strengthen his profile, while MIRA MIRA, VE/RA, and Paula van Klar are part of a powerful new generation claiming their space. It is important to me that The Midnight Project gives that platform to rising artists alongside established names.

Cherrymoon Trax and Thomas Schumacher represent history and legacy. Bringing that 1994 anthem back into rotation is about respect for where this culture began. Thomas has consistently remained relevant through evolution, and that longevity deserves recognition.

Return Fall and Chris Mantanz are building momentum, Shuhandz, NYMESYS, and Nicole Chen show how collaboration fuels growth, and Marie Vaunt continues her unstoppable climb with major international recognition. Closing with Storm and Juliet Fox connects two strong artistic identities, and Juliet remains one of the most respected names on global lineups.

This is what Episode 194 stands for. Established icons, rising talent, and artists who are shaping what we will be hearing in clubs worldwide.

Thank you for being part of this movement. Your energy keeps this platform alive.

See you next Wednesday at 6 AM.

Sebastiaan

item.title: Dold – Bassiani Podcast 297
item.description:
Artist: Dold Show: Dold – Bassiani Podcast 297 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: February 18, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Dold – Bassiani Podcast 297

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: February 18, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Bridging emotionally charged sounds with driving loops of the highest order, Patrik Eriksson has cast a striking form in Sweden and beyond. Since his 2015 founding of Arsenik Records (alongside Kuf), the nordic phenom has expanded his catalogue and scope to include live sets as well as studio productions, both demonstrating a deep passion for music as well as a tightly focused reinterpretation of what came before. As Dold, he pulls from IDM, ambient, electro and techno and reformulates a percussive hallmark brimming with mechanical intensity, one that swells with ideas and a technical skill that raises the bar record on record; his latest for instance is a heavy-duty banger titled Feng Shui, a VA contribution worthy of his name. From Europe to farther afield his sets too, negotiate the twin demands of mind and body, offering a highly intelligent and highly danceable techno forever at the vanguard. For Bassiani Podcast 297 Dold returns with yet another masterclass in expert mixing, a 90 minute rollercoaster through contemporary rhythms and nordic ambiance recorded in his Stockholm studio.

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 946 – Josh Hvaal
item.description:
Artist: Josh Hvaal Show: Data Transmission Podcast 946 – Josh Hvaal Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: February 16, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 946 – Josh Hvaal

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: February 16, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Josh Hvaal steps up for DT Podcast 946 with a 100% JHV Mix, and it lands heavy.

Eight releases deep with Jamie Jones and his Hot Creations camp, Josh Hvaal has moved from breakthrough name to reliable club weapon. From ‘The Sound EP’ through to a steady run of dancefloor records, he’s earned backing from heads like Patrick Topping, Joseph Capriati, Solomun and Pete Tong. Not by accident. The tunes work.

This week’s mix says it plainly. A journey through the sound of a 100% JHV Mix. Fourteen tracks. All Josh Hvaal. Around 75% unreleased. No filler, no detours. Just rolling drums, tight low end and that clipped vocal energy he’s dialled in over the last few years.

There’s weight in the IDs. You can hear the next six months taking shape. ‘Where Ya Been Baby’ and ‘Rhythm Of House’ bring that direct, peak-time bounce. ‘Want 2 Feel’ locks into a groove that feels built for low ceilings and warm rooms. And then there’s ‘Hustlers Dance’, the standout and Josh Hvaal’s personal favourite in the mix.

‘Hustlers Dance’ drops Friday 13th February on Trick, the label run by Patrick Topping. It’s one he’s been working towards for a while, and you can hear why. It’s sharp. Confident. Built for those moments when the floor is already moving and you just need to push it further.

Josh Hvaal has been steadily building his own lane too with Gibberish, unveiled by Pete Tong on BBC Radio 1, and that same drive runs through this hour. It feels focused. No hype. Just club music made by someone who spends time in clubs.

DT Podcast 946 is a marker. A snapshot of where Josh Hvaal is right now, and where he’s heading next.

Lock into the full 100% JHV Mix, and keep ‘Hustlers Dance’ on your radar this Friday.

Data Transmission Podcast

item.description:
Artist: Blasha & Allatt Show: Blasha & Allatt – HATE Podcast 476 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: February 15, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Blasha & Allatt – HATE Podcast 476

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: February 15, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Blasha & Allatt are the 476th guests of our original HATE Podcast series.

A high energy club mix by Blasha & Allatt that sees the duo blending hypnotic grooves with raw machine funk that’ll keep you locked from start to finish 🔐

Blasha & Allatt are honorary Mancunian DJs and co-founders of the renowned Meat Free parties, celebrated as some of the wildest techno raves in the UK. Known for their magnetic energy behind the decks, the duo have built a strong reputation both locally and across Europe, bringing intensity and connection to every set, whether at The White Hotel, Blitz or Bret.

Their sound moves seamlessly between techno and house, a dynamic force that has lit up clubs like FOLD, Berghain and Radion, as well as festivals including Stone Techno, Awakenings and Dekmantel. In 2022 they joined Amsterdam’s Vault Sessions as residents, deepening their bond with the city’s scene while continuing to shape Manchester’s underground.

With releases on Blue Hour, Positive Source, Discos Paraiso and Symbolism, Blasha & Allatt continue to evolve, driven by community, creativity and an unshakable love for the dance floor.

HATE Podcast

Shayan Pasha is a progressive house DJ and producer known for high-impact, groove-driven tracks shaped by deep emotion and hypnotic flow.

With over a decade behind the decks and in the studio, he has crafted a signature sound that blends driving energy with musical depth.

His releases on labels like Renaissance and Mango Alley reflect a style that’s both powerful and instantly recognizable.

On this Balance Selections mix, Shayan delivers on his extensive experience to showcase a singular sound.

Featuring tracks from Quivver & Dave Seaman, Rockka & RNDØM, Julieta Kühnle and many original productions, this two hour mix is an effortless ride into smooth progressive.

Tracklist

A key component of Markus Schulz’s acclaimed DJ mix show Global DJ Broadcast is the Collectors Editions Themed Series; time capsules of emotion, craft and musical storytelling. This edition concentrates on the slower paced but reflective and pensive tones of Deeper Shades – a journey weaved around slower paced trance, deeper progressive house and immersive cinematic themes. Designed for repeat listening through intricate listening, gentle walks and scenic drives, Deeper Shades embodies Markus Schulz’s mantra of music as a best friend; a journey where meaning matters.

Whether you are discovering Deeper Shades for the first time or returning to add another chapter to your collection, this is a set designed to be revisited, remembered and kept close.

item.description:
Artist: Unknown
