Serie: Monument Techno Podcast

Added: February 12, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Síoda Rua is a Berlin-based DJ originally from Ireland. She has enjoyed a lifelong connection to music, rooted in years of playing classical and Irish traditional instruments, which eventually led her into the electronic scene.

Prior to settling in Berlin, she spent nearly a decade immersed in the Parisian scene, followed by a year touring across Mexico — chapters that helped refine her sound and broaden her artistic perspective.

Regarding the mix Síoda offered some thoughts :

‘ This two hour vinyl mix is a showcase of the sound I feel most connected to right now. I wanted to build a journey into those hypnotic spaces, the kind of music that feels like being lost in a mystical forest. It is a place where I feel a real sense of freedom, allowing me to let go and lose myself in the music.

Deep hypnotic techno has always been what I have been drawn to, but I’ve also developed a love for the tribal aspects of the music I play. It reminds me of my time living in Chiapas, a part of Mexico where the Mayan culture is still so present. That region has a deep connection to psychedelics and ancient rituals, which influenced my more recent dive into the trippy and trancey style of certain tracks I select. This mix is a reflection of that journey and the sounds that move me.’

Tracklist

Reflective Surface is the sonic brainchild of producer Felipe Novoa, a project where technology and raw emotion collide. Heavily inspired by cyberpunk aesthetics and neon-drenched dystopias, the project serves as a sensory gateway designed to transport listeners into a high-intensity, futuristic journey.

Reflective Surface thrives on the absence of limits. His sound is a complex tapestry of textures that seamlessly mutate between sharp Electro, introspective IDM, and the relentless pulse of Techno. By integrating the rhythmic weight of UK Bass and the groove of House, Felipe strikes a perfect balance between dancefloor intensity and cerebral experimentation.

More than just a musical endeavor, Reflective Surface is a sonic expedition. Each frequency acts as a mirror to a digital tomorrow, proving that in Felipe Novoa’s universe, the only constant is evolution.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 193
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 193 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: February 11, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 193

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: February 11, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

Welcome back to The Midnight Project. This week’s episode kicks off a special run that’s very close to my heart. Dark, driving, and locked into a deep late-night flow, this one is all about momentum and trust in the groove.

I opened the show with “Ritmolicious,” taken from a brand-new four-track EP that UMEK just sent me. This is the first track from that release, and I’ll be featuring the remaining three cuts across the next three episodes of The Midnight Project. No rush, no shortcuts. Each track gets its own moment and its own space exactly where it belongs.

Around that exclusive opener, the energy builds with powerful selections from Emmanuel Miro, Nikoretti, C-Poch, and Return Fall, followed by a timeless, remastered weapon from Monika Kruse and Voodooamt. The second half of the show keeps the pressure high with music from Rich Coote, German Carrizo, ZEREN, Nico Banfi with Techmo, CHANCEKNOT, YellowHeads, and Ali James, carrying us through to the closing moments.

This is what The Midnight Project is about. Sharing new music directly from the artists, giving it room to breathe, and taking you along for the journey as it unfolds week by week.

Thank you for tuning in, for listening closely, and for being part of this every Wednesday morning. I’ll see you next week at 6 AM for the next chapter.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Simone de kunovich – Bassiani Podcast 296
item.description:
Artist: Simone De Kunovich Show: Simone de kunovich – Bassiani Podcast 296 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: February 11, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Simone de kunovich – Bassiani Podcast 296

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: February 11, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Meet Simone de Kunovich, Italian DJ and producer with an eclectic approach to electronic music. International resident of Public Records in New York and Minh in Hong Kong, as well as Love on the Rocks family member, he spent the past two decades accumulating a gigantic collection that spans across records, books, synths, movie posters and collectible of all sorts. He’s a house aficionado, everything from deep to tech house and weirder avantgarde inflections (like his Mondo Nuovo trilogy on Japanese publisher Mule Musiq, influenced by 60/70s avantgarde cinema soundtracks): it’s dance music with a wealth of cultural touchpoints behind it, underlined by extensive crate digging and an intuitive feel for rhythm. For this latest Podcast number, Simone delves back into that universe and returns hands full with a patient assemblage, rolling and funky through and through. Bassiani Podcast 296 is a three hour edition from the Horoom floor, packed with bouncing baselines and saccharine tunes, feel-good house from an Italian master recorded live at Bassiani’s anniversary back in October.

Bassiani Podcast

item.description:
Artist: Unknown

Show: Tracklistings Mixtape 755 – Poladroïd Serie: Tracklistings Mixtape Added: February 11, 2026 Genre: Electro , House

Serie: Tracklistings Mixtape

Added: February 11, 2026

Genre: Electro , House

Tracklist

Shortly after making his debut on International Deejay Gigolos back in 2000, Poladroïd ventured on his own to establish Roulette Rekordz. He then toured Europe performing in cities such as Madrid, Barcelona, London, Amsterdam, Prague, Paris… and predominantly in Belgium alongside artists like ADULT., Ectomorph, Dopplereffekt, Luke Eargoggle, MANASYt, Zerkalo and numerous local talents where he has gained a reputation for his dynamic and energetic live performances, delivering a unique blend of electro with an unwavering intensity that has remained consistent throughout the years.

Around 2008 the label ceased its activities and shortly after Poladroïd took a break from his musical pursuits. However, he resurfaced in 2019, simultaneously relaunching his label. Since then he has released music on Science Cult, Detriti, Microm, Applied Research, Meta Moto, Diffuse Reality, Patterned Media… In addition to his work as Poladroïd, he has also released albums as the Xenomorph Jazz Ensemble and under the Cercle Futur moniker.

Show: Josh Heywood – HATE Podcast 475

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: February 8, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Josh Heywood is the 475th guest of our original HATE Podcast series.

A key figure in Australia’s techno circuit, Josh Heywood crafts his sets instinctively, always guided by the dancefloor.

This set truly represents Josh as an artist, diving deep into a steady pulse. It’s meditative yet physical, blurring time, keeping bodies moving, and suspending minds somewhere between focus and release. Josh is known for his driven, immersive techno, combining driving rhythms, dark textures, and layered mixing. His releases have appeared on respected & influential European labels, translating seamlessly across clubs and late-night dancefloors.

HATE Podcast

Added: February 6, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Enjoy this week’s episode with Colombian NY House Music Legend DJ & Producer JOESKI. Change is inevitable, and nowhere is this more prevalent than in the world of dance music. Analog gives way to digital, trends come and go, yet NYC’s DJ Joeski remains at the top of his game, and now, in the midst of his fourth decade as one of house music’s most sought-after stars, his momentum shows no signs of slowing. Joeski’s trajectory can be traced back to 1991, when he burst onto the NYC house music scene as a founding member of The Chocolate Factory DJ collective. He delighted crowds at Limelight, Tunnel, Palladium and NASA, helped turn “Save The Robots” into a NYC afterhours institution and earned his first residency at “Together” parties at the legendary Roxy, playing alongside the likes of Danny Tenaglia, Louie Vega and Roger Sanchez. Fueled by his genuine love of the music & his hard work through the years, there’s no doubt that Joeski will continue to play a major role in this industry. Tracklist

M.O.S. is an electronic music duo formed by Paul and Ilia, operating in the space between organic and progressive house.

Their releases have appeared on labels such as Anjunadeep, Colorize, UV, and All Day I Dream, gaining measured traction while maintaining a consistent, understated aesthetic.

In 2020, they extended their practice with the launch of Melody Of The Soul Records, a platform that has since grown to over 60 releases and reached the upper tier of Beatport’s Organic House label rankings.

On their Balance Selections mix, the duo lays down two hours of carefully crafted music.

Featuring a number of unreleased M.O.S. tracks alongside collaborations with D-Nox, PROFF, Kamilo Sanclemente, and others, the mix is a considered journey through contemporary progressive.

Dance TV is proud to present Dance TV DJ Mix #668 with Egyptian-born DJ, producer, and tastemaker Shadi Megallaa, whose journey from New York and the UK to Dubai has established him as a key figure in the city’s electronic music culture. A longtime underground devotee and respected community builder, he is the force behind Ark To Ashes and founder of The Flip Side Dubai record shop — both reflecting his commitment to musical integrity and his mission to make house deep again. Drawing from a broad spectrum of house, techno, and beyond, Shadi delivers immersive, groove-led soundscapes shaped by refined taste, deep knowledge, and decades of dedication to the craft. Enjoy this dope mix!

Egyptian-born DJ, producer, and tastemaker Shadi Megallaa is a true underground lifer whose journey through electronic music has taken him from New York and the UK to Dubai, where he has become a pivotal figure in shaping the city’s evolving dance music culture. With decades of dedication behind him, Megallaa embodies the ethos of the underground — a friend to many, an enemy of none, and an artist driven by an enduring mission to make house deep again.

As the founder of Ark To Ashes record label and the driving force behind The Flip Side record shop — now a cornerstone for vinyl collectors and discerning selectors in the region — his influence extends far beyond the DJ booth. Both platforms reflect his unwavering commitment to nurturing community, preserving musical integrity, and supporting forward-thinking artists.

Rooted in the foundations of house, techno, and adjacent sonic territories, Shadi draws on a wealth of experience, diverse taste, and a finely tuned ear to craft productions and DJ sets that resonate with depth and purpose. His sound is immersive yet precise — layered with groove, subtle emotion, and understated power — capturing the essence of a culture he has long helped cultivate while continuing to push it forward.

item.title: Slam Radio 680 – DJ Tool
item.description:
Artist: Dj Tool Show: Slam Radio 680 – DJ Tool Serie: Slam Radio Added: February 5, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Slam Radio 680 – DJ Tool

Serie: Slam Radio

Added: February 5, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

DJ TOOL’s quicksilver sound is as intrepidly propulsive as it is indebted to the old school. Isochronously authentic and assertive, his sets traverse percolating trance, frenetic techno and seductive psychedelia across an encyclopaedic back-catalogue of clandestine classics.

Enraptured by the raw essence of DJing, TOOL honed his style as part of Copenhagen’s Fast Forward collective, boasting an apodictic vinyl dexterity that quickly earned him international renown. High energy and even higher stamina, his anarchistic and indefatigable 8-hour(+) sets at Berlin’s Mala Junta have catalysed fabled closings at the likes of Tbilisi’s Bassiani, New York’s Basement, and London’s Fold.

As a co-founder of Mala Junta, TOOL’s assiduous efforts to politicise nightlife and re-contextualise trance within the queer underground has led to multiple collaborations with Berghain, as well as activist DIY collectives worldwide. From the studio to the floor, every ingredient of his output emanates an energy that’s irrefutably TOOL.

Slam Radio

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 192
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 192 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: February 4, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 192

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: February 4, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Midnighters, welcome back to The Midnight Project.

Episode 192 focuses on momentum and pressure. From the very first kick, this one locks into that late-night drive where groove, acid, and raw techno energy collide. I’ve been digging deep for this episode, blending brand-new heat with timeless attitude, all designed for those moments when the outside world fades, and the music takes over.

You’ll hear a powerful opener from Adam Beyer, GENESI and Aye Anne setting the tone straight away, followed by a tight flow of tracks from Luca Marchese and Teenage Mutants and a massive remix from Marco Faraone on Factory 93. Chris Liebing brings that unmistakable CLR tension, while Gregor Tresher’s Sleeping Giants gets a stunning Enrico Sangiuliano remix that really lifts the journey.

There’s also acid-fueled fire from Amber Broos, a futuristic edge from ADRIANNA, and a no-compromise closing statement with T78 and Mha Iri delivering exactly what the title promises. Every track in this episode has a reason to be here, tested, felt, and selected for that Midnight Project state of mind.

Thank you for being part of this journey and for tuning in every week. Your energy keeps this project moving forward. See you next Wednesday at 6 AM.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 945 – HASKELL
item.description:
Artist: HASKELL Show: Data Transmission Podcast 945 – HASKELL Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: February 3, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 945 – HASKELL

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: February 3, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

There’s a certain type of mix that doesn’t shout. It just locks in and keeps things moving. This one lands exactly there, with HASKELL stepping up with a fresh Data Transmission session as he opens 2026 on Strangelove. No gimmicks, no filler, just club music played by someone who understands pacing, pressure, and when to let a groove breathe.

HASKELL’s rise has been steady rather than noisy. Releases across Toolroom Records, Nervous Records, Myth Of NYX, IN/Rotation and Strangelove Records have built a catalogue that works where it counts. In the booth. On proper systems. The records sit between house and stripped-back club cuts, rolling rather than racing, focused on movement and control.

That mindset runs through this mix. His new Strangelove cut Ice sets the tone early, cold drums, tight low-end, no wasted energy. From there it’s a selector’s run. Lipstick brings swing and weight, DOUBLE C does what PAWSA does best, pressure without shouting. Cuts like El House and Power Of Love keep things ticking with that late-night bounce, the kind that works just as well in a low ceiling basement as it does on a warm rooftop.

There’s a strong run of HASKELL originals woven through the set too. Shake That, unreleased IDs, and the collaboration energy hinted at with the I Need You Baby cut all reinforce a clear point of view. This is club music made by someone who plays clubs regularly, not theory, not trends.

A lot of that discipline comes from outside music. Before records and road life, HASKELL competed internationally in rugby, and you can hear that mentality here. Repetition, timing, restraint. Knowing when to push and when to hold. It’s the same logic that made Go Deep with Mark Knight and Gene Farris such a strong Toolroom moment last year, functional, confident, built to last past first plays.

This mix feels like a proper marker for the year ahead. No rush, no rebrand, just someone doubling down on what works and delivering it clean.

Get locked in and listen via SoundCloud, Mixcloud or Apple Podcasts. This one’s built for long blends and late finishes.

item.description:
Artist: NDRX , Newa Show: Ndrx b2b Newa – Bassiani Podcast 295 Serie: Bassiani Podcast Added: February 3, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Ndrx b2b Newa – Bassiani Podcast 295

Serie: Bassiani Podcast

Added: February 3, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

It’s back to Georgian turf with native talents NDRX and Newa. With complementing propositions for the techno genre, this prolific duo has been perfecting its b2b sets over years of collaborative work while fusing parallel sounds in a fruitful dialogue that’s now in its third run on the Podcast. As well as fundamental in establishing Tbilisi as a pin on the techno map, the two have selflessly encouraged the growth of talents in their own right: NDRX with his nurturing projects Stare at DJ and 11th Floor and Newa with the co-founding of Shin Records, an imprint that champions the best of her homeland’s talent. Berghain, Basement NYC, ADE Amsterdam, Fast Forward and Robert Johnson figure among the storied list of venues and events the pair have made appearances at, this alongside their long running residencies for Bassiani itself. The two have more than proved their mettle, and established themselves as prime representatives of Tbilisi techno at its strongest. For Bassiani Podcast 295, these pillars of Georgian electronics continue their ongoing partnership with a truly special edition. All beat no brakes, this is three hours of industrial sounds recorded live at the club in December.

Bassiani Podcast

Serie: MindTrip Podcast

Added: February 2, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Fueled by her ever-evolving exploration of raw techno, Dutch artist Vera Grace delivers a 70-minute MindTrip session on episode 112, that dives deep into hypnotic, uncompromising territory. With a background shaped at the Conservatorium of Amsterdam, her sound merges musical precision with an instinctive, modular-driven approach, unfolding through layered, driving rhythms and warped textures. Rooted in deep sound design and an almost live method of DJing, the mix evolves into a slow-burning mental journey where time dissolves and intensity steadily builds—capturing Vera Grace at her most focused, raw, and forward-pushing.

This is MindTrip!

Artist: M-F-S Observatory Show: M.F.S Observatory – HATE Podcast 474 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: February 1, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: M.F.S Observatory – HATE Podcast 474

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: February 1, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

M.F.S: Observatory is the 474th guest of our original Hate Podcast series.

For this episode, M.F.S: Observatory shares a raw and hypnotic techno journey built around deep grooves, rolling percussion, and slowly shifting atmospheres. The mix moves naturally between driving techno, ambient moments, and subtle electronic textures, taking its time and letting each transition breathe. The focus is on feel and movement rather than big moments. Repetition settles into a steady rhythm, small changes keep the energy alive, and layers come and go without forcing attention. It’s an immersive, continuous flow, a mix meant to be lived through, where sound, space, and momentum connect in an honest and instinctive way.

HATE Podcast

item.title: Mees Salomé – Distant 103
item.description:
Artist: Mees Salomé Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 103 Serie: Distant Added: January 30, 2026 Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 103

Serie: Distant

Added: January 30, 2026

Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Tracklist

This year is starting out great. It feels really good so far, and it’s made me excited for everything that’s still coming. One of the reasons is that the first release of the year, Into The Light with Tyler Mann, is out today.

There’s more on the way too, five more releases over the next six months, and even more after that. I feel really grateful for the people I got to work with in the previous year, and for the music that came out of those moments. There’s something really beautiful and unpredictable about making music together and seeing where it takes you. These songs are a result of that.

I’m honestly really proud of these songs, and it feels amazing to finally share them. This month’s episode includes some of them. Hope you enjoy ❤️

Distant

item.description:

Show: La Santa – Redolent Radio 270

Serie: Redolence Radio

Added: January 30, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Enjoy this week’s episode with LA SANTA, head honcho of Redolent Music, along with CHUS, DJ & producer influenced by Classical Music, Jazz, Bossa Nova, Soul, and World Music. This amalgamation of cultures allowed her to blend them into a unique scent. She creates a unique and extraordinary sense of belonging, enhanced through an inner journey. Her DJ sets are filled with sensitivity, harmony, high doses of groove, drums & ethnic roots. She has shared the DJ booth with the best international Electronic djs at the moment such as The Martinez Brothers, Seth Troxler, Blond:ish, CHUS, Dennis Ferrer, Deborah De Luca, Oscar L, Audio Fly or Birds Of Mind to name a few. La Santa expands her energy & grooves all over the world with her continuous plays at Ibiza, Tulum, El Cairo, Guatemala, Panama, Bali, India, Morocco… Her style, influenced by the English, Dutch & American underground sounds, definitely converged into house music inspired by Soul, Tribal, Latin, and World Music.

Tracklist

Kevin Di Serna is an Argentine DJ and producer whose work moves across house, progressive house, techno, UK garage, and indie-informed electronics.

Early musical influences at home helped shape a broad listening palette, spanning artists from Radiohead to Burial, Sasha, and John Digweed. The emotional tones absorbed from these references are evident in his output, with labels from Innervisions to Last Night On Earth releasing his introspective productions.

On this Balance Selections, the Argentine producer delivers a densely packed 60-minute session. Featuring music from Kollektiv Turmstrasse, Robag Wruhme, Fort Romeau, and others, it stands as the work of a highly skilled craftsman.

item.description:
Artist: Olivia Mendez Show: Slam Radio 679 – Olivia Mendez Serie: Slam Radio Added: January 29, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Slam Radio 679 – Olivia Mendez

Serie: Slam Radio

Added: January 29, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Olivia Mendez is a vinyl-only DJ, selector, and curator whose sets weave deep, minimalistic techno. Her sound is rooted in rhythm – shaped by her early years as a percussionist and dancer, and refined through a deep immersion in London’s underground scene between 2006 and 2011.

A passionate digger with a background in music journalism and event curation, Olivia approaches her sets as narrative journeys – sonorous, layered, and emotionally resonant. From Brooklyn to Kyiv, she’s queered consciousness through sound, creating dancefloors that pulse with tension, release, and intent.

She is the founder of KONVENT, a FLINTA collective dedicated to reshaping feminist discourse through site-specific music and art interventions, and launched her own label, Dust in Grooves.

Alongside Chami, she co-runs DIG Curated, a cross-disciplinary platform spotlighting underground sound, visual art, and community-driven projects.

Now based in Berlin, Olivia continues to explore the intersections of activism, art, and sound smashing the patriarchy, one beat at a time.

Slam Radio

item.description:

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: January 28, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Greetings Midnighters,

Welcome to Episode 191 of The Midnight Project. Another Wednesday, another moment where we all connect through the same sound and the same energy. No matter where you are listening from, this show is about coming together as one global community and sharing the drive that keeps us moving.

This week’s episode is stacked with music from artists who continue to shape the sound of the scene. You will hear tracks from Mark Reeve, Luca Marchese, Teenage Mutants, Kjaer, Chloe Martinez, Chris Coloré, Dave Davis, ID10-T, UMEK, Belocca, Patrick Scuro, Roger Lavelle, YellowHeads, Kurt Heisz, Nelayan, Pig&Dan, Leoni Alexi, Zanova, Estefa Silvera, and Felix Reichelt. From start to finish, this episode is about trusting the flow and letting the music do the talking.

The Midnight Project is built on all of us. Your support, your messages, and your presence every week are what turn this show into a real Midnighters community. This is not just a radio show, it is a shared ritual that connects us across borders and time zones.

Thank you for being part of The Midnight Project and for keeping this movement alive. I will see you next Wednesday at 6 AM.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Even though Gabriel Muñoz is only 18, he has a decade of production behind him and a sound that’s already unmistakably his.

Backed by support from Interplanetary Criminal, KETTAMA, Silva Bumpa, Benwal and Ben UFO, he’s been steadily landing on the right radars. With releases on Untitled Dist, ATW, ec2a and Hardline, his Hardline drop became the one that really put him on the map.

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 944 – Castion
item.description:
Artist: Castion Show: Data Transmission Podcast 944 – Castion Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: January 26, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 944 – Castion

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: January 26, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

There’s a certain sound that only works when the lights are low and the room is already moving. This is that sound. Castion steps back into the Data Transmission booth with a mix built for sweat, bounce, and no-nonsense groove. Zero warm-up. Straight into business.

Fresh off his return to MoodCollective, Castion has been on a sharp upward curve. The Tenerife-based producer first landed on the imprint alongside Nicole Moudaber, helping launch the label in mid-2025 and pulling early support from Groove Armada and Harry Romero. Since then, it’s been clubs, charts, and consistent damage.

This mix feels like how Castion actually plays. Rolling tech-house pressure, chunky drums, and grooves that don’t let go. It moves fast but never rushes. Percussion swings. Basslines hit low and wide. Vocals land just long enough to hook you before the next blend snaps in. Rooftops at sunset, basements at 3am, and those packed mid-set moments where the floor locks into one rhythm.

There’s plenty of his own material woven through the session. Cuts like Non Stop and The Beat set the tone early. His new single See Some More slides in naturally, all hypnotic drums, sexy vocal tension, and peak-time punch. Elsewhere, he dips into Chinonegro’s Mi Gente, Rushin’s FNKSTA, Sohail & SEBS’ Nah, and a cheeky flip of Timbaland’s The Way I Are that lands exactly where it should. By the time the closing stretch hits, it’s full dancefloor control.

This is a DJ mix that understands flow. No filler. No distractions. Just groove after groove, built for real rooms and real systems.

Castion’s See Some More drops on MoodCollective on 13th February 2026, keep it locked for that. For now, hit play on the podcast and let this one roll.

Data Transmission Podcast

item.description:
Artist: Aöcram Show: Aöcram – HATE Podcast 473 Serie: HATE Podcast Added: January 25, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Aöcram – HATE Podcast 473

Serie: HATE Podcast

Added: January 25, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Aöcram is the 473rd guest of our original Hate Podcast series.

Aöcram’s hypnotic techno brings something enchanting. Their purist approach to artistic integrity is one of a kind; lifelong dedication to electronic music and its culture has established them as an esteemed voice when it comes to cerebral and psychedelic techno. World-renowned institutions such as Berlin’s Berghain and Tresor, as well as more than 40 countries, have seen Aöcram live performances — including all major cultural hubs from New York City to Tokyo, Amsterdam, London, Seoul, Paris, LA, Buenos Aires, Shanghai, and Mexico City

Aöcram’s discography can be found on their own eponymous label as well as through 12” records for some of the scene’s most illustrious labels, such as Mord, Cocoon, Axis, and Semantica. Far removed from any fashions or trends, their path is one of profound passion leading to excellence in the craft.

This podcast delivers a highly emotional narrative into the realms of underground techno.

HATE Podcast

item.title: Global DJ Broadcast – Markus Schulz and ALAT (Jan 22 2026)
item.description:
Artist: ALAT , Markus Schulz Show: Global DJ Broadcast – Markus Schulz and ALAT (Jan 22 2026) Serie: Global DJ Broadcast Added: January 22, 2026 Genre: Trance

Show: Global DJ Broadcast – Markus Schulz and ALAT (Jan 22 2026)

Serie: Global DJ Broadcast

Added: January 22, 2026

Genre: Trance

Tracklist

Ahead of boarding the annual Miami Groove Cruise, Markus Schulz checks in with another weekly Global DJ Broadcast session. The show opens with a heartfelt dedication to dear friend Daxson, who recently underwent serious surgery to remove a tumor, featuring his track While We Wait. If you can spare a moment, please visit Dan’s Instagram to read his story, and send your best wishes to him.

Markus also showcases a new deeper take of his Dakota piece Faultline by Das Pharaoh, a Colorize showcase featuring Mees Salomé and Estiva, and material from Korolova, Hellmuth, Victor Ruiz, Adina Butar and more. There’s a special nod to Washington DC’s Soundcheck nightclub as it prepares to close its doors for good. ALAT provides the guestmix, including the new Coldharbour Black single Almadel Page 205, before Markus returns for an uptempo final 30 minutes to close.

January is here, winter’s in full swing, and the Christmas magic feels like a distant memory. Meanwhile, the team at Mambo HQ have been busy behind the scenes, making some exciting changes to Café Mambo as we get ready for another amazing summer.

With Ibiza buzzing and the sunsets calling, we’re already dreaming of warm nights, chilled breezes, and all the unforgettable moments this island brings. Once again, Café Mambo resident Ryan McDermott is here with a handpicked set of tracks that’ll take you straight to the sun-soaked Mambo Terrace.

This month’s music also features Café Mambo resident Gareth Stirling, joining us for the first guest mix of 2026, alongside new tracks from Carlos Sanjines, Ludwik M ft. G-Martinez, Nopasanada, NS Boulevard, and RUZE — just to name a few.

We are Café Mambo… We are Ibiza!

Midnighters, welcome back to The Midnight Project. Sebastiaan here and Episode 190 is ready to pull you straight into the signal.

This episode is all about pressure, drive, and forward motion. A focused journey where every transition is built to keep the energy moving and the tension alive. No distractions, just a locked groove from start to finish that stays true to the core of the sound.

We open with my own Transmitter to set the tone, and right now that track is available as a free download for now. If you want to grab it, head straight here:

From there we dive into serious momentum with Space 92 and Mark Reeve bringing power early on. The flow deepens with strong selections from Ivox Garcia, Sheik (AR) & Easy Toys, and Giancarlo Di Chiara, before lifting into rave territory with the Teenage Mutants remix.

The pressure keeps building with Fabio Salvati, Lautaro Ibañez, and Yuuta driving things forward. Patrik Widmer and Matteo Vitanza raise the intensity in the final stretch, leading into a massive late moment from Charlotte de Witte. GENESI closes Episode 190 with a relentless finish that stays with you.

Thank you for tuning in, supporting the show, and keeping this movement alive week after week. Your energy means everything.

Stay locked, stay connected, and I will catch you in the next transmission.

Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

Dance TV is proud to present Dance TV DJ Mix #667 with the Underground Ibiza club regular DJ and producer- Kevin Cook. A minimal and quirky deep journey, this recording invites you to dive into a magical world of sublime rhythms, sensual and smooth mixing, mysterious vocal fragments, and a hypnotic, mystical mood — press play and let it pull you in! A true pearl! 🙂

@kevincookmusic @ibizaundergroundclub A long-standing resident and familiar face at Ibiza Underground, Kevin Cook spent years immersed in one of the island’s most vital yet often underestimated spaces — a room that quietly shaped the taste and direction of countless young artists, away from the spotlight and close to the roots of house and techno.

While Juanito’s Ibiza Underground played an essential role in preserving and pushing the island’s true underground spirit, Kevin was there week after week, building his sound, sharing music, and connecting scenes beyond the island through releases and parties around the globe. That chapter laid the foundation for a deeper, more intentional artistic path.

Now based in Maribor, Slovenia, Kevin focuses on the next phase of his journey: developing his label Red Doe, spending more time in the studio, and letting production lead the way forward — with the same patience, depth, and underground ethos that defined his years on the White Island.

item.title: Juan Pablo Torrez – Clubsonica Radio 068 (Lucas Zárate Guestmix)
item.description:
Artist: Juan Pablo Torrez , Lucas Zárate Show: Juan Pablo Torrez – Clubsonica Radio 068 (Lucas Zárate Guestmix) Serie: Clubsonica Radio Added: January 20, 2026 Genre: Progressive House

Show: Juan Pablo Torrez – Clubsonica Radio 068 (Lucas Zárate Guestmix)

Serie: Clubsonica Radio

Added: January 20, 2026

Genre: Progressive House

Tracklist

Hello everyone, and welcome back to a brand new episode of Clubsonica Radio with your host and the DJ for the first hour of the show, Juan Pablo Torrez.

It feels great to be back after a short hiatus, and I’m really excited to share this new chapter of the show with you. This episode features a carefully curated journey through deep and progressive sounds, with a strong selection of music from Clubsonica Records, alongside releases from labels such as Movement Recordings, Mango Alley, and UV Noir.

You’ll hear tracks by Chicato, Abity & Las Modas, Ajaw & Rama, Gudo & Edwin Ajtun, Ignacio Hernández, and more. There are also a couple of personal highlights in this mix, including my extended remix of Caballero feat. Maria – Adventour, as well as my collaboration with Kamilo Sanclemente, remixed by Hernan Cattaneo & Marcelo Vasami.

Lucas Zárate is our guest for this episode, providing a powerful and hypnotic guest mix for the second hour of the show.

Originally from Tucumán, Argentina, Lucas has been a constant presence in the underground scene, both as a DJ and producer. His releases on labels such as Songuara, Kindisch, and Amulanga have showcased his distinctive sound, while his “Siamba | Sambuka” EP, released in March 2025, marked an impressive debut on Clubsonica Records. Supported by artists like Nick Warren, Sébastien Léger, and Hernan Cattaneo, Lucas now returns to the label with a brand new remix of “Amor Fati” by Gudo & Edwin Ajtun, set for release on January 30th.

His rework dives deep into tribal percussion and hypnotic grooves, blending modulated basslines with subtle melodic elements, slowly building tension before reaching a dramatic and expressive climax that perfectly represents the Lucas Zárate sound.

Let the music set your vibes, and let me know what you think about the show. Leave a comment, like, and repost; it’s a great way to support the artists. As always, music is life. Enjoy!

item.title: Data Transmission Podcast 943 – G.Felix
item.description:
Artist: G.Felix Show: Data Transmission Podcast 943 – G.Felix Serie: Data Transmission Podcast Added: January 19, 2026 Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Show: Data Transmission Podcast 943 – G.Felix

Serie: Data Transmission Podcast

Added: January 19, 2026

Genre: House , Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Heads up, dancefloor warriors! G. Felix is back, ready to drop some serious heat with his upcoming ‘REBORN’ EP. This Brazilian tech house wizard is about to two monster tracks that’ll have you grooving from dusk till dawn.

With 18 years of spinning magic, G. Felix isn’t just a name; he’s a legend in the making. His beats have rocked labels like Repopulate Mars and Armada, and he snagged the crown on Brazil’s tech house charts back in 2020. Talk about a heavyweight champ in the scene!

Now, let’s dive into these tracks. First up, ‘11.0 (TimeVision)’ is a deep dive into a groove so immersive, it feels like a sci-fi saga with a haunting vocal twist. It’s the kind of track that sticks with you long after the last note. Then, we got ‘10.0 (The Cosmo’s Purpose)’, packing a gritty bassline that’s got a futuristic spin on those classic house vocals we all love. This is a you won’t want to miss, trust.

Repopulate Mars is G. Felix’s playground, where he’s consistently dropping beats that push the limits. It’s a cornerstone in the scene, setting the pace for everyone else to keep up.

Circle the date, party people: the ‘REBORN’ EP is dropping on 23rd January 2026 via Repopulate Mars. Get ready for a sound adventure that’ll flip your musical world upside down and inside out.

Data Transmission Podcast

Show: Balance Selections 352 – Frankey & Sandrino

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: January 16, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

With a partnership stretching back to 2009, Frankey & Sandrino have quietly carved out a body of work defined by curiosity rather than conformity. Their productions favour intuition over trend, moving fluidly between moods while retaining a clear, personal signature. That commitment to following their own instincts has seen them release across a broad spectrum of respected imprints, including Innervisions, Mule Musiq, Kompakt, Diynamic, as well as their own platform, Sum Over Histories.

On this Balance Selections mix, the duo trace a slow-burn arc from progressive breaks into more introspective terrain. Featuring music from David August, Impérieux, Frizon and others, it unfolds as a focused, inward-looking 60 minutes that rewards close listening.

Balance Selections

Tracklist

Hailing from Belfast, LAZLO is a Scottish based DJ who has quickly made her mark on the Glasgow Techno scene with dynamic residencies playing for long running collectives Animal Farm and Frenetik.

Her underground sound showcases a journey between the chiaroscuro of electronica with modular, analog effects and low end nuances to a more hypnotic sound.

She has played some of the most infamous clubs and parties in Scotland, such as Sub Club and Pressure whilst supporting some of technos heavyweights.

LAZLO brings driving, hypnotic grooves to the floor that you won’t want to miss.

“Hello, my name is Joanan, better known as “Tony Tormenta”, from Mexico City.

At very early age my taste for music has been differently influenced by my family, cousins ​​and uncles – they taught me bands that I have never heard in my childhood, like Dance, House and Synthpop. Inspired by “Everything But The Girl”, “Art of Noise”, “Propaganda”, “East of Wall” and “Prefab Sprout” in a mature age was discovering them, the best bands without a doubt. It was until 2003 in the Love Parade that took place in Mexico, listening to all those sounds, and seeing how the deejay was the center of the movement, I wanted to be like them and stir the dancefloor up. That experience led me to meet many people who today I consider my best friends, who gave me the opportunity to show my work as a DJ. ‘Subway Club’, ‘Seek My Beat’ and where now is my home ‘Terror Clash’.”

Tony Tormenta was born as a project, as a synthesis of the Disco, House, EBM, Electro, Breaks, Techno trash and Darkwave, those same styles has taken me to important venues in the city- Kinky, Rico Club, Uta, La Mezcali, Real Under, Allende Red, Madero. Club, Pasaguero, BLACK (to mention a few), in addition to sharing a booth with the legends of the Mexican scene.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 189
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 189 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: January 14, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 189

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: January 14, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

It’s Wednesday and Episode 189 of The Midnight Project is out now. This one is all about momentum and atmosphere. Deep pressure, rolling grooves, and that slow-burning intensity that keeps you locked in from start to finish.

I open the show with Expanse by GENESI on Arcane, setting the mood instantly. From there it keeps evolving with driving selections by Giancarlo Di Chiara, Matteo Vitanza, Nikoretti, and the timeless Player Three remaster. Heavy underground energy comes in with Demon Noise and Zafer Atabey, followed by hypnotic movement from Enveak and Mazdem, plus raw attitude from Momola and Estora. Marie Vaunt brings serious fire on Arcane, Rob Robsen and Paula van Klar with Spartaque push the pressure higher, and Thomas T. takes things into darker territory.

Big shout out to Bruno Power. Bruno is a world on its own. That Opus bootleg landing in my DM made my Sunday night, and closing the show with it just felt right.

Thank you for being part of this journey every single week. Your energy keeps The Midnight Project alive.

See you in the night, Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

item.title: Balance Selections 351 – Tantum
item.description:
Artist: TANTUM Show: Balance Selections 351 – Tantum Serie: Balance Selections Added: January 13, 2026 Genre: Deep House

Show: Balance Selections 351 – Tantum

Serie: Balance Selections

Added: January 13, 2026

Genre: Deep House

Tracklist

Berlin-based producer Tantum, aka Thomas Koch, came up as a guitarist before channeling a decade of instrumental discipline into a refined electronic sound rooted in analog warmth, restrained tension and steady momentum. Moving fluidly between minimal, techno and progressive house, he broke through with his 2020 debut on Guy J’s Lost & Found, setting the tone for a steady run of club-focused releases.

Subsequent outings on labels including Bedrock, Radikon, Poker Flat and Monaberry have cemented his reputation, earning consistent support from key selectors across the scene. Since 2025, he has also helmed the keep my letters imprint, extending his curatorial vision while delivering DJ and live sets built around long arcs, deep grooves and euphoric release.

For this Balance Selections mix, Tantum delivers a two-hour journey steeped in refined progressive drama. Featuring music from Frankey & Sandrino, Andrés Moris, Guy J and more, this is an impressive showcase of track selection and narrative which unfolds with purpose from start to finish.

Balance Selections

Tracklist

🖖 This week’s guest is an exclusive from Mystik Vybe👨‍🚀🌕

Mystik Vybe is a Bucharest-based DJ and producer deeply rooted in the city’s underground electronic music culture. With a musical background that started at an early age through various instruments, his passion for electronic music took shape in the late ’90s, inspired by iconic performances in his hometown from artists such as John Digweed, Deep Dish, Sasha, Groove Armada, Sven Väth, Richie Hawtin, Luciano and Hernan Cattaneo.

He began his DJ career in 2011 and later expanded his artistic vision by studying music production in London. Since then, Mystik Vybe has performed across key electronic music destinations including Bucharest, London, Ibiza, Barcelona, Moscow, and more, delivering groove-driven sets built for the dancefloor.

His productions have been released on well-established labels such as Deeplomatic Recordings, Witty Tunes, Safe Music, Selectro and Baikonur Recordings. In 2015, he marked a major career highlight by becoming a finalist in the prestigious Burn Residency, one of the most competitive platforms for emerging electronic artists.

Musically, Mystik Vybe moves seamlessly between tech house, deep house, minimal/deep tech, techno and electronica, shaping a sound that balances groove, atmosphere and precision. His releases have received chart support and recognition from influential names including Claptone, Stefano Noferini, Paco Osuna and Claude VonStroke.

Focused on quality, consistency and evolution, Mystik Vybe continues to deliver refined electronic music designed for late-night dancefloors worldwide.

Yo, space cadets and groove warriors, strap in for a celestial ride with Deep Cuddle’s latest mix, a shimmering portal into the 2026 podcast series. This one’s got those ethereal grooves that’ll have you floating in the sonic stratosphere.

Deep Cuddle’s been the shining star in Chicago’s underground galaxy for more than two decades, a true legend in the cosmos of sound. His vibe is a wild fusion of psychedelic nebulae and house rhythms, crafting an ever-evolving universe of beats and melodies.

In ‘Glimmer’, Deep Cuddle teams up with the stellar suemomo to weave a of smooth, steady grooves. Picture this: the bassline glides like a comet streaking through the cosmos, while those light drums pulse with a steady, celestial rhythm that’ll have your head nodding in no time. Suemomo’s vocals? They’re like stardust, floating, adding a gentle lift that enhances the deep house atmosphere without stealing the spotlight. This mix is the essence of Chicago’s vibrant dance music galaxy, a true through the stars.

Released under the astral banner of Penthouse Audio, ‘Glimmer’ is out now, ready to get your feet moving and your soul grooving. Artist: Markus Schulz Show: Global DJ Broadcast: World Tour – Markus Schulz Live from Avalon, Los Angeles (NYE 2026) Serie: Global DJ Broadcast Added: January 8, 2026 Genre: Trance

Show: Global DJ Broadcast: World Tour – Markus Schulz Live from Avalon, Los Angeles (NYE 2026)

Serie: Global DJ Broadcast

Added: January 8, 2026

Genre: Trance

Tracklist

The first World Tour edition of 2026 on the Global DJ Broadcast takes us to one of the most important cities in Markus Schulz’s career: Los Angeles. Recorded live on New Year’s Eve from Avalon Hollywood, this special episode captures highlights from Markus’ open to close solo set – a tradition he has returned to time and again to mark the turn of the year.

Los Angeles has long been a second home for Markus, a city where extended solo journeys, trust from the dancefloor, and musical risk-taking helped shape his identity as a storyteller behind the decks. From late-night introspection to peak-time energy and afterhours depth, this World Tour reflects the full arc of an open to close experience on a night where history, emotion, and momentum collide.

A powerful way to begin 2026 – live from a venue and city that remain central to the Global DJ Broadcast story.

Bryan Gee kicks off 2026 with something a little different, a deep dive into the sounds of 2025 across V Recordings, Liquid V and Philly Blunt.

This special edition of the V Podcast rewinds through some of the biggest releases, standout moments and underground gems from the past year, showcasing the full strength of the V family. Expect highlights from L-Side, Alibi, Sl8r, Carlito, Crystal Clear, Command Strange and more, alongside vocal pressure from Inja, DRS, Rider Shafique, Carasel, MC GQ and Sherona Knight.

item.title: Slam Radio 676 – Electric Rescue
item.description:
Artist: Electric Rescue Show: Slam Radio 676 – Electric Rescue Serie: Slam Radio Added: January 8, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Slam Radio 676 – Electric Rescue

Serie: Slam Radio

Added: January 8, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

In 2026, it’s 36 years of activism with passion. Electric Rescue is considered one of the made-in-France masterpieces of the electronic music but also a worldwide renowned artist. His hits are regularly played by electronic music masters like: Laurent Garnier, Len Faki, Ben klock, Dax J, Fjaak, Ellen Allien, Perc, marcel Dettmann, Sven Väth, Slam or Luke Slater.

Electric Rescue has been forging a strong specificity in the electronic landscape by defending a techno neither conceding nor creating compromises, similar in this aspect to his friend Laurent Garnier.His productions have been signed on labels like Cocoon, Virgo, Arts, F Communications, Cod3QR, Soma, Sci + Tec, Boys noize and his own label Skryptöm of course…..

Electric Rescue is also a famous name as live artist and DJ. Since more than two decades, he has been traveling the world preaching the techno good word with passion and modesty. He had the opportunity to play in mythic clubs such as Berghain/Panorama Bar (Berlin), Tresor (Berlin), Weather Festival (France), The Edge (São Paulo), Concrete (Paris), The Egg (Londres), Herr Zimmerman (Rotterdam), Air Club (Tokyo), Moog (Barcelone)

His artistic effervescence is also the result of his good Skryptöm Records management, an establishment he founded in 2006, on which he has signed many tracks for Traumer, Moteka, Kmyle, Popof, Julian Jeweil, Scan X, Maxime Dangles, Commuter, dusty kid, the label has collaborated with renowned remixers like: Antigone, Mark Broom, Truncate, Slam, Johannes Heil, Secluded, Xhin, Inigo Kennedy, Zadig, Laurent Garnier, Jonas Kopp, , Flug, Danton Eeprom or The Hacker. On his former label, Calme Records (1999/2005), he was releasing tracks and remixes of Surburban Knight, DJ ESP / Woody Mc Bride, Thomas P Heckmann, Neil Landstrumm, Oxia, Paul Nazca, Southsoniks.

Electric Rescue is also involved in organising parties in Paris, with its Skryptöm residency at Kilomètre 25, Glazart, Rex Club, 1988 live club in Rennes and its famous Play parties in unusual and secret venues around the French capital. Always on the lookout for new artists emerging in techno, he was the first to invite artists like Boys Noize, Laurent Garnier, Ben Klock, Ellen Allien, Stephan Bodzin, Dave Clarke, Anthony rother, Oscar mulero, Dusty Kid, Gary Beck, Alan Fitzpatrick, blue hour, cleric and Paul Ritch to mix in Paris, from the newcomer to the biggest artists from our electronic scene.

At the same time, he is pursuing a lesser-known activity in his career, the artistic direction of clubs such as Kilomètre25, Glazart since 2021. He founded Nexus in 2019 and withdrew in September 2022 to devote himself solely to Kilomètre25 and Glazart.

Considered as a discrete but efficient techno activist, Electric Rescue has been insuffling in his entire work the Rave values which he has been adopting, defending them and making them self-references (exchanging, sharing, brotherhood, freedom, underground culture) rejecting so the blinding DJ business spot lights

In 2026, A new album will be released on Cod3QR Laurent Garnier label, a very surprising opus with some group collaborations with artists such as Abd Al Malik, Amélie Nilles, Gaspar Claus, Boscaro and his brother Maxime Dangles who will arrive on a huge label to be name soon.

2026 promises to be another nice year for Electric Rescue.

Slam Radio

item.title: Monument Techno Podcast 501 – Nesa Azadikhah
item.description:
Artist: Nesa Azadikhah Show: Monument Techno Podcast 501 – Nesa Azadikhah Serie: Monument Techno Podcast Added: January 8, 2026 Genre: Techno

Show: Monument Techno Podcast 501 – Nesa Azadikhah

Serie: Monument Techno Podcast

Added: January 8, 2026

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Nesa Azadikhah is a Tehran-born, Paris-based DJ, producer and musician. She is best known for her work as the founder of Deep House Tehran, a platform that highlights electronic music scenes in her country. Nesa has been playing traditional percussion instruments (tonbak, daf) since the age of six. She started mixing and producing in her teens. Over the years, she established herself as one of the pillars of the Tehran music scene before relocating to Tbilisi and then Paris. In 2022, she teamed up with AIDA (a DJ and producer based in San Francisco) to launch Apranik record label in the midst of the Woman Life Freedom revolution. She also founded Makhunik Records. As a DJ, her sets move effortlessly from techno to house music.

Monument Techno Podcast

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 188
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 188 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: January 7, 2026 Genre: Tech House , Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 188

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: January 7, 2026

Genre: Tech House , Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

This week’s episode of The Midnight Project hits differently. Pure drive, no distractions, and a profound opening statement to set the tone for the whole journey. From the first beat, this one is built for big systems and that shared moment when the energy locks in.

I’m excited to say I’ve secured a very special festival edition of Adam Beyer’s brand-new track, and you’re hearing it right here. This version is made to explode in front of massive crowds, and opening the show with it felt like the only right move. From there, the pressure stays on with heavy hitters and forward-thinking cuts from Twins Project, Tini Gessler, Kate Hex, and a strong run of Arcane releases that keep the momentum rolling.

The middle of the mix dives deep with A.D.H.S. & Jose Bonetto and Teenage Mutants alongside Technicism, before pushing into raw, driving territory with Anna Reusch and a standout Robert Hood remix for FJAAK. I closed things out with DJ Rush and Deas, because sometimes you need that final punch to seal the deal.

This episode is all about movement, tension, and that unmistakable festival-ready energy, even when you’re listening in the dark.

Thank you for being part of The Midnight Project and for supporting the music every single week.

See you next Wednesday, Sebastiaan

The Midnight Project

This month’s mix is called Far From Home. I spent the holidays away from family for the first time in a long while, and I know many of us were in the same boat.

Whether you were traveling, working, or simply embracing where life’s taken you, this one’s for everyone who found themselves far from home.

As always, it’s a journey through some of my favorite melodic electronic tracks of the moment, featuring Sébastien Léger, Bob DK, Makebo & Amonita, Eynka, and even Ella Fitzgerald remixed by Tourist.

Thanks for being a Global Citizen!

item.title: Mees Salomé – Distant 102
item.description:
Artist: Mees Salomé Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 102 Serie: Distant Added: January 2, 2026 Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Show: Mees Salomé – Distant 102

Serie: Distant

Added: January 2, 2026

Genre: Melodic House , Melodic Techno , Progressive House

Tracklist

Before anything else, I want to say thank you, for the support, the messages, the energy, and the moments we shared last year. None of this exists without you.

Looking back at 2025, it was a year that started out with uncertainty, writer’s blocks and doubt. Searching for that peculiar balance between creativity and business. Some soul searching later, I realised that music will always be the fabric of this whole adventure, creating music that I truly love. Knowing it resonates with you makes every step that much more meaningful. This will be, without a doubt, the most important goal for the new year.

As this new year begins, I feel a sense of clarity and purpose. I have a desire to create and build that space where we can slow down together, be present and let the music speak without distraction.

On that note, here’s the first episode of the year, with some new music that will come your way soon. I promise. Hope you enjoy <3

Distant

Stereo Productions kicks off 2026 with something truly special: a Vinyl Only Tribute Mixtape from Baggi, setting the tone for the year ahead. item.title: Monument Techno Podcast 500 – Mary Yuzovskaya
item.description:
Artist: Mary Yuzovskaya Show: Monument Techno Podcast 500 – Mary Yuzovskaya Serie: Monument Techno Podcast Added: December 31, 2025 Genre: Techno

Show: Monument Techno Podcast 500 – Mary Yuzovskaya

Serie: Monument Techno Podcast

Added: December 31, 2025

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

We are thrilled to share Mary Yuzovskaya’s set recorded live from Monument Festival 2025 as part of our Monument Techno Podcast 500 celebrations.

Mary Yuzovskaya runs her set like an old but reliable steam engine locomotive. Except this train is going to Hogwarts. Mary is a responsible conductor, making sure everyone is on board, getting their bodies going at a steady pace, warming up the system for what’s to come. Later.

Her sound lives in a hypnotic but assertive space. The hypnotic part comes from steady patterns that loop and settle into the body. Rhythms that repeat long enough to quiet the thinking mind. You are not distracted by constant changes. The groove stays in place and draws you in through consistency.

The whole Monument family is dancing in sync. Looking as good as ever. High in energy and anticipation. And then. The sky opens. But, we have our best lasers ON, saved for this occasion, saturday night, they weren’t used on friday at all, and when the pouring rain hits the upgraded lasers, we have a million diamonds falling towards us. The crowd roars. Celebrates what nature throws at us. Surrenders to its will. No one left the dancefloor to seek refuge in their tents. No one. Mary Yuzovskaya responds…

If you were there, you know that this was the start to what can only be described as the Champions League of festival night shifts. With Yuzovskaya, Pacho and Doltz seemingly playing one after another. Mary’s job was to get the crowd going, but at the same time leave room for more. She delivered.

Monument Techno Podcast

Tracklist

Random Alias, established in 2020 alongside Breakfast on Mars record label, ushers in a forward-thinking paradigm that redefnes reality, prioritizing substance over name and identity. Against a stereotyped society and conventions, Random Alias creates a dynamic, magnetic, and ever-evolving sonic landscape. The integration of infuences from techno, progressive and acid house, crafts dancefoor foundations with perpetually shifting atmospheres. Random Alias employs wave modeling and FM synthesis to shape a hybrid sound that converged the clarity of crisp digital tones with the warmth of analog elements, all the while keeping the focus on the ever-evolving interconnection between human end technology.

item.title: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 187
item.description:
Artist: Sebastiaan Hooft Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 187 Serie: The Midnight Project Added: December 31, 2025 Genre: Techno

Show: Sebastiaan Hooft – The Midnight Project 187

Serie: The Midnight Project

Added: December 31, 2025

Genre: Techno

Tracklist

Hey Midnighters,

Episode 187 of The Midnight Project hits different. This is a high speed mix, released on the final Wednesday of 2025, and it is packed with momentum from start to finish. No slowing down, no looking back, just pure drive as we close the year together.

This episode brings together some of the most streamed techno of 2025 alongside fresh cuts and exclusives. From Ailen DC opening the door to an alternate universe, to Eli Brown, Adrianna, Bart Skils with Heerhorst, and the unmistakable pull of Adam Beyer and HNTR, the energy stays locked in. Arcane makes a huge mark throughout the mix with tracks from Miane, Matt Guy, TigerBlind, Nelayan, and Marie Vaunt, shaping a sound that defined the year.

There is a personal thread running through this one as well. You will hear my remix of Raving Adventure by Horatio and Pagano, plus my extended remix of Chrome by bismark and Sygma, both built for speed, tension, and late night intensity. Space 92 hits hard twice, Joyhauser and Drunken Kong keep it raw, and the closing moments feel like a final statement before the year flips.

Thank you for making 2025 such a powerful year for this project. Your support means everything. Let’s take this energy straight into what is next.

Sebastiaan

🖖 This week’s guest is an exclusive from Mathei👨‍🚀🌕

Mathei is a Cluj-based artist and producer who has made a name for himself in the electronic music scene with energetic sets and productions that dive into deep house, deep tech, and minimal.

His tracks, available on Beatport, include well-received releases like Flawless (Mihai Popoviciu Remix), Gravel Pit, Love Like This, and Pump Up That, showing both his versatility and artistic depth.

With a unique style and refined sound, Mathei keeps catching the attention of the international electronic music community.
